title: MintEval: Do LLMs Implement the Trading Strategy You Asked For? A Behavioural-Equivalence Benchmark for Natural-Language-to-Strategy Code
comments: 5 pages, 3 figures, benchmark code and evaluation harness available at https://github.com/spearmintai/minteval. Siyu Wang and Varstern Yifan Wang contributed equally, Yifig Wang is corresponding author
summary: Large language models are moving from producing trading signals to writing the code that executes them. The failure mode of the second role is silent: generated code runs, a backtest plots, yet the risk logic that the trader described is not the logic being executed. Existing code benchmarks test functional correctness on unit tests and finance benchmarks test forecasting; neither measures whether an implementation behaves like the strategy that was asked for. We introduce MintEval, a benchmark in which reference strategies are generated programmatically from a library of composable building blocks, back-translated into colloquial trader instructions, and re-implemented by the model under test. Generated and reference programs are executed bar by bar on identical market data and frictions, and compared on their actions rather than on code similarity or profit: alpha is differenced away. MintEval v0 contains 800 tasks on BTCUSDT 15-minute data, stratified by an execution-measured state-span complexity tau that is decoupled from description length. Low-cost models reach a mean ActionMatch of at most 0.544 and reproduce at most 0.087 of tasks exactly; on a stratified subset of 200 tasks a frontier model (Claude Opus 5.5) reaches 0.889 and reproduces 0.575 exactly, yet still fails silently on 0.275 of tasks. Given a menu of building blocks, models identify the strategy almost perfectly, yet 79.2% of the implementations whose specification was read correctly diverge on more than 10% of active bars. The LLM judge of a recent strategy-generation benchmark, applied verbatim, accepts every one of these silent failures.

title: Smart Sensing for Safer Bridges: From Sensor Signals to AI-Driven Anomaly Detection
summary: Bridges contribute significantly to transportation connectivity and urban development. Therefore, reliable bridge monitoring is crucial for protecting public safety and detecting anomalous behavior in bridge sensor data that may provide early indications of abnormal structural conditions. This paper investigates anomaly detection in real-world bridge sensor data using two different complementary approaches, namely signal processing and the data-driven machine learning model Isolation Forest. The real-time bridge sensor data is collected from an iBridge sensor device installed on a bridge in Norway. The methods are evaluated using anomaly counts, anomaly detection time, processing rate, anomaly rates, visualization, and temporal agreement. Moreover, a controlled anomaly-injection analysis is performed to evaluate the sensitivity of each method. Numerical results demonstrate distinct detection characteristics and computational requirements, highlighting the potential of machine learning, particularly the data-driven Isolation Forest, alongside signal processing for identifying anomalies in bridge sensor measurements.

title: NegT2IBench: When Negation Changes the Picture. A Polarity Benchmark for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models are judged by benchmarks that measure whether requested content appears, but these benchmarks largely overlook the complementary ability to satisfy negated constraints, for example, generating "a non-red cup." Measuring negation raises challenges not faced by affirmation-based benchmarks and requires careful prompt and evaluation design. We introduce NegT2IBench, a benchmark of 4,800 prompts covering two attribute types and four relation categories. Prompts are organized by polarity: the number of positive statements that must hold and negated statements that must not, each ranging from 0 to 2. Varying the two independently separates the effect of negation from the effect of prompt complexity. Our detector-based scoring is reproducible, auditable, and pinpoints which requirement failed. On 600 images with three-annotator labels, it agrees with humans as closely as vision-language judges up to 30x larger, while using only a fraction of their GPU memory. Across eleven T2I models and 211,200 images, nine score lower on a single negated statement than on a single positive one. Per-statement scoring reveals that the loss is largest for color and near zero for proximity, and that 41.5% of failed statements render exactly what the prompt forbids. Rendering what a prompt asks for and withholding what it forbids are distinct capabilities that an aggregate compositional score cannot distinguish. NegT2IBench measures the latter directly, providing a controlled testbed for diagnosing negation failures and developing methods to overcome them.

title: Light Entropic Optimal Transport on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: Entropic Optimal Transport (EOT) has become a practical framework for learning stochastic couplings between complex distributions, with applications in generative modeling and domain adaptation. However, most EOT solvers are designed for Euclidean spaces, while manifold extensions remain limited and often rely on costly iterative methods, simulated dynamics, or generic neural models that do not fully exploit the underlying geometry. We introduce ManifoldLightOT, a light approach for learning kernel-induced EOT couplings directly on common manifolds. Using the kernel form of the EOT solution, we construct geometry-specific Gibbs kernels together with compatible potential parameterizations for spheres, tori, $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, and $\mathrm{SE}(3)$. These choices yield closed-form normalization and directly sampleable conditional distributions. Our formulation naturally extends to products of manifolds, making it applicable to more complex geometries. The parameters of the potentials are optimized directly from samples using Monte Carlo estimates of the learning objective. Through synthetic and real-world experiments, we show that ManifoldLightOT often outperforms existing manifold OT methods while retaining direct sampling.

title: Zephon: Elastic Determinism for Online, Stateful Foundation Model Data Loading Pipelines
comments: preprint; currently under revision at VLDB'27
summary:
Deterministic data loading is important for foundation model development: model researchers need confidence that differences they observe across costly ablations are caused by the parameter they changed rather than non-determinism in the training data sequence. The data loader must provide elastic determinism, i.e., a deterministic sequence of global training data batches despite changes to the GPU topology across runs (e.g., due to GPU scarcity), frequent checkpoint-resume cycles, and different data processing execution backends. Achieving this is difficult because modern foundation model data pipelines tokenize, pack, and mix samples online, introducing stateful n-to-m transformations that break sample indexing. Existing data loaders largely assume indexable 1-to-1 pipelines, and the common workaround of offline materialization is expensive and, for some modalities such as video, infeasible.
  We present Zephon, a data loader for foundation models that supports online, stateful pipelines while providing elastic determinism and efficient resumption from checkpoints. It partitions the global stream into topology-independent lanes, serializes ordering decisions while parallelizing stateless work on interchangeable backends, and checkpoints only bounded in-flight state so recovery cost does not grow with training progress. We evaluate Zephon on text and vision-language workloads and show that it achieves competitive throughput while providing a combination of guarantees that no existing loader offers for online, stateful pipelines.

title: Coda: Exploiting Admission Flexibility for Coding-Agent Serving
summary:
Coding agents powered by large language models (LLMs) repeatedly alternate between model inference and tool calls, creating long-lived sessions with reusable key-value (KV) states and asynchronous request resumptions. Logical readiness, however, does not ensure efficient admission in a shared serving system. Through direct trace analysis and trace-driven replay, we identify two mismatches: reusable KV states reside across storage tiers and incur unequal computational costs for state preparation, while requests with heterogeneous context lengths can decode inefficiently together. Our central insight is that exploiting admission flexibility can improve serving performance while preserving request progress.
  We present Coda, a coding-agent serving system that realizes this insight through a readiness-informed admission layer incorporating two mechanisms. Tiered-Aging state admission exploits bounded flexibility in admission order to improve admission efficiency and preserve request progress. Compatibility-Aware execution admission exploits flexibility in attention grouping within each model iteration to reduce mixed-context interference and improve shared decoding efficiency. For multi-worker configurations, Coda introduces a separate routing layer that considers KV-state residency, worker load, and request-to-worker context-length compatibility to guide efficient request placement. We evaluate Coda across different models and workloads against state-of-the-art coding-agent serving systems and vLLM. Across the single-worker and multi-worker experiments, Coda improves output-token and SLO-compliant throughput by 20.3% and 70.5% on average, with peak gains of 29.3% and 140.2%.

title: Securing Computer-Use Agents Against Branch Steering Attacks
comments: 16 pages, including 2 figures. To be presented at the "Agents in the Wild" Workshop at the NeurIPS 2026 Conference
summary: Modern Computer Use Agents (CUAs) directly interact with graphical user interfaces and execute third-party web tools, exposing them to indirect prompt injection across every rendered page and tool response. While the Dual-LLM pattern is the primary system-level architecture offering formal security guarantees - using an isolated Planner LLM (P-LLM) to fix execution paths before processing untrusted inputs via a Quarantined LLM (Q-LLM) - these guarantees break down in graphical environments. Because CUA interaction is inherently dynamic, plans cannot remain data-independent; they must branch based on anticipated runtime web content - covering all possible cases the agent may encounter. This exposes agents to branch steering attacks, where an adversary crafts untrusted data to coerce a CUA down a hazardous, pre-approved branch without injecting explicit instructions. We systematically study branch steering attacks and introduce STEER-Bench (101 tasks across 9 domains), showing high attack success against both standard (94.4%) and vanilla Dual-LLM (89.5%) CUAs. We then propose COBRA, an architecture that pairs trusted branching plans with ahead-of-time capability constraints, strictly bounding the parameters and destinations each branch may execute. On STEER-Bench, COBRA reduces attack success to 0% while retaining 97% benign utility.

title: PaNGEA: Parallel Node Generation and Exploration Algorithm on GPU
summary: Primal heuristics for finding high-quality feasible solutions are an important component in mixed-integer optimization (MIO) solvers. Recent advances in GPU-accelerated optimization algorithms show the potential of GPU acceleration for continuous optimization. In this paper, we introduce the Parallel Node Generation and Exploration Algorithm (PaNGEA), a GPU-friendly MIO primal heuristic. PaNGEA explores restricted subproblems by combining linear-relaxation solves with a local-search procedure designed for efficient batched execution on GPUs. In addition, instead of relying on a single heuristic for iterative variable fixing, we leverage GPU batching capabilities to generate and explore multiple subproblems in parallel. PaNGEA leverages GPU capabilities in two ways. First, on 283 MIPcc26 and MIPLIB instances, implementing a single-node primal heuristic on the GPU reduces the average gap integral by 8-18% relative to its CPU counterpart. Second, generating and exploring multiple nodes in parallel further reduces the average gap integral by 12-19%.

title: ULTRADISCOVERY: Abductive Exploration in an Interconnected, Epistemically Open Universe
summary: Scientific discovery often begins when scattered clues call for a new way of describing the world. Such abductive exploration can require constructing the representation in which an explanation is stated, when the world is epistemically open, and composing evidence scattered across contexts, when it is structurally interconnected. Existing benchmarks rarely separate these two demands or control them independently. We introduce ULTRADISCOVERY, an interactive world of five domains in which an agent revises an initially successful theory and predicts the outcome of an unseen cross-domain intervention. A $2 \times 2$ design leaves the representation open or discloses it, and leaves the evidence distributed or aligns it, with the latent dynamics fixed. With the representation open, agents across eleven models often retract the axiom they were taught, and none introduces the unobserved entity or rewrites the variables that a replacement requires. Disclosure triples intervention requests and adds about one of the eighteen findings the world affords, and alignment adds less. Two vendor-harness systems carry discovery into more domains, and one of them rewrites the variables in Open episodes. No system makes the exact prediction within 200 paid actions. At larger budgets one exact prediction appears with both aids, while every Open episode remains inexact. The results locate the difficulty in the step from accumulating evidence to composing it into a representation that transfers.

title: LS-AR: Future-Predictive Latent Steering in Autoregressive LLMs
comments: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Long-Context Foundation Models
summary: Standard autoregressive (AR) models process high-level task instructions, state history, and transient tokens within a single shared sequence of tokens. Consequently, they lack the architectural mechanisms needed to isolate macro-objectives from context noise. To overcome this single-channel limitation, we introduce Latent-Steered Autoregressive (LS-AR), a dual-channel architecture that decouples continuous goal steering from discrete token decoding via FiLM conditioning. We evaluate a Static Goal Encoder (P_0) for persistent macro-objective retention across long rollouts and a Dynamic State Tracker (P_t) for recurrent latent updates during generation. On long-horizon retrieval past context limits (H=1024, W=500), LS-AR (Static) achieves 100% target recall where parameter-matched baselines collapse (0%), while increasing throughput by ~35% and cutting peak VRAM by 52.8%. In Blocksworld planning under forced perturbations (k=1), LS-AR (Dynamic) sustains an 89.0% completion rate vs. 71.0% for the baseline, though zero-shot entity scaling (N -> N+1) exposes single-vector capacity limits (0%). Finally, dual-channel authority analysis shows that text goal dropout establishes latent-dominant control, offering structural defence against text prompt injection while introducing a latent vector attack surface.

title: Peer Influence across Heterogeneous AI Models
summary: When two AI agents disagree, who persuades whom? As multi-agent systems increasingly combine language models of different families and sizes, the answer can determine which judgments survive interaction. Measuring persuasion as the probabilistic shift in an agent's decision after a single exchange with a dissenting peer, we test seven open-weight models across three language understanding tasks. We find that persuasion is strong: when models disagree, receivers often abandon their initial judgment after seeing a peer's answer and explanation. Surprisingly, however, neither standalone certainty nor model scale reliably predicts persuasion dynamics. Models producing almost perfectly consistent decisions in isolation can be among the most susceptible to persuasion, and small models can match larger ones as persuaders and resist their influence just as effectively. Furthermore, we show that the size of the shift depends more on the susceptibility of the listener than on the persuasiveness of the speaker. Persuasion patterns are therefore specific to each model pairing, with heterogeneity amplifying persuasion in some combinations and suppressing it in others, allowing a dissenting agent running a small model to overturn the judgments of a much larger one. These findings show that the behavior of interacting models cannot be inferred from their individual properties but must be evaluated in the combinations in which they will operate.

title: Predictor-Guided Latent Space Codon Optimization for Maximizing Protein Expression
summary: Codon optimization, the process of selecting synonymous codons to improve mRNA translation efficiency and protein expression, is central to therapeutic protein production and mRNA vaccines, yet it remains a hard problem. The design space is discrete and combinatorially large, precluding gradient-based methods, and existing tools rely on heuristic proxies (e.g., Codon Adaptation Index or GC-content) that poorly capture true expression. We introduce Latent-Space Codon Optimization (LSCO), which recasts this discrete problem as a continuous one by mapping sequences into the latent space of a pretrained mRNA language model, enabling efficient gradient-based search. LSCO combines four components: a data-driven expression objective from an uncertainty-aware predictor, a Minimum-Free-Energy regularizer for structural stability, a naturalness prior from a protein-to-codon back-translation model, and constrained decoding for protein fidelity. On a real-world, wet-lab antibody expression dataset, LSCO outperforms simple frequency-based, as well as modern deep generative baselines in predicted expression, while retaining suitable biophysical properties.

title: Beyond Single Videos: Benchmarking and Active Evidence Seeking for E-Commerce Cross-Video Reasoning
summary: E-commerce videos are information-dense and frequently compared by consumers evaluating products and merchants assessing marketing strategies. However, existing multimodal models mainly focus on single-video understanding and have limited ability to compare information across videos. We introduce AdsCVR, the first e-commerce cross-video reasoning benchmark, containing 2,483 videos and 6,110 question-answer pairs across six reasoning dimensions. Cross- video reasoning requires models to locate fine-grained evidence among many redundant frames and integrate visual details, speech, and on-screen text. We therefore propose AdSeek, an agentic framework that dynamically selects visual and audio tools during multi-turn exploration, replacing static uniform sampling with active evidence acquisition. To address the sparse credit assignment of reinforcement learning, we develop an offline trajectory rectification mechanism that identifies reasoning errors and missing multimodal evidence in RL-generated trajectories. The corrected trajectories provide supervised fine-tuning signals that reduce biases learned during RL. This mechanism supports a rectified bootstrapping pipeline in which initial RL exposes reasoning bottlenecks, supervised fine-tuning corrects them, and a final RL stage further improves the policy. AdSeek achieves 74.30 percent accuracy on the AdsCVR test split, outperforming its Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct backbone by 27.90 percentage points. It also generalizes to the open- domain CrossVid benchmark, demonstrating effective active evidence gathering.

title: Ask, Relax, or Act? Evaluating Actionable Indeterminacy in LLM Preference Reasoning
summary: An LLM agent can recognize uncertainty yet still choose the wrong next step: asking when action is already justified, or seeking clarification when the constraints must change. We formalize actionable indeterminacy: act when an accepted action is shared across all admissible preferences or objectives, clarify when each possibility is feasible but no action is shared, and propose a minimum-cost permitted constraint repair when the request is infeasible. We construct a solver-grounded benchmark spanning object allocation, meeting scheduling, apartment choice, and stable matching. Matched pairs retain the same source while changing whether intervention is necessary, and evaluation separates decision correctness, matched-pair reliability, and fully correct responses. Our findings reveal a recurring difficulty in recognizing when intervention is unnecessary: models can identify situations requiring clarification or repair yet still intervene when a justified action already exists. Correct decision labels also fail to guarantee usable actions, questions, or repairs. Crucially, response requirements shape not only how decisions are expressed but also which decisions are made. Making the required content explicit substantially improves fully correct responses and can change intervention decisions, even when outputs are already parseable. These findings highlight that reliable agency requires more than recognizing uncertainty: it requires intervening only when necessary and translating the chosen next step into a verifiable response.

title: A Benchmark for Spatially Grounded Gesture Generation
comments: 13 pages, 9 figures. Benchmark of the Referential Gesture Challenge at the HSI Workshop, ECCV 2026. Data and video: https://huggingface.co/datasets/hsi-workshop/referential-gesture-challenge
summary: Communication in shared space interweaves verbal and non-verbal signals, and pointing gestures anchor language to the environment: "put the cup on that one" is uninterpretable without the gesture that fixes the referent. Yet no common framework exists for evaluating whether generated gestures indicate their intended referent; distributional metrics reward a gesture aimed at the wrong object as long as it looks natural. We introduce a benchmark for spatially grounded gesture generation, comprising ~2K pointing-annotated clips from naturalistic VR dialogue with ground-truth 3D referents, a task in which systems must decide when, how and where to point within conversational speech, and a protocol that separates temporal alignment, spatial grounding and perceived naturalness. We also provide a flow-matching baseline, MM-Conv-Flow. Evaluating it alongside an independent retrieval-based system and captured human motion, we find that geometric grounding can exceed that of human pointing without any gain in perceived naturalness, showing that referential gesture quality must be measured along separate dimensions.

title: Emergent Structure in the Marginal Attention Space of Language Models
summary: While representation similarity across independently trained language models is well-documented, how internal mechanics such as attention behave across models remains far less characterized. Inspired by this gap, we examine the structure of post-softmax attention weights by marginalizing over query positions, mapping them into a joint token-head "marginal attention space". Evaluating across 60+ diverse LLMs, we find that different properties emerge when reducing this space along its token and head axes. When reduced token-wise, marginal attention yields a text-intrinsic signal robustly conserved across models. To explain this property, we empirically connect marginal attention to the input-output Jacobian of the network, and prove theoretically that under a smoothness assumption, models with similar next-token distributions are guaranteed to have similar input-output Jacobian statistics. When reduced head-wise, it forms a model-private signature conserved across documents. Practically, this provides a natural way to estimate a per-head budget for key-value (KV) cache eviction, effectively decoupling model-specific budget allocation from text-intrinsic token scoring. On standard eviction benchmarks, a per-head budget precomputed offline on pretraining text, combined with a training-free token score, shows competitive performance with methods that recompute the budget on every document or train it per target. Code available at https://github.com/Flegyas/marginal-attention

title: Ontological Instability and Statistical Amplification: The Paradox of "Humanizing" LLM-Generated Text
summary: Supervised AI-text detectors report high benchmark accuracy, but it is not clear what their decisions are based on. We analyze a RoBERTa-based detector under semantic, structural, and tokenizer-level perturbations, using the M4 dataset (N = 10,000) and controlled generations (N = 300). When Mistral-7B-Instruct was asked to make machine text sound more human, Verb Diversity rose from 0.77 to 0.92 and the outputs became easier to detect. Detection scores appear to track statistical complexity, which also leads to a 76.3% false-positive rate on formal human writing. As a control, we evaluate event-based Latent Space detection. Paraphrasing changed 87% of its event sequences (Jaccard = 0.067), and homoglyphs altered 70% of the extracted verbs even though extraction still ran (Jaccard = 0.30). Its best domain AUC was 0.577. RoBERTa's robustness seems specific to the features it uses, and structural abstraction did not make detection more robust.

title: Building Interpretable Feature Representations for Resume-Vacancy Matching by Distilling Production LLM Signals
comments: Accepted to EMNLP 2026; 13 pages, 4 figures, 7 tables
summary: Matching candidates to vacancies is central to recruitment, and a recruiter needs to see why a candidate fits, not only a single opaque relevance score. We provide this evidence as named, interpretable matching dimensions recruiters can act on - eight in our current deployment. We propose a two-part approach. The first is an LLM-based labeler whose prompts and feature definitions were refined from recruiter feedback while it served as an earlier production matching stage. In the current architecture, it is used only for offline labeling and is not called on online requests. The second is a feature bi-encoder distilled from it: a LoRA-adapted embedding backbone with compact per-dimension heads that runs on CPU and serves all online requests. Both parts keep improving: prompts are revised as feedback arrives, and the bi-encoder is retrained on the updated labels. The model is trained on 168,772 labeled vacancy-resume pairs (17,921 vacancies and 180,030 resumes). Recruiters using the service can confirm or revise surfaced feature predictions. On 927 recruiter-recorded values from this selected production-feedback subset, the deployed student agrees with the recorded decisions in 888 cases (95.79%). This is operational, non-blinded agreement rather than an independent human evaluation.

title: Exploring the Trade-Off Between Structured Pruning and Fault Tolerance in Deep Neural Networks for Space Applications
summary: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) inherently exhibit a degree of robustness to bit-level faults due to their distributed representation of information. As a model increases in width, this information becomes more dispersed, theoretically reducing the impact of any single bit fault. In this paper, we empirically investigate the relationship between model width and robustness to Single Event Upsets (SEUs). We conduct a comprehensive experiment in which baseline models undergo iterative structured pruning to reduce their width while preserving task performance as much as possible. At each pruning stage, we run a targeted fault-injection campaign to evaluate the model's performance under simulated bit-flip scenarios. Our results show that, although structured pruning increases per-inference sensitivity to faults by reducing redundancy, this effect is effectively counterbalanced by shorter execution time, which lowers the probability of encountering an SEU. These findings suggest that structured pruning can yield significant energy and latency savings without compromising overall reliability, providing useful guidance for designing robust AI systems for space applications.

title: How to Find and Reuse Policies for Continuous Adaptation in Lifelong Reinforcement Learning
summary: In lifelong reinforcement learning, retaining previously learned policies is not sufficient for effective transfer to a new task. Useful knowledge may be distributed across several prior policies, and its relevance may change as the learner acquires experience. One hypothesis is that task similarity can be effectively used in a continual learning setting to find and combine previously learned policies. To test it, Adaptive Mask Selection and Composition (AMSC) is designed to estimate similarity from online experience via non-parametric Wasserstein task embeddings from state-action-reward samples. The z-score-normalized sparsemax of the similarity scores are used to derive a variable-size support to periodically choose and weight policies to form a prior when learning a new task. On CT-graph and MiniGrid, AMSC achieves higher mean performance and forward transfer than the evaluated modular composition baselines while exhibiting no forgetting. Results on Continual World suggest that identifying relevant prior knowledge and determining its layer-specific composition may require additional layer-specific tuning. Ablations show that selecting relevant sources and determining how strongly to reuse them are central to these gains. Independently measured pairwise transfer is also positively associated with task-embedding similarity. These results indicate that task similarity can be an effective criterion to select and weight specific knowledge for reuse in lifelong reinforcement learning.

title: In-Distribution Forcing for Long Video Generation at Test Time
summary: Modern autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models excel at short-horizon video generation, yet generating long videos remains challenging due to drifting, where colors and textures shift, and motion dynamics decay. Existing works primarily rely on KV conditioning, which selects or modifies cached key-value (KV) entries to mitigate drifting. However, we observe that KV conditioning alone is insufficient as it assumes cached KV entries remain in-distribution. This assumption fails beyond the training horizon: nothing constrains the construction of KV entries during rollout, giving rise to the KV-provenance problem where cached entries themselves become out-of-distribution (OOD). To address this, we propose In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing), a test-time framework that aligns both KV caching and KV conditioning with training configurations. Its key mechanism, self-caching, prevents OOD KV entries at their source. Each chunk is cached without attending to prior KV entry, keeping the rolling window exactly in-distribution. Consequently, ID-Forcing seamlessly extends short-horizon models to minute-scale video generation. Extensive evaluations show that our method remains competitive on standard video generation benchmark while substantially outperforming prior work in mitigating drifting, as validated by both our drift metrics and a user study.

AI.title_translation: 测试时用于长视频生成的分布内强制技术
AI.tldr: 提出一种名为ID-Forcing的测试时框架，通过自缓存机制解决长视频自回归生成中的KV缓存分布外问题，实现高质量的分钟级视频生成。
AI.motivation: 现代自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成时容易出现颜色、纹理偏移和运动衰减（漂移问题），而现有的基于KV条件的方法由于缓存条目超出训练视野而变成了分布外（OOD），无法根治该问题。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing)的测试时框架，其核心机制为自缓存（self-caching），即每个数据块在缓存时不关注先前的KV条目，从而使滚动窗口保持在分布内。
AI.result: 在标准视频生成基准上保持了竞争力，并在抑制漂移方面大幅超越以往工作，通过漂移指标和用户研究得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: ID-Forcing作为一个测试时框架，成功将现有的短视野自回归视频扩散模型无缝扩展到分钟级长视频生成，并在抑制漂移方面显著优于先前的方法。
AI.translation: 现代自回归（AR）视频扩散模型在短视野视频生成方面表现出色，但由于颜色和纹理发生偏移的“漂移”现象以及运动动态的衰减，生成长视频仍然具有挑战性。现有工作主要依赖KV条件设定，通过选择或修改缓存的键值（KV）条目来减轻漂移。然而，我们观察到仅靠KV条件设定是不够的，因为它假设缓存的KV条目仍然在分布之内。这种假设在训练视野之外会失效：在生成过程中没有什么能够约束KV条目的构建，从而引发了KV来源问题，即缓存的条目本身变成了分布外（OOD）。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了“分布内强制”（ID-Forcing），这是一个在测试时将KV缓存和KV条件设定与训练配置对齐的框架。其关键机制——自缓存，从源头上防止了OOD KV条目的产生。每个数据块在缓存时都不去关注先前的KV条目，从而使滚动窗口完全保持在分布之内。因此，ID-Forcing无缝地将短视野模型扩展到了分钟级视频生成。广泛的评估表明，我们的方法在标准视频生成基准上保持了竞争力的同时，在减轻漂移方面显著优于先前的工作，这一点已由我们的漂移指标和用户研究所证实。
AI.summary: 该论文针对长视频生成中由于KV缓存超出分布范围（OOD）导致的漂移问题，提出了一种测试时框架——In-Distribution Forcing (ID-Forcing)。通过核心的自缓存机制，该方法在测试时将KV缓存和条件与训练配置对齐，成功将短视野视频模型扩展至分钟级生成。
AI.keywords: 长视频生成, 视频扩散模型, 自回归, KV缓存, 分布内强制
AI.comments: 该论文针对自回归视频扩散模型在长视频生成中常见的漂移和运动动态衰减问题，提出了在测试时进行分布内强制（ID-Forcing）的创新框架。通过引入自Capping机制（self-caching），有效解决了KV缓存失效和分布外（OOD）问题，具有很高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Foresight: planning future perception in streaming VLMs without retraining
summary: Existing streaming vision-language models (VLMs) continuously perceive and reason over visual streams, but their computational pathways remain fixed throughout inference. Consequently, they cannot adapt computation to evolving scene dynamics, where different future events demand different levels and forms of perception. We show that streaming VLMs inherently possess the ability to anticipate the immediate future, and leverage this capability to dynamically configure future computation in a training-free manner. Realizing such anticipatory computation, however, is very challenging: future anticipation must be sufficiently reliable to guide computation, planning must run concurrently with streaming inference, and online reconfiguration must incur negligible overhead. To address these challenges, we introduce FORESIGHT, a dual-stream architecture comprising two Siamese LLMs with shared weights, input encoders, and KV cache. The first LLM continuously processes incoming tokens, while the second runs ahead of the stream to anticipate future context, plan future computation, and generate task responses without interrupting streaming inference. Each plan decides when to reason next, what to check then, and how densely to sample, keeping transient evidence separate from persistent control. The resulting computation plan is executed online through an efficient reconfiguration protocol with schemaguided decoding and lightweight diff-based updates, enabling dynamic adaptation with low overhead. With a frozen Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, FORESIGHT achieves 23.0 mean joint F1 on OmniPro Online evaluation beating strongest trained baseline by 9.5%, while improving the backbone by 6.7 on StreamingBench and 15.4 on OVO-Bench, with the largest gain of 18.7 when evidence arrives later in the video stream. Our source code will be made publicly available.

AI.title_translation: Foresight：无需再训练即可在流式VLM中规划未来感知
AI.tldr: FORESIGHT是一个双流架构，它利用流式VLM的未来感知能力，通过动态规划未来计算来适应场景变化，从而在不中断推理的情况下提高性能，无需再训练。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视觉语言模型（VLMs）的计算路径在推理过程中是固定的，无法适应不断变化的场景动态，导致在不同未来事件需要不同感知水平和形式时效率低下。
AI.method: FORESIGHT引入了一个双流架构，包含两个共享权重、输入编码器和KV缓存的Siamese LLM。第一个LLM处理传入的token，第二个LLM超前流运行以预测未来上下文、规划未来计算并生成任务响应，而不中断流式推理。它通过模式引导解码和轻量级基于diff的更新实现高效的在线重新配置协议。
AI.result: 使用冻结的Qwen3-VL-8B骨干网络，FORESIGHT在OmniPro Online评估中取得了23.0的平均联合F1分数，比最强的训练基线高出9.5%。同时，在StreamingBench上将骨干网络性能提高了6.7，在OVO-Bench上提高了15.4，当证据在视频流后期出现时，增益最大达到18.7。
AI.conclusion: FORESIGHT通过利用流式VLM固有的未来感知能力，动态规划未来计算，在不进行再训练的情况下显著提高了流式VLMs在处理复杂、动态场景时的适应性和性能。
AI.translation: 现有流式视觉语言模型（VLMs）持续感知和推理视觉流，但其计算路径在整个推理过程中保持固定。因此，它们无法根据不断变化的场景动态调整计算，而不同的未来事件需要不同水平和形式的感知。我们展示了流式VLM天生就具备预测近期未来的能力，并利用这种能力以无需训练的方式动态配置未来的计算。然而，实现这种预测性计算非常具有挑战性：未来预测必须足够可靠以指导计算，规划必须与流式推理并行运行，并且在线重新配置必须带来可忽略的开销。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了FORESIGHT，一个双流架构，包含两个共享权重、输入编码器和KV缓存的Siamese LLM。第一个LLM持续处理传入的token，而第二个LLM超前流运行以预测未来上下文、规划未来计算并生成任务响应，而不中断流式推理。每个计划决定下一次何时推理、接下来检查什么以及如何密集采样，将瞬时证据与持久控制分开。由此产生的计算计划通过高效的重新配置协议在线执行，该协议采用模式引导解码和轻量级基于diff的更新，实现低开销的动态适应。在冻结的Qwen3-VL-8B骨干网络下，FORESIGHT在OmniPro Online评估中取得了23.0的平均联合F1分数，比最强的训练基线高出9.5%，同时在StreamingBench上将骨干网络性能提高了6.7，在OVO-Bench上提高了15.4，当证据在视频流后期出现时，增益最大达到18.7。我们的源代码将公开发布。
AI.summary: 本文提出了FORESIGHT，一个无需再训练的双流架构，旨在解决现有流式视觉语言模型（VLMs）在处理动态场景时计算路径固定的问题。FORESIGHT利用VLM固有的未来感知能力，通过一个Siamese LLM并行预测未来上下文并规划后续计算，从而动态调整感知策略。该方法通过模式引导解码和轻量级更新实现高效的在线重新配置，显著提高了模型在OmniPro Online、StreamingBench和OVO-Bench等基准上的性能，尤其在证据延迟出现时表现出更大的优势。
AI.keywords: 流式VLM, 未来感知, 动态规划, 无需再训练, FORESIGHT
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个无需再训练的动态计算规划方法，利用了模型固有的未来感知能力。双流Siamese LLM架构设计巧妙，实现了预测和推理的并行进行，有效解决了流式VLM适应动态场景的挑战。其在性能上的显著提升，尤其是在复杂场景下的表现，凸显了其重要性。

title: The Fragility of Trigger-Tag Mechanisms for Misuse Detection in Open-Weight LLMs
summary: Open-weight language models can be downloaded, modified, and deployed beyond their developers' control, limiting the effectiveness of centrally enforced safeguards. Recent work has therefore proposed \emph{trigger-tag} mechanisms that produce a detectable signal when a model is used under a target condition, such as generating phishing contents. Although these mechanisms borrow from established techniques, their use for conditional misuse detection in open-weight LLMs is relatively new. Therefore, existing research works have not systematically studied the robustness of trigger-tag mechanisms under adversarial attacks. To close this gap, (i)~we formalize trigger-tags and distinguish \emph{token-level trigger-tags}, which introduce watermark-inspired signals during decoding, from \emph{weight-level trigger-tags}, which learn backdoor-inspired associations between target conditions and detectable model behavior. Furthermore, (ii)~we introduce \Untag, a unified attack framework that organizes their mechanism-specific attack surfaces into a common taxonomy. We evaluate representative token-level and weight-level trigger-tags using phishing as a case study. We find that while trigger-tags may provide useful evidence in controlled settings, our attacks render the existing trigger-tag mechanisms to be entirely ineffective. Consequently, we argue that these mechanisms should not be treated as robust misuse detectors when attackers can transform outputs or modify open weights.

AI.title_translation: 开源权重语言模型中用于滥用检测的触发标签机制的脆弱性
AI.tldr: 本文揭示了开源大语言模型中用于滥用检测的“触发标签”机制在对抗攻击下极其脆弱，现有的检测机制在面对输出转换或权重修改时会完全失效。
AI.motivation: 开源大语言模型下载和部署不受控制，中心化安全防护受限，近期提出的“触发标签”机制用于条件滥用检测相对较新，但现有研究尚未系统研究其在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。
AI.method: (1) 将触发标签形式化，区分为解码时的“词元级触发标签”和学习后门关联的“权重级触发标签”；(2) 提出统一的攻击框架Untag，将特定机制的攻击面组织为通用分类法；(3) 以钓鱼内容生成为案例进行实证评估。
AI.result: 虽然触发标签在受控设置下可能提供有用证据，但Untag攻击使得现有的触发标签机制完全失效。
AI.conclusion: 现有的触发标签机制在面对能够转换输出或修改权重的攻击者时并不可靠，不应被视为鲁棒的滥用检测器。
AI.translation: 开源语言模型可以被下载、修改和部署，超出了其开发者的控制范围，这限制了集中强制实施的安全保护措施的有效性。因此，近期研究提出了“触发标签”（trigger-tag）机制，当模型在目标条件（如生成网络钓鱼内容）下使用时，会产生可检测的信号。尽管这些机制借鉴了现有技术，但它们在开源大语言模型中用于条件滥用检测的应用还相对较新。因此，现有研究尚未系统地研究触发标签机制在对抗攻击下的鲁棒性。为了填补这一空白，(i) 我们将触发标签形式化，并区分了在解码过程中引入受水印启发信号的“词元级触发标签”与学习目标条件和可检测模型行为之间受后门启发关联的“权重级触发标签”。此外，(ii) 我们引入了 \Untag，这是一个统一的攻击框架，将其特定机制的攻击面组织成一个共同的分类法。我们以网络钓鱼为案例研究，评估了具有代表性的词元级和权重级触发标签。我们发现，虽然触发标签在受控环境中可能提供有用的证据，但我们的攻击使得现有的触发标签机制完全失效。因此，我们认为，当攻击者可以转换输出或修改开放权重时，这些机制不应被视为鲁棒的滥用检测器。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了开源大语言模型中用于滥用检测的“触发标签”机制的脆弱性。作者将触发标签形式化为词元级和权重级两类，并提出了一个名为Untag的统一攻击框架。以钓鱼内容生成为例的评估表明，现有的触发标签机制在对抗攻击下会完全失效，因此不能被视为鲁棒的滥用检测手段。
AI.keywords: 开源大语言模型, 滥用检测, 触发标签, 对抗攻击, 鲁棒性
AI.comments: 该论文首次系统性地研究了开源大语言模型中基于“触发标签”（trigger-tag）机制的滥用检测的鲁棒性，通过提出统一的攻击框架Untag，证明了现有机制在对抗攻击下完全失效，对开放权重模型的安全治理具有重要警示意义。

title: ParaGeo: Decomposing Paralinguistic Variation into a Shared Latent Geometry
summary: Speech delivery varies with both the requested paralinguistic attribute and the linguistic content. We introduce ParaGeo, a matched-content decomposition of paralinguistic variation in a frozen speech language model. Synthesized audio tokens are replayed with a fixed listening prompt; pooled key/value (K/V) representations are centered and projected into a shared low-dimensional space. Our GLM-4-Voice probe spans 80 requested controls from 12 benchmark families across eight sentences. With a globally fitted calibration basis, content-held-out centroid accuracy using this basis is 9.49% versus a 1.25% permutation baseline; same-label cross-content cosine similarity is 0.285 versus 0.017, and both conditional permutation tests yield p = 0.001. A separate ten-scenario, six-style probe reveals reproducible contrast directions across scenarios. Static, additive, and temporal interventions produce attribute-, layer-, and schedule-dependent response profiles. These results provide a shared coordinate representation for measuring paralinguistic structure and an empirical starting point for latent speech control. Code is available at https://github.com/yuhanlydia/ParaGeo.

AI.title_translation: ParaGeo：将副语言变异分解为共享的潜在几何空间
AI.tldr: ParaGeo是一种将语音语言模型中的副语言变异解耦到共享低维空间的新方法，能够有效测量和控制副语言结构。
AI.motivation: 语音表达会随着请求的副语言属性和语言内容而变化，为了更好地理解和测量这种副语言结构，需要建立一种共享的坐标表示方法。
AI.method: 引入ParaGeo方法，对冷冻语音语言模型中的副语言变异进行匹配内容解耦；重放合成音频Token并配合固定的监听提示；将汇集的键/值（K/V）表示进行中心化并投影到一个共享的低维空间中。
AI.result: 在内容留一法中心准确率上，ParaGeo达到9.49%（显著优于1.25%的置换基线）；同标签跨内容余弦相似度为0.285（对照组为0.017）；条件置换检验的p值均为0.001。静态、加法和时间干预产生了属性、层和调度依赖的响应轮廓。
AI.conclusion: ParaGeo成功地将副语言变异分解到共享的低维潜在几何空间中，证明了跨语境副语言结构的共性，为潜空间语音控制提供了经验基础。
AI.translation: 语音的传递会随着所请求的副语言属性和语言内容而改变。我们介绍了ParaGeo，这是一种对冷冻语音语言模型中的副语言变异进行匹配内容解耦的方法。合成的音频标记通过固定的监听提示进行重放；汇集的键/值（K/V）表示经过中心化处理并投影到一个共享的低维空间中。我们的GLM-4-Voice探针跨越了8个句子的12个基准家族中的80个请求控制。通过全局拟合的校准基底，基于此基底的内容留一法中心准确率为9.49%，而排列基线为1.25%；同标签的跨内容余弦相似度为0.285，而基线为0.017，且两项条件排列检验的p值均为0.001。一个包含十个场景、六种风格的独立探针揭示了跨场景的可复现对比方向。静态、加法和时间干预产生了依赖于属性、层和调度的响应轮廓。这些结果为测量副语言结构提供了一个共享的坐标表示，并为潜在语音控制提供了实证起点。代码可在 https://github.com/yuhanlydia/ParaGeo 获取。
AI.summary: 论文介绍了ParaGeo，这是一种通过共享低维潜在几何来解耦语音语言模型中副语言变异的方法，实验证明了其能够有效捕捉并控制跨语境的副语言结构。
AI.keywords: 副语言变异, 语音语言模型, 潜在几何, 特征解耦, 语音控制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为ParaGeo的新颖方法，通过将副语言变异分解到一个共享的潜在几何空间中，为解释和控制语音语言模型中的副语言属性提供了一个有力的分析框架。其创新之处在于利用匹配内容的解耦方式，揭示了跨语境的共享坐标表示。

title: The Reeb Transform
summary:
Reeb Transforms offer a compact representation of how shapes in $\mathbb{R}^n$ change when sliced along varying directions. We define the Reeb Transform as the family of Reeb graphs induced by height functions along all directions in the unit sphere. In this paper, we develop a rigorous treatment of Reeb Transforms for o-minimal definable sets, with particular emphasis on one-dimensional stratified spaces embedded in $\mathbb{R}^d$ and on surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$. We establish injectivity of the Reeb Transform in multiple settings, including compact surfaces in $\mathbb{R}^3$, capturing the essential topological features needed to uniquely reconstruct such surfaces.
  However, in dimensions above three, the Reeb Transform ceases to be injective, indicating the limitations of this descriptor in higher-dimensional settings.

AI.title_translation: Reeb变换
AI.tldr: 论文提出了Reeb变换并证明了其在三维及以下曲面形状重建中的单射性，但该性质在高维空间中不复存在。
AI.motivation: 为了提供一种能够紧凑表示$n$维空间中形状随不同方向切片变化规律的数学工具，并研究其在形状重建中的唯一性（单射性）。
AI.method: 利用o-minimal可定义集的严格数学框架，研究嵌入在欧几里得空间中的一维分层空间和三维曲面，并通过高度函数分析Reeb图的族。
AI.result: 证明了Reeb变换在多种设置下的单射性，特别是在$\mathbb{R}^3$中的紧致曲面上；然而，在维数大于三时，Reeb变换不再具有单射性。
AI.conclusion: Reeb变换是一种强大的形状描述符，在低维度（如3维及以下）下能够唯一确定形状，但其单射性在高维空间中不成立。
AI.translation: Reeb变换提供了一种紧凑的表示方法，用于展示 $\mathbb{R}^n$ 中的形状在沿不同方向切片时如何变化。我们将Reeb变换定义由单位球面上所有方向的高度函数所诱导的Reeb图族。在本文中，我们对 o-minimal 可定义集发展了严格的 Reeb 变换处理方法，特别强调了嵌入在 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 中的一维分层空间和 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中的曲面。我们在多种设置下（包括 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中的紧致曲面）确立了 Reeb 变换的单射性，捕获了唯一重建此类曲面所需的本质拓扑特征。然而，在三维以上的高维中，Reeb 变换不再是单射的，这表明了该描述符在高维环境中的局限性。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了Reeb变换这一概念，用于紧凑表示形状在不同方向切片时的变化，在严格的数学框架下证明了其在三维及以下空间中的单射性，同时指出其在高维空间中的局限性。
AI.keywords: Reeb变换, Reeb图, 拓扑数据分析, o-minimal结构, 形状重建
AI.comments: 该论文在数学和拓扑数据分析领域做出了重要贡献，将Reeb图的概念推广到了Reeb变换，并严格证明了其在特定维度下的单射性，但在高维情况下失效，具有很高的理论价值。

title: Coverage You Can Steer: Online Conformal Calibration for RL-Driven Hardware-Aware NAS
summary: Hardware-aware neural architecture search (NAS) is dominated by evaluation cost: every architecture must be trained before its reward is known. Conformal-prediction filters cut this cost by pruning candidates whose predicted-reward upper bound misses a threshold, with a distribution-free guarantee that at most a fraction $δ$ are wrongly discarded. That guarantee assumes exchangeability between calibration and test candidates, which the surrounding reinforcement-learning (RL) loop violates: the policy's proposals improve as search proceeds and, in layer-by-layer construction, shift within every episode. We replace one-shot quantile estimation with online feedback control (Adaptive Conformal Inference, with tuning-free, locally-adaptive, and group-conditional variants), restoring steerable coverage: dialing the target delivers it, monotonically and reproducibly, for arbitrary sequences. Across three neural-network architecture families and both single-step and sequential search (three seeds), it tracks every requested level to within ${\sim}10^{-3}$ while pruning 25-50% of evaluations at no measured accuracy cost, whereas static calibration loses control of its coverage and a Gaussian-process baseline stays conservative regardless of the request. Finally, used as an acquisition function on one constrained testbed, the same optimistic bound beats random search, a gain that fixed optimism already carries and online calibration sharpens. The source code is available at https://github.com/Vicomtech/rl-hw-nas.

AI.title_translation: 可控覆盖：RL驱动的硬件感知NAS的在线共形校准
AI.tldr: 通过在线自适应共形推断解决强化学习神经架构搜索中的分布偏移问题，实现精确可控的候选剪枝，大幅降低评估成本。
AI.motivation: 硬件感知神经架构搜索中评估代价高昂，共形预测过滤器可用于剪枝，但其依赖的“校准集与测试集可交换性”假设被周围的强化学习循环所破坏（因为策略不断改进且分布发生漂移），因此需要恢复可控的覆盖率。
AI.method: 用在线反馈控制（自适应共形推断，包含免调优、局部自适应和群组条件变体）替代了一次性分位数估计，以适应强化学习搜索过程中分布变化的特性。
AI.result: 在三个神经网络架构家族和单步/序列搜索中，该方法能将请求的覆盖水平精确追踪到约 $10^{-3}$ 的范围内，同时在不损失准确率的情况下剪枝了 25-50% 的评估，优于静态校准和高斯过程基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过在线反馈控制替换传统的一次性分位数估计，成功恢复了RL驱动的硬件感知NAS中的可控覆盖率保证，在不损失准确率的前提下显著减少了评估次数。
AI.translation: 硬件感知神经架构搜索（NAS）主要受评估成本的支配：每个架构在得知其奖励之前都必须经过训练。共形预测过滤器通过剪枝预测奖励上限未达到阈值的候选者来降低此成本，并具有“最多只有$\delta$比例被错误丢弃”的无分布保证。然而，该保证假设了校准候选者和测试候选者之间的可交换性，而周围的强化学习（RL）循环违反了这一假设：策略的提案随着搜索的进行而改进，并且在逐层构建中，在每个 episode 内发生偏移。我们用在线反馈控制（自适应共形推断，具有免调优、局部自适应和群组条件变体）替代了一次性分位数估计，恢复了可控的覆盖率：调节目标即可单调且可重复地实现任意序列的覆盖率。在三个神经网络架构家族以及单步和序列搜索（三个随机种子）中，它将每个请求的水平追踪到约 $10^{-3}$ 以内，同时剪枝了 25-50% 的评估且没有测得的准确率损失，而静态校准则失去了对其覆盖率的控制，高斯过程基线无论请求如何都保持保守。最后，作为受限测试台上的采集函数，相同的乐观边界击败了随机搜索，这是一个固定乐观性已经具备、在线校准予以尖锐化的增益。源代码可在 https://github.com/Vicomtech/rl-hw-nas 获取。
AI.summary: 论文针对强化学习驱动的硬件感知神经架构搜索中因分布偏移导致共形预测失效的问题，提出了在线反馈控制（自适应共形推断）方法，实现了精确、可控的覆盖率保证，有效减少了搜索过程中的评估成本，且未牺牲模型准确率。
AI.keywords: 神经架构搜索, 共形预测, 在线反馈控制, 强化学习, 硬件感知
AI.comments: 该论文将自适应共形推断（ACI）引入强化学习驱动的硬件感知神经架构搜索（NAS）中，解决了强化学习导致的数据分布非平稳性（非可交换性）问题，实现了可控且分布自由的覆盖率保证，大幅减少了不必要的架构评估代价。具有很高的实用价值和方法论创新性。

title: Trading Strategy Optimization via Textual Gradient
summary: Quantitative trading strategy design aims to discover trading programs from historical data that remain effective in future markets, which can be viewed as a black-box program optimization problem. LLM-based textual gradients offer a promising approach by providing explicit optimization directions for iterative strategy refinement. However, directly applying textual gradients faces two challenges: (1) optimization is myopic, underutilizing experience from previous evaluations; and (2) aggregate backtest feedback overlooks temporal robustness, potentially favoring strategies that perform well only in specific market periods. To address these challenges, we propose TradeGrad, an experience-guided textual-gradient framework for robust trading strategy optimization. TradeGrad leverages accumulated optimization experience to estimate textual gradients and employs multi-scale revisions for both strategy exploration and refinement. It further introduces the Cross-Period Robust Objective (CPRO), which emphasizes performance in unfavorable historical periods to promote temporal robustness. Experiments on cross-sectional and time-series strategy design in Chinese A-share and U.S. equity markets show that TradeGrad achieves the best in-sample and out-of-sample performance across all four settings. Notably, its Chinese cross-sectional strategy achieves 27.99% annualized return, 12.19% maximum drawdown, and a Sharpe ratio of 1.63, approximately 68% higher than the CSI 300 benchmark. Further analyses validate the proposed components and show consistent improvements in both in-sample and out-of-sample performance throughout optimization. The code is available at https://github.com/transcend-0/TradeGrad.

AI.title_translation: 通过文本梯度优化交易策略
AI.tldr: 本文提出了TradeGrad框架，利用经验引导的文本梯度和跨期稳健目标优化量化交易策略，在多个股票市场实验中取得了显著优于基准的表现。
AI.motivation: 直接应用基于LLM的文本梯度进行量化交易策略设计时，存在优化短视（未能充分利用以往评估经验）和忽略时间稳健性（过度拟合特定市场时期）两个主要挑战。
AI.method: 提出了TradeGrad框架，利用积累的优化经验来估计文本梯度，采用多尺度修订进行策略探索与精炼，并引入跨期稳健目标（CPRO）来强调不利历史时期的表现。
AI.result: 在中国A股和美国股票市场的横截面和时间序列策略设计实验中，TradeGrad在所有四种设置下均取得了最佳的样本内和样本外性能。
AI.conclusion: TradeGrad 通过引入经验引导的文本梯度和跨期稳健目标，有效解决了大模型在量化交易优化中面临的短视和时间稳健性差的问题，实验证明了其在不同市场设置下的优越性。
AI.translation: 定量交易策略设计的目的是从历史数据中发现未来市场中依然有效的交易程序，这可以被视为一个黑盒程序优化问题。基于大语言模型的文本梯度通过为迭代策略精炼提供明确的优化方向，提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，直接应用文本梯度面临两个挑战：（1）优化具有短视性，未能充分利用以往评估的经验；（2）聚合的回测反馈忽视了时间稳健性，可能偏爱仅在特定市场时期表现良好的策略。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了TradeGrad，一个用于稳健交易策略优化的经验引导文本梯度框架。TradeGrad利用积累的优化经验来估计文本梯度，并采用多尺度修订来进行策略探索与精炼。它进一步引入了跨期稳健目标（CPRO），该目标强调在不利历史时期的表现以促进时间稳健性。在中国A股和美国股票市场的横截面和时间序列策略设计上的实验表明，TradeGrad在所有四种设置下都取得了最佳的样本内和样本外性能。值得注意的是，其中国横截面策略实现了27.99%的年化收益率、12.19%的最大回撤以及1.63的夏普比率，大约比沪深300基准高出68%。进一步的分析验证了所提出的组件，并显示出在整个优化过程中样本内和样本外性能的一致提升。代码已发布在 https://github.com/transcend-0/TradeGrad。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TradeGrad，一个用于稳健量化交易策略优化的经验引导文本梯度框架。通过结合历史优化经验估计梯度、多尺度修订机制以及跨期稳健目标（CPRO），该方法克服了传统LLM文本梯度优化的短视性和缺乏时间稳健性的问题，并在多个市场中展现出优异的实盘与回测表现。
AI.keywords: Quantitative Trading, Textual Gradient, Large Language Models, Strategy Optimization, Temporal Robustness
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型的文本梯度方法引入量化交易策略优化中，并针对金融时序数据的特点提出了经验引导与跨期稳健目标（CPRO），显著提升了策略的泛化能力和样本外表现。

title: Benchmarking Literature Retrieval for a Model Organism: A Dictyostelium Case Study
comments: 15 pages, 5 figures. Submitted version (before peer review) of a paper accepted at Discovery Science 2026 (DS 2026); to appear in the Springer proceedings. Code and data: https://github.com/fulaibaowang/dictycite ; dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20308282
summary: Biological literature retrieval systems are often developed and evaluated using broad biomedical corpora and general-purpose search tasks. However, many curated knowledge bases operate in narrower model-organism domains, where the literature is sparse and terminology is organism-specific. We introduce a retrieval benchmark from dictyBase for Dictyostelium, a model organism in cell and developmental biology. The benchmark consists of curator-generated biological queries linked to PubMed-indexed articles, together with structured gene annotations. Using this benchmark, we study three factors in niche biological retrieval: cross-encoder reranking, gene-aware query expansion, and abstract-only versus full-text retrieval. We report that reranking and gene-aware query expansion improve retrieval selectively: reranking is most useful when the model is well suited to biological evidence matching, whereas curated annotations help clarify compact biological queries by reducing vocabulary mismatch. Full-text chunks substantially improve retrieval when abstracts omit supporting evidence, increasing both candidate recall and top-rank performance, although these cases are harder than queries supported by abstracts. Data and code are publicly available at https://github.com/fulaibaowang/dictycite, and the benchmark dataset is additionally archived on Zenodo.
comment: 15 pages, 5 figures. Submitted version (before peer review) of a paper accepted at Discovery Science 2026 (DS 2026); to appear in the Springer proceedings. Code and data: https://github.com/fulaibaowang/dictycite ; dataset: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20308282

AI.title_translation: 模型生物的文献检索基准测试：以网柄细胞（Dictyostelium）为例
AI.tldr: 本文针对网柄细胞（Dictyostelium）这一模式生物建立了一个文献检索基准，研究并证实了重排序、基因感知查询扩展以及全文检索在提升特定生物学领域文献检索性能方面的作用。
AI.motivation: 现有的生物医学文献检索系统通常使用广泛的生物医学语料库和通用搜索任务进行评估，但在文献稀疏且术语具有生物特异性的狭窄模式生物领域表现不足，因此需要建立专门的检索基准来研究 niche 生物学检索的关键影响因素。
AI.method: 引入了来自 dictyBase 的基准测试集（包含策展人生成的生物学查询、PubMed索引文章及结构化基因注释），并研究了交叉编码器重排序、基因感知查询扩展以及摘要与全文检索三种因素在 niche 生物学检索中的影响。
AI.result: 研究发现，重排序和基因感知查询扩展能选择性地提升检索性能：当模型适应生物学证据匹配时重排序最有用，而策划的注释通过减少词汇不匹配有助于澄清紧凑的生物学查询；当摘要遗漏支持证据时，全文检索能显著提升候选召回率和前排性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入针对 Dictyostelium 的专门文献检索基准，本研究表明重排序、基因感知查询扩展和全文检索在特定情况下能显著提升狭窄生物学领域的检索性能，为未来的垂直领域检索系统设计指明了方向。
AI.translation: 生物学文献检索系统通常使用广泛的生物医学语料库和通用搜索任务来开发和评估。然而，许多策展知识库在较窄的模式生物领域运作，这些领域的文献稀疏且术语具有生物特异性。我们引入了来自 dictyBase 的 Dictyostelium（细胞和发育生物学中的一个模式生物）检索基准。该基准由策展人生成的、与 PubMed 索引文章相连的生物学查询以及结构化的基因注释组成。使用该基准，我们研究了生态位生物学检索中的三个因素：交叉编码器重排序、基因感知查询扩展以及仅摘要与全文检索。我们报告称，重排序和基因感知查询扩展有选择地改善了检索：当模型非常适合生物学证据匹配时，重排序最有用，而策划的注释通过减少词汇不匹配有助于澄清紧凑的生物学查询。当摘要省略支持证据时，全文块大大改善了检索，增加了候选召回率和顶级性能，尽管这些情况比由摘要支持的查询更难。数据和代码可在 https://github.com/fulaibaowang/dictycite 公开获取，基准数据集还在 Zenodo 上进行了归档。
AI.summary: 该论文针对模式生物（细胞与发育生物学中的粘菌 Dictyostelium）建立了一个文献检索基准，利用 dictyBase 的策展查询和基因注释数据，评估了交叉编码器重排序、基因感知查询扩展以及全文检索对 niche 生物学文献检索的影响，并揭示了它们各自的优势与适用场景。
AI.keywords: 文献检索, 模式生物, 细胞生物学, 基因注释, 基准测试
AI.comments: 该论文针对模式生物文献检索这一特定且常被忽视的领域，建立了一个高质量的基准数据集（dictyBase），并深入探讨了交叉编码器重排序、基因感知查询扩展以及全文检索与摘要检索的区别。这为生物医学文献检索系统的定制化开发和评估提供了有价值的参考和标准测试平台。

title: Safe Streaming Flow Planning by Aligning Sampling Dynamics with Execution Dynamics
comments: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). Project page: https://jang-seunghwan.github.io/SafeStreamingFlowPlanning/
summary: Generative planners based on diffusion/flow matching can learn to synthesize long-horizon trajectories from demonstrations. However, real-world deployment requires (i) enforcing safety constraints during execution and (ii) tight online replanning at fast execution rates. Prior safe diffusion/flow planners generate the agent's full trajectory at once, while repeatedly perturbing intermediate states to satisfy safety constraints. This approach is not only computationally intensive, but also introduces distribution shift since the learned sampling dynamics is distinct from the system's execution dynamics. We propose SafeStreamingFlow, a goal-conditioned planner that aligns flow sampling dynamics with execution dynamics by sequentially integrating a learned state vector field with hierarchical state prediction. Importantly, we need to enforce safety constraints only for the executed step via high order control barrier functions. Across navigation, racing, and locomotion benchmarks, SafeStreamingFlow reduces planning latency and improves safety compared to existing methods, while maintaining competitive goal-reaching success.
comment: Accepted to the 10th Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL 2026). Project page: https://jang-seunghwan.github.io/SafeStreamingFlowPlanning/

AI.title_translation: 通过对齐采样动态与执行动态的安全流规划
AI.tldr: SafeStreamingFlow 通过对齐采样与执行动态，解决了传统扩散/流规划器计算开销大和存在分布偏移的问题，实现了低延迟、高安全性的实时轨迹规划。
AI.motivation: 现有的安全扩散/流规划器一次性生成智能体的完整轨迹并在中间状态反复扰动以满足安全约束，这种方法计算强度高，且由于学习到的采样动态与系统执行动态不同而引入了分布偏移。
AI.method: 提出 SafeStreamingFlow，这是一种目标条件规划器，通过分层状态预测依次整合学习到的状态向量场，从而对齐流采样动态与执行动态，并仅对执行步骤通过高阶控制障函数强制执行安全约束。
AI.result: 在导航、赛车和运动学基准测试中，SafeStreamingFlow 相比现有方法降低了规划延迟并提高了安全性，同时保持了具有竞争力的目标达成成功率。
AI.conclusion: SafeStreamingFlow 成功对齐了采样动态与执行动态，在降低规划延迟和提高安全性的同时，保持了极具竞争力的目标到达成功率。
AI.translation: 基于扩散/流匹配的生成式规划器可以学习从示范中合成长视距轨迹。然而，真实世界的部署需要（i）在执行期间强制执行安全约束，以及（ii）以快速执行速率进行紧凑的在线重新规划。先前的安全扩散/流规划器一次性生成智能体的完整轨迹，同时重复扰动中间状态以满足安全约束。这种方法不仅计算密集，而且由于学习到的采样动态与系统的执行动态不同，引入了分布偏移。我们提出了 SafeStreamingFlow，这是一种目标条件规划器，通过依次整合学习到的状态向量场与分层状态预测，将流采样动态与执行动态对齐。重要的是，我们只需要通过高阶控制障函数对执行步骤强制执行安全约束。在导航、赛车和运动 locomotion 基准测试中，与现有方法相比，SafeStreamingFlow 降低了规划延迟并提高了安全性，同时保持了有竞争力的目标到达成功率。
AI.summary: 论文提出了 SafeStreamingFlow，这是一种用于长视距轨迹生成的目标条件规划器，它通过结合学习到的状态向量场与分层状态预测，对齐了流采样动态与执行动态，仅在执行步骤应用高阶控制障函数以确保安全性，从而在多个基准测试中降低了延迟并提升了安全性。
AI.keywords: 安全流规划, 扩散模型, 控制障函数, 流匹配, 轨迹生成
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的安全流规划方法，核心创新在于对齐采样动态与执行动态，从而在减少计算延迟的同时保证了实时安全约束，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Page-EntroKV: Hardware-Aligned, Entropy-Weighted KV-Cache Eviction under Grouped-Query Attention
comments: 24 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Formal framework with pilot-scale empirical validation on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Includes step-by-step derivations (Appendix C) and PyTorch reference implementation (Appendix D). Code and data available at: https://github.com/bruce12-glitch/PageEntro-KV
summary: Serving long-context autoregressive language models is constrained by the key-value (KV) cache. Most dynamic eviction methods score token importance per query head and choose tokens independently. This fits poorly with grouped-query attention (GQA), where several query heads share one physical KV buffer: divergent per-head selections force the serving engine to retain the union of their choices - inflating the cache by up to the group ratio r - while arithmetic mean pooling dilutes the specialized retrieval heads that carry factual recall. We introduce Page-EntroKV, a formal framework for KV-cache eviction operating at the granularity GQA serving actually allocates. Heads within each physical group are pooled by weights derived from sink-isolated collision (Renyi-2) entropy - one inner product per head, computed once at prefill with no calibration - so sink heads cannot masquerade as retrieval heads. Pooled scores are projected onto PagedAttention page frames, and eviction executes at the hardware tuple (layer, group, page). We formalize the union overhead ratio (UOR) and intra-group disagreement, prove an exact identity linking them for two-head groups alongside two-sided bounds at every group ratio, prove strict budget preservation and a finite-context needle-retention bound that arithmetic mean pooling provably violates, and give exact per-layer page accounting. On a pilot architecture (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct, r=6), head-independent replay over 2,240 group measurements yields union overhead up to 4.75x at a 2% budget, while Page-EntroKV holds UOR exactly 1.000; sink isolation removes a 13x sink masquerade; needle recall is 100% versus 0% for mean pooling at a 20% budget; retained cardinality is exact for every page size; and QA and code tasks remain solvable at 20% retention.
comment: 24 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables. Formal framework with pilot-scale empirical validation on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct. Includes step-by-step derivations (Appendix C) and PyTorch reference implementation (Appendix D). Code and data available at: https://github.com/bruce12-glitch/PageEntro-KV

AI.title_translation: Page-EntroKV：群组查询注意力下硬件对齐、熵加权的 KV 缓存淘汰机制
AI.tldr: Page-EntroKV 解决了长文本大语言模型中 GQA 机制下的 KV 缓存膨胀和检索头稀释问题，实现了硬件对齐的精确 KV 缓存淘汰。
AI.motivation: 现有的动态 KV 缓存淘汰方法大多按查询头独立对 Token 重要性进行评分，这与分组查询注意力（GQA）机制不匹配。不匹配会导致：1. 差异化的按头选择迫使服务引擎保留其选择的并集，导致缓存膨胀；2. 算术平均池化会稀释承载事实召回的专业检索头。
AI.method: 引入 Page-EntroKV 框架，利用由汇聚隔离的 collision (Renyi-2) 熵导出的权重对组内头进行加权池化，并将池化后的分数投影到 PagedAttention 页帧上，在硬件元组（层、组、页）粒度执行淘汰。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct（r=6）架构上的实验表明：Page-EntroKV 的联合开销比（UOR）精确保持在 1.000（而独立回放高达 4.75x）；消除了 13 倍的汇聚伪装；在 20% 预算下针式召回率达到 100%（平均池化为 0%）；且 QA 和代码任务在 20% 保留率下依然可解。
AI.conclusion: Page-EntroKV 框架在保持高任务准确率的同时，有效消除了 GQA 中的联合开销，确保了硬件对齐的精确 KV 缓存淘汰。
AI.translation: 服务长上下文自回归语言模型受到键值（KV）缓存的限制。大多数动态淘汰方法按查询头对 Token 重要性进行评分并独立选择 Token，这与分组查询注意力（GQA）配合较差，在 GQA 中几个查询头共享一个物理 KV 缓冲区：不同头之间的选择差异迫使服务引擎保留其选择的并集——将缓存膨胀高达组比率 r——而算术平均池化则稀释了携带事实召回的专门检索头。我们推出了 Page-EntroKV，这是一个以 GQA 服务实际分配的粒度运行的 KV 缓存淘汰的正式框架。每个物理组内的头通过源自汇聚隔离的碰撞（Renyi-2）熵导出的权重进行池化——每个头一个内积，在预填充时计算一次且无需校准——因此汇聚头无法伪装成检索头。池化的分数被投影到 PagedAttention 页帧上，并在硬件元组（层、组、页）上执行淘汰。我们形式化了并集开销比（UOR）和组内分歧，证明了将它们与两头组在每个组比率下的双侧边界联系起来的精确恒定关系，证明了算术平均池化必然违反的严格预算保持和有限上下文针检索边界，并给出了精确的每层页面记账。在一个试验架构（Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct，r=6）上，跨 2240 个组测量的头独立回放产生高达 4.75 倍的并集开销（在 2% 预算下），而 Page-EntroKV 将 UOR 保持在精确的 1.000；汇聚隔离消除了 13 倍的汇聚伪装；针检索召回率为 100%，而在 20% 预算下平均池化为 0%；保留的基数对每个页面大小都是精确的；并且 QA 和代码任务在 20% 保留率下依然可解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Page-EntroKV，这是一种针对分组查询注意力（GQA）机制的硬件对齐、熵加权的 KV 缓存淘汰框架。通过基于 Rényi-2 熵的权重池化与 PagedAttention 页帧投影，该方法解决了传统方法带来的缓存联合开销膨胀和检索头稀释问题，在理论和实验上均证明了其优越性。
AI.keywords: KV-Cache Eviction, Grouped-Query Attention (GQA), Entropy-Weighted, PagedAttention, Long-Context Language Models
AI.comments: Page-EntroKV 创新性地针对分组查询注意力（GQA）机制设计了硬件对齐的 KV 缓存淘汰策略，通过引入基于 Rényi-2 熵的加权池化与 PagedAttention 页帧对齐，完美解决了传统独立头选择导致的联合开销膨胀和算术平均池化导致的检索头稀释问题，理论严密且实验效果显著。

title: Investigating the Role of Reasoning-Language Alignment in Monolingual Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comments: Accepted to the Workshop on Open Reasoning Across Cultures & Languages at EMNLP 2026
summary: Reasoning traces improve large language models (LLMs), but current models are trained to reason mostly in English. It has been shown that forcing a model to reason in another language degrades accuracy, even when the reasoning language matches the language of the prompt -- but only for a setting where the model reasons over a short prompt. Here, we ask whether the same holds for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), where the model must read and integrate a large amount of retrieved evidence in the target language. To study this, we build a fully monolingual German RAG question-answering testbed over the fictional world of the tabletop role-playing game The Dark Eye, a domain that is richly documented in German but too niche for the model to answer from memory, so that it has to rely on retrieval. Varying the forced reasoning language of an agentic RAG system on this testbed, we find that aligning the reasoning language with the language of the query and the retrieved documents helps. Forced German reasoning outperforms forced French, although the model benchmarks higher in French, so the benefit comes from alignment and not from language proficiency. The advantage grows when the retrieved context is richer and structure-aware. However, forced German only reaches the level of the model's native, unconstrained English reasoning without surpassing it, showing that native multilingual reasoning is needed. We publicly release the testbed and QA benchmark.
comment: Accepted to the Workshop on Open Reasoning Across Cultures & Languages at EMNLP 2026

AI.title_translation: 研究单语检索增强生成中推理-语言对齐的作用
AI.tldr: 本文研究了RAG系统中推理语言与目标语言对齐的影响，发现对齐能提升性能，但仍需进一步提升原生多语言推理能力。
AI.motivation: 虽然推理轨迹能提升大模型性能，但当前模型主要基于英语训练，强制在其他语言中推理会降低准确率。论文旨在研究在检索增强生成（RAG）场景中，模型必须阅读和整合大量目标语言检索证据时，推理语言与语言环境的对齐是否同样重要。
AI.method: 构建了一个完全单语的德语RAG问答测试平台（基于《The Dark Eye》），通过强制设定智能体RAG系统的推理语言，并改变检索上下文的丰富度和结构感知能力，来评估推理语言与查询及检索文档语言对齐的效果。
AI.result: 研究发现，将推理语言与查询和检索文档的语言进行对齐（如强制德语推理优于强制法语推理）能够带来性能提升，且该优势随检索上下文的丰富和结构化而增加；然而，强制德语推理仅能达到模型原生未约束英语推理的水平，并未超越它。
AI.conclusion: 推理语言与目标语言的对齐能提升RAG系统的性能，但强制使用非英语进行推理并未超过模型原生英语推理的水平，这表明大模型亟需更强大的原生多语言推理能力。
AI.translation: 推理轨迹能够提升大语言模型（LLMs）的性能，但当前模型的训练使其主要使用英语进行推理。已有研究表明，强制模型使用另一种语言进行推理会降低准确率，即使推理语言与提示词语言相匹配也是如此——不过这仅限于短提示词的场景。在此，我们探讨在检索增强生成（RAG）中是否也是如此，在RAG中模型必须阅读并整合大量目标语言的检索证据。为了研究这一点，我们构建了一个完全单语的德语RAG问答测试平台，该平台基于桌上角色扮演游戏《The Dark Eye》的虚构世界，该领域在德语中有丰富文档记载，但对模型而言过于冷门而无法仅凭记忆回答，因此必须依赖检索。通过在该测试平台上改变代理式RAG系统的强制推理语言，我们发现将推理语言与查询及检索文档的语言进行对齐是有帮助的。强制德语推理的表现优于强制法语推理，尽管该模型在法语上的基准测试表现更高，因此这种优势来自于对齐而非语言熟练度。当检索到的上下文更丰富且具有结构感知时，这一优势会进一步扩大。然而，强制德语推理仅能达到模型原生、无约束的英语推理水平而无法超越它，这表明亟需原生多语言推理能力。我们公开了该测试平台和QA基准。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了单语检索增强生成（RAG）中推理与语言对齐的作用。通过构建德语RAG问答测试平台，研究发现将模型的推理语言与查询及检索文档语言进行对齐可以提升RAG性能，但仍无法超越模型原生的英语推理能力，凸显了原生多语言推理的必要性。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 语言对齐, 推理轨迹, 多语言模型, 问答测试平台
AI.comments: 本文针对RAG系统中的推理与语言对齐问题进行了深入研究，创新性地构建了德语完全单语的RAG问答测试平台。研究结果对跨语言RAG系统的优化具有重要的指导意义，指出了原生多语言推理能力在未来大模型发展中的必要性。

title: Keeping JEPA World Models Plannable When Little of the Frame Moves
summary: Specifying a goal in language rather than as a goal frame is a natural interface for planning with a latent world model, but testing it needs scenes in which language must discriminate between several objects. We build SLIM, a pushing benchmark with several small objects and paired visual and language goals on identical scenes. On SLIM a LeWM world model that solves PushT succeeds on under 1% of trials, although a scripted controller with simulator state solves every tier. Probes locate the failure in the encoder: its latent is nearly action-insensitive, neither pusher nor object positions can be decoded from it, and rollouts are no better than copying the current latent forward. One inverse-dynamics auxiliary loss, applied to encoder latents and to predicted latents through a shared head discarded at test time, restores every probe and raises success from 0.003 to 0.35 (0.16 on the hard pushing tier, where a goal-agnostic policy scores zero), and improves PushT at twice the trained horizon. Controls attribute the repair to the gradient into the encoder, and a response sweep shows that the vanilla model plans once enough of the frame responds to actions. A cheap action-sensitivity probe, computable without environment access, acts as an empirical necessary condition: all configurations below its threshold failed to plan. On the repaired latent, a small language-goal head plans from sentences without retraining the world model: it reaches 0.84 on navigation (visual-goal oracle 1.00), follows the named zone when it is swapped with a decoy, and degrades gracefully to unseen nouns. A single goal sentence rarely completes a push, but given the push as a sequence of stage sentences the head raises success on the medium and hard pushing tiers from 0.04 to 0.25, on par with the goal-frame oracle, also when the switch between stages is read from the latent alone.

AI.title_translation: 当帧变化较小时保持JEPA世界模型的可规划性
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入逆动力学辅助损失，解决了JEPA世界模型在低动态场景下失效的问题，使其能够基于语言指令进行有效规划。
AI.motivation: 当场景中大部分画面静止时，现有的基于JEPA的世界模型（如LeWM）在进行规划时会失效，无法有效区分动作并提取状态，因此需要解决如何保持世界模型在低帧位移场景下的可规划性问题。
AI.method: 引入了一种逆动力学辅助损失（applied to encoder latents and predicted latents through a shared head discarded at test time），并通过动作敏感度探针进行经验验证。
AI.result: 修复后的潜在空间恢复了动作敏感度，成功率从0.003提升至0.35；在语言目标规划任务中，无需重新训练世界模型即可达到很好的效果，并在多阶段推动任务中与目标帧神谕（oracle）表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入逆动力学辅助损失，成功解决了JEPA世界模型在小位移场景下的动作不敏感问题，使其能够实现基于语言指令的高效规划。
AI.translation: 使用语言而不是目标帧来指定目标，是利用潜在世界模型进行规划的一种自然接口，但对其进行测试需要场景中的语言能够区分多个对象。我们构建了SLIM，一个包含多个小对象以及在相同场景下成对的视觉和语言目标的推动基准测试。在SLIM上，一个能够解决PushT的LeWM世界模型在不到1%的试验中成功，尽管具有模拟器状态的脚本控制器可以解决每一个级别。探针发现故障在于编码器：其潜在表示几乎对动作不敏感，无法从中解码出推动器或物体的位置，并且展开效果不比将当前的潜在表示直接复制向前好。一个逆动力学辅助损失（应用于编码器潜在表示以及通过在测试时丢弃的共享头预测的潜在表示）恢复了每一个探针，并将成功率从0.003提高到0.35（在困难的推动级别上为0.16，其中目标无关策略得分为零），并在两倍于训练视界的情况下改进了PushT。控制实验将修复归因于传入编码器的梯度，响应扫描显示当足够多的帧对动作做出反应时，普通模型即可进行规划。一个无需环境访问即可计算的廉价动作敏感度探针作为一个经验必要条件：所有低于其阈值的配置都无法进行规划。在修复后的潜在空间上，一个小型的语言目标头可以在不重新训练世界模型的情况下根据句子进行规划：在导航上达到了0.84（视觉目标神谕为1.00），当命名区域与诱饵对调时能够跟随，并且对未见过的名词表现出优雅的退化。单一的目标句子很少能完成一次推动，但给定作为一系列阶段句子的推动，该头将中等和困难推动级别的成功率从0.04提高到0.25，与目标帧神谕相当，并且在仅从潜在表示读取阶段切换时也是如此。
AI.summary: 本文针对JEPA世界模型在场景变化较小时规划能力失效的问题，通过引入逆动力学辅助损失修复了编码器的动作不敏感缺陷，大幅提升了模型在密集物体推动和语言目标规划任务中的成功率。
AI.keywords: JEPA, 世界模型, 规划, 动作敏感度, 语言目标
AI.comments: 该论文针对JEPA世界模型在低动作动态场景下失效的问题，提出了基于逆动力学辅助损失的解决方案，显著提升了模型的可规划性，并在语言指导规划任务上取得了优异表现。其发现的动作敏感度作为必要条件的结论具有较强的理论和实践意义。

title: Tracking State Footprints: How Agents Can Transact
summary: Can AI agents transact? We argue that they must: as multi-agent systems (MASs) increasingly write code, deploy infrastructure, modify databases, and call web services, lost updates or stale reads can be catastrophic. Although MASs increasingly execute plans in parallel, current orchestrators do not track the state that agents read and write. As a result, concurrency anomalies manifest even in simple coding tasks. We frame MAS coordination as a data management problem and propose to describe agents by their state footprint: the state they read and write across their own local context and state, as well as the state of the orchestrator and external systems. We posit that MASs require guarantees similar to those of databases, but providing them raises new challenges and opportunities: unlike database transactions, agents do not read from a fixed schema or an isolated snapshot, and cannot be replayed deterministically upon failure. They can, however, resolve conflicts semantically instead of aborting, enabling new forms of concurrency control and conflict resolution. Towards agents that can transact, we outline a vision for next-generation agent orchestrators and transactional interfaces for external systems to participate in agentic transactions.

AI.title_translation: 追踪状态足迹：智能体如何进行事务处理
AI.tldr: 本文提出将数据库事务思想引入多智能体系统，通过追踪智能体的“状态足迹”并进行语义冲突解决，解决多智能体并行执行时的并发异常问题。
AI.motivation: 随着多智能体系统（MASs）并行执行复杂的任务（如编写代码、部署基础设施、调用网络服务），缺乏状态读写追踪会导致丢失更新或陈旧读取等严重并发异常，因此AI智能体迫切需要类似于数据库的事务保障。
AI.method: 将多智能体系统的协调建模为数据管理问题，通过追踪智能体的“状态足迹”（即它们在其本地上下文、编排器及外部系统中读写的内容），并利用语义冲突解决而非简单的中止来实现并发控制。
AI.result: 文章指出了提供智能体事务保障的新挑战与机遇（如智能体无法从固定模式读取、无法确定性重放，但能语义解决冲突），并勾勒出了下一代智能体编排器和外部系统事务接口的愿景。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出了一种将数据库事务概念引入多智能体系统（MAS）的方法，通过状态足迹追踪和语义冲突解决，为下一代智能体编排器奠定了基础。
AI.translation: AI智能体能进行事务处理吗？我们认为它们必须如此：随着多智能体系统（MASs）越来越多地编写代码、部署基础设施、修改数据库和调用网络服务，丢失的更新或陈旧的读取可能会带来灾难性的后果。尽管多智能体系统越来越多地并行执行计划，但当前的编排器并不追踪智能体读取和写入的状态。因此，即使在简单的编码任务中也会出现并发异常。我们将多智能体系统的协调建模为一个数据管理问题，并建议通过它们的“状态足迹”来描述智能体：即它们在其本地上下文和状态、以及编排器和外部系统的状态中读取和写入的状态。我们认为多智能体系统需要类似于数据库的保障，但这带来了新的挑战与机遇：与数据库事务不同，智能体不是从固定模式或隔离快照中读取，且在失败时无法确定性地重新执行。然而，它们可以通过语义方式解决冲突而不是中止，从而实现新形式的并发控制和冲突解决。为了实现能够进行事务处理的智能体，我们勾勒了下一代智能体编排器的愿景，以及允许外部系统参与智能体事务的事务接口。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了AI智能体进行安全交易的需求，指出当前多智能体编排器缺乏对状态读写的追踪，导致并发异常。作者将多智能体协调建模为数据管理问题，提出了“状态足迹”的概念，并探讨了如何借鉴和调整数据库事务保障机制，利用语义冲突解决来实现下一代智能体编排器。
AI.keywords: AI agents, multi-agent systems, concurrency control, state footprint, transactions
AI.comments: 本文将AI多智能体系统的协调建模为数据管理问题，创新性地提出了“状态足迹（State Footprint）”的概念，将数据库事务的思想引入多智能体领域，并指出了智能体事务与传统数据库事务的异同及语义冲突解决的潜力，为下一代智能体编排器指明了方向。

title: Behavior Pack Optimization for Video MLLM Post-Training
summary: Video multimodal large language models (MLLMs) keep climbing video question answering benchmarks, yet shuffling the frames, masking the segment that supports the answer, or occluding the target object barely changes their predictions. The accuracy rests on appearance and language priors, not on the temporal evidence the question asks for. We trace this to the unit of post-training: rewards are computed on a single response to the original clip, so the model is never asked to behave consistently across views. We propose Behavior Pack Optimization (BPO), which replaces the single response with a behavior pack of outputs across counterfactual views chosen by question type, scored jointly. The pack reward asks for stability when the intervention is irrelevant, sensitivity when key evidence is removed, and abstention when no evidence remains. To keep this objective stable at small pack sizes, BPO uses an anchor-relative advantage: the response on the original view serves as a per-prompt reference instead of a group mean over mixed views. On TempCompass, MVBench, and NExT-QA, BPO improves the macro accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct by 4.7 pp, the temporal-hard subset by 7.8 pp, and abstention F1 by 20.0 pp over a budget-matched vanilla GRPO baseline from the same SFT checkpoint. The gains transfer to Video-MME, LongVideoBench, and to LLaVA-Video-7B; ablations confirm they follow the view sets, not the rollout count. We hope this pack-level perspective offers a useful starting point for the video MLLM and multimodal post-training community as the field moves toward evidence-grounded video reasoning.

AI.title_translation: 面向视频多模态大模型后训练的行为包优化
AI.tldr: 提出行为包优化（BPO）方法，通过在反事实视角下对模型输出进行联合评分和锚点相对优势训练，解决了视频多模态大模型依赖先验而非时序证据的问题，显著提升了时序推理与拒答能力。
AI.motivation: 当前的视频多模态大模型（MLLMs）在视频问答基准上表现优异，但对帧顺序打乱、关键片段遮挡等干扰不敏感，其准确性依赖于外观和语言先验而非真正的时序证据。根本原因在于后训练的单元是针对原始片段的单一响应，模型从未被要求跨视角保持行为一致性。
AI.method: 提出行为包优化（BPO），用跨越根据问题类型选择的反事实视角的输出行为包代替单一响应并进行联合评分；引入锚点相对优势（anchor-relative advantage）以在小包大小时保持目标稳定。
AI.result: 在TempCompass、MVBench和NExT-QA上，BPO使Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的宏平均准确率提升了4.7个百分点，时序困难子集提升了7.8个百分点，拒答F1分数提升了20.0个百分点，并且增益可泛化至其他模型和基准。
AI.conclusion: 行为包优化（BPO）通过引入反事实视角的联合奖励和锚点相对优势，有效解决了视频MLLM依赖先验而非时序证据的问题，在多个基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 视频多模态大模型（MLLMs）在视频问答基准测试中的表现不断攀升，然而，打乱帧顺序、掩盖支持答案的片段或遮挡目标物体几乎不会改变它们的预测结果。其准确率依赖于外观和语言先验，而非问题所要求的时序证据。我们将此归因于后训练的单元：奖励是对原始片段的单一响应计算的，因此模型从未被要求在不同视角下保持行为一致性。我们提出了行为包优化（BPO），它用根据问题类型选择的反事实视角下的输出行为包代替了单一响应，并进行联合评分。包奖励要求在干预无关时保持稳定性，在移除关键证据时保持敏感性，在没有剩余证据时进行拒答。为了在小包大小时保持该目标的稳定，BPO使用了一种锚点相对优势：原始视角下的响应作为每个提示的参考，而不是混合视角的组平均值。在TempCompass、MVBench和NExT-QA上，与来自同一SFT检查点的预算匹配的普通GRPO基线相比，BPO将Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct的宏平均准确率提高了4.7个百分点，时序困难子集提高了7.8个百分点，拒答F1提高了20.0个百分点。这些收益可转移到Video-MME、LongVideoBench以及LLaVA-Video-7B中；消融实验证实这些收益源于视角集，而非采样次数。我们希望这种包级别的视角能为视频MLLM和多模态后训练社区提供一个有用的起点，推动该领域向基于证据的视频推理发展。
AI.summary: 论文针对视频多模态大模型过度依赖外观和语言先验、缺乏真实时序推理能力的缺陷，提出了行为包优化（BPO）方法。通过对反事实视角的多个输出进行联合奖励打分，并采用锚点相对优势来确保训练稳定，BPO显着提高了模型在多个视频问答基准上的时序理解和拒答能力。
AI.keywords: Video MLLM, Post-Training, Behavior Pack Optimization, Temporal Reasoning, Counterfactual Views
AI.comments: 该论文针对视频多模态大模型依赖外观和语言先验而非真正时序理解的缺陷，创新性地提出行为包优化（BPO）方法，通过反事实视角下的联合评分机制，显著提升了模型对时序证据的敏感性与鲁棒性，具有重要的应用价值。

title: CalCErt: Bin-wise Certification of Confidence Calibration in Medical Image Classification
summary: Deep neural networks remain vulnerable to adversarial perturbations, which can distort not only predictions but also confidence scores, undermining uncertainty calibration. While existing certification methods focus on preserving the predicted category, providing guarantees on how calibration behaves under adversarial attacks remains overlooked. In this work, we introduce CalCErt, a simple and efficient post-hoc strategy that certifies bin-wise confidence calibration for any pretrained differentiable classifier. Our approach combines empirical calibration estimates, statistical concentration bounds, and local Lipschitz estimates of the confidence function to derive data-dependent upper bounds on worst-case miscalibration within an $ell_2$-ball of radius R. We evaluate CalCErt across 11 medical image classification tasks and multiple adversarial perturbations, demonstrating substantially higher certified coverage than baseline strategies while maintaining competitive tightness. Our code is available at https://github.com/leofillioux/calcert.

AI.title_translation: CalCErt：医学图像分类中置信度校准的分箱认证
AI.tldr: 本文提出了CalCErt，首个用于在对抗攻击下认证医学图像分类置信度校准的高效后处理方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的认证方法主要关注保持预测类别，但在对抗攻击下置信度校准的行为保证在很大程度上被忽视了，而深度神经网络容易受到对抗扰动的影响，这会扭曲预测及置信度分数并破坏不确定性校准。
AI.method: 提出CalCErt策略，结合经验校准估计、统计集中界以及置信度函数的局部Lipschitz估计，推导出在半径为R的$l_2$球内最坏情况校准偏差的数据依赖型上界。
AI.result: 在11个医疗图像分类任务和多种对抗扰动上进行评估，结果表明CalCErt相比基线策略展现出显著更高的认证覆盖率，同时保持了具有竞争力的紧密性。
AI.conclusion: CalCErt作为一种高效的后处理策略，成功实现了对抗攻击下医疗图像分类置信度校准的区间证明，优于现有基线策略。
AI.translation: 深度神经网络仍然容易受到对抗扰动的影响，这不仅会扭曲预测结果，还会扭曲置信度分数，从而破坏不确定性校准。虽然现有的认证方法侧重于保持预测类别，但提供关于校准在对抗攻击下如何表现的保证仍然被忽视。在这项工作中，我们介绍了CalCErt，这是一种简单且高效的后处理策略，可以为任何预训练的可微分类器认证分箱置信度校准。我们的方法结合了经验校准估计、统计集中界和置信度函数的局部Lipschitz估计，以推导出半径为R的$l_2$球内最坏情况校准偏差的数据依赖型上界。我们在11个医学图像分类任务和多种对抗扰动上评估了CalCErt，证明了它比基线策略具有显著更高的认证覆盖率，同时保持了有竞争力的紧密性。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/leofillioux/calcert 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了CalCErt，一种针对预训练可微分类器的简单高效的后处理策略，用于认证医学图像分类中的分箱置信度校准，并在对抗攻击下提供最坏情况下的校准上界。
AI.keywords: 置信度校准, 对抗鲁棒性, 医疗图像分类, 认证方法, 局部Lipschitz估计
AI.comments: 该论文首次关注并解决了对抗攻击下医疗图像分类中置信度校准的认证问题，提出的CalCErt方法结合了经验校准估计、统计集中边界和局部Lipschitz估计，具有较高的创新性和实际应用价值。

title: A Physics-Driven Multiscale Method for High-Frequency Helmholtz Equations
summary: We develop and analyze a physics-driven multiscale method for model reduction of the Helmholtz equation at high frequency. The method constructs a reduced approximation space from local wave responses within a mixed finite element formulation with velocity elimination. These responses are computed by solving Helmholtz problems with boundary excitations on oversampled regions, giving snapshots that incorporate the oscillatory behavior and propagation characteristics of the underlying medium. Local generalized eigenvalue problems then select modes from this physically informed space to form a reduced global system with sparse interelement coupling. To establish stability and convergence of this reduction, we relate the local spectral approximation to approximation of the global adjoint problem. Starting from an inf--sup estimate for the fine-grid formulation, this argument yields a multiscale inf--sup condition governed by fine-grid resolution, oversampling, and the first omitted local eigenvalues. The resulting stability establishes well-posedness and quasi-optimality of the multiscale approximation in a discrete energy norm. Together with local spectral estimates, it gives an a priori error bound that explicitly quantifies the roles of the coarse and fine mesh sizes, oversampling depth, spectral truncation, and wavenumber. This analysis provides a quantitative link between local space reduction and the stability and accuracy of the global approximation. Numerical experiments in two and three dimensions demonstrate accurate wavefield approximation with substantial reductions in global dimension and solution cost for homogeneous and strongly heterogeneous media, including perfectly matched layer truncations.

AI.title_translation: 高频亥姆霍兹方程的物理驱动多尺度方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于高频亥姆霍兹方程的物理驱动多尺度降阶方法，通过局部波响应和谱分析在保证计算稳定性的同时大幅降低了计算成本。
AI.motivation: 高频亥姆霍兹方程的数值求解需要极细的网格以解析剧烈的振荡行为，导致计算代价极高，因此需要开发一种既能保持高精度又能大幅降低计算维度的物理驱动多尺度模型降阶方法。
AI.method: 基于带有速度消除的混合有限元公式，通过在超采样区域上求解带有边界激发的亥姆霍兹问题构建局部波响应快照；利用局部广义特征值问题从物理信息空间中选择模态，形成具有稀疏单元间耦合的全局降阶系统。
AI.result: 建立了多尺度inf-sup条件，证明了多尺度近似在离散能量范数下的适定性和准最优性，得到了显式量化误差界；二维和三维数值实验表明，该方法在均质和强非均质介质中均能实现高精度的波场近似，并大幅降低全局维度和求解成本。
AI.conclusion: 该物理驱动的多尺度方法能够有效降低高频亥姆霍兹方程的全局计算维度，且通过严格的理论分析和数值实验证明了其在复杂非均质介质中的高精度和稳定性。
AI.translation: 我们针对高频亥姆霍兹方程的模型降阶，开发并分析了一种物理驱动的多尺度方法。该方法在具有速度消除的混合有限元公式框架下，由局部波响应构建降阶近似空间。这些响应通过在超采样区域上求解带有边界激发的亥姆霍兹问题来计算，从而得到结合了底层介质振荡行为和传播特性的快照。接着，局部广义特征值空间从中选取模态，以形成具有稀疏单元间耦合的全局降阶系统。为了建立这种降阶方法的稳定性和收敛性，我们将局部谱近似与全局伴随问题的近似联系起来。从精细网格公式的inf--sup估计出发，该论证导出了一个受精细网格分辨率、超采样以及首个被忽略的局部特征值控制的多尺度inf--sup条件。由此产生的稳定性确立了多尺度近似在离散能量范数下的适定性和准最优性。结合局部谱估计，它给出了一个先验误差界，显式地量化了粗细网格尺寸、超采样深度、谱截断和波数的作用。该分析为局部空间降阶与全局近似的稳定性及精度之间提供了定量联系。在二维和三维上的数值实验证明，对于均质和强非均质介质（包括完美匹配层截断），该方法能够以显著降低的全局维度和求解成本实现准确的波场近似。
AI.summary: 本文针对高频亥姆霍兹方程开发并分析了一种物理驱动的多尺度降阶方法。通过局部波响应快照与广义特征值问题构建降阶空间，并在理论上建立了相应的稳定性、收敛性及显式先验误差估计。二维和三维数值实验验证了该方法在降低计算成本方面的显著优势。
AI.keywords: 亥姆霍兹方程, 多尺度方法, 模型降阶, 局部广义特征值问题, 稳定性分析
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种针对高频亥姆霍兹方程的物理驱动多尺度降阶方法，创新性地结合了局部波响应快照与广义特征值问题，并在理论上严格证明了其稳定性和准最优性误差估计。这对于解决高频波动方程计算量大的瓶颈问题具有重要意义。

title: TSGuard: A Real-Time Framework for Detecting and Imputing Missing Data in Streaming Time Series
comments: The 35th ACM International Conference on Information and Knowledge Management (CIKM '26), November 07--11, 2026, Rome, Italy
summary:
Streaming sensor applications routinely suffer from delayed or missing observations caused by faults, communication losses, or environmental interference. Although recent imputation methods exploit temporal and spatial dependencies effectively, most either assume offline access to future observations or prioritize throughput without enforcing domain plausibility. We present TSGuard, a real-time demonstration system for monitoring, validating, and imputing missing values in streaming time series. TSGuard combines a lightweight graph-aware temporal imputation model with constraint-aware validation, fallback estimation, and operator-facing explanations.
  Rather than treating imputation as an isolated prediction task, TSGuard integrates it into a broader data-quality loop: detect problematic observations, impute missing values, validate estimated against physical and spatial constraints, and either retain the original value as a plausible anomaly or replace it when it violates domain constraints. Using environmental sensing as a motivating setting, the demo enables users to inspect delayed sensors, compare imputers, define constraints, and validate flagged values in real time. The combination of lightweight online spatiotemporal imputation, domain-aware validation, and explicit retain-or-replace decisions is our central contribution, while interactive explanations make these decisions inspectable and actionable. for operators.
