title: Where Do Apparent LLM Clinical Triage Failures Arise? Localizing the Multiple-Choice Format Effect
comments: 9 pages main text, 29 pages total including appendices; 7 figures, 25 tables
summary: LLM evaluations using clinician-authored triage vignettes have reported substantial under-triage under constrained multiple-choice testing. Yet model performance on the same clinical cases can change when responses are generated in free text. We test whether this format effect appears while the case is processed or when clinical information is mapped to the final answer. Using sparse-autoencoder (SAE) features in Gemma 3 4B/12B IT and Qwen3-8B, we find that medical features fire on the shared clinical narrative under both formats but are inactive at the multiple-choice decision token. Emergency-tier information is linearly decodable from vignette representations with ROC-AUC $0.95$--$1.00$ under both formats, with no significant format difference, but is attenuated at the decision token. Natural-language autoencoder verbalization and top-feature characterization associate that token with the multiple-choice scaffold. In a direct linear projection, the identified medical features contribute zero, whereas scaffold-peaking features account for over $91\%$ of unsigned attribution in both Gemma models. Behaviorally, whether multiple choice improves or worsens performance depends on the model. Option-order shuffles rule out simple positional bias, and cases that differ between formats are usually one severity tier apart. Together, these findings place the strongest correlates of the format effect at answer selection while leaving open whether unmeasured clinical representations also differ. Code and data to reproduce experiments are available in the study repository. https://github.com/dafraile/SAE_mad

title: FRUC: Feedforward Dynamic Scene Reconstruction from Uncalibrated Collaborative Driving Views
summary: We present FRUC, a feedforward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for dynamic scene reconstruction from uncalibrated collaborative driving views. Existing multi-agent reconstruction frameworks are often hindered by rigid prerequisites, demanding precise spatial calibration and slow per-scene optimization. In this paper, we rethink this task by conceptualizing a distributed multi-vehicle network as a spatio-temporally unstructured ego-centric multi-camera system, where the core challenge lies in enhancing ego-centric occluded geometry through collaboration without degrading the ego's accurately observed visible geometry, while preserving reconstruction efficiency. For efficient reconstruction, FRUC is built upon a visual grounded geometric Transformer backbone to enable one-shot, calibration-free inference from a flexible number of multi-vehicle views. To achieve non-destructive geometric supplementation under uncalibrated cross-agent misalignment, FRUC first introduces an ego-centric causal occlusion field that explicitly derives occlusion evolution as latent priors by modeling agent-wise spatio-temporal correlations. Guided by these occlusion priors, it further formulates cross-agent integration as a deterministic residual denoising process via zero-initialized injection, turning challenging cross-agent fusion into bounded residual learning for robust collaborative blind-spot completion. Through extensive evaluations on real-world V2X-Real and UrbanIng-V2X datasets, FRUC is shown to be a new state-of-the-art for the scene reconstruction of dynamic collaborative driving environments, significantly outperforming existing methods in both rendering quality and efficiency. Code is available at https://github.com/yihangtao/FRUC.git.

title: LLM Anonymization Against Agentic Re-Identification
summary: Agentic LLMs with web search change the threat model for text anonymization: weak contextual cues can become cross-referenceable evidence for re-identification, yet those same details also carry downstream analytic value of the text. Existing defenses either remove explicit identifiers, perturb text for formal privacy, or test rewritten text against non-web inference models, leaving underexplored the operating region between resistance to agentic web-search re-identification and utility retention. We introduce AURA (\textbf{A}nonymization with \textbf{U}tility-\textbf{R}etention \textbf{A}daptation), an LLM-powered \textit{mask-reconstruct} framework that decouples privacy localization from utility-preserving reconstruction and selects candidates with adversarial privacy and utility-retention checks. We evaluate AURA on real-user interview transcripts using re-identification attacks carried out by web-search agents, along with a utility evaluation based on interviewee-profile facts, codebook facts, and the joint contextual utility grid. Our results show that adaptive-scope AURA yields the lowest agentic re-identification counts under each of three attacker models among the non-DP methods, and that at matched scope and backbone, AURA's mask-reconstruct design retains more contextual utility than the prior LLM anonymizer (+6.4 pp unit-grid recovery) at comparable privacy. Source Code: https://github.com/AaronLi43/AURA

title: One Hypothesis Is Not Enough: Abductive Reasoning with Agentic Hypothesis Refinement over Knowledge Graphs
summary: Abductive reasoning over knowledge graphs (KGs) seeks a first-order logic hypothesis whose answer set explains a given set of observed entities. Since many hypotheses can explain the same observations, controllable hypothesis generators condition generation on entities, relations, or logical patterns, but they treat generation as a single step. A generated hypothesis may be well-formed and satisfy the given conditions yet still fail to explain the observations, and the model has no mechanism to detect or correct this mismatch. Closing the abductive cycle requires revising a discrete, structured hypothesis, which large language models cannot do reliably, even though they iterate readily in natural language. We propose HypoAgent, an agentic hypothesis refinement framework that treats condition signals not only as expressions of user intent but also as operators that steer generation. A Hypothesis Proposal Agent calls a small trained generator to propose a hypothesis. Root-cause analysis then uses fragment-level coverage to locate branches worth inspecting and gathers neighborhood evidence from the training graph. A Hypothesis Refiner Agent combines this diagnosis with previously generated hypotheses to produce updated conditions and directly revised hypotheses. HypoAgent outperforms one-shot generation in single-turn and multi-turn settings on BioKG, PharmKG8k, and DBpedia50, and in the unconditional setting on DBpedia50. Our code is available at https://github.com/HKUST-KnowComp/HypoAgent.

title: Fixed Universal Transformers
summary: We introduce \emph{universal transformers}: fixed transformers that can simulate any transformer in a given class via a suitable input embedding. Analogous to a universal Turing machine, the input embedding encodes a description of the target model while all internal parameters remain fixed. We provide explicit sparse constructions achieving universality when the embedding dimension is sufficiently large, and further show that universality is generic: randomly initialized transformers are universal almost surely, which aligns with recent empirical results of Zhong and Andreas (2024). We empirically validate our theory on the algorithmic tasks of parenthesis balancing and multi-hop reasoning. Our results suggest that much of a transformer's expressive power may reside in its input representation rather than its learned weights.

title: SurGe: Improved Surface Geometry in Point Maps
summary: Recent feedforward 3D reconstruction methods predict point maps and estimate global 3D geometry remarkably well. However, their predictions still exhibit inaccurate local surface geometry, which is clearly visible qualitatively but only weakly reflected in common metrics. To make these errors more explicit in evaluation, we introduce a point map normal metric that evaluates the local surface orientation induced by neighboring 3D predictions. To reduce these errors, we propose two complementary components: a point gradient matching loss that supervises depth-normalized 3D finite differences, and a Neighborhood Attention Decoder (NAD) that progressively upsamples features and uses Neighborhood Attention for local feature mixing. Across eight zero-shot monocular geometry benchmarks, our model, SurGe, achieves the best average rank for global point map AbsRel and consistently improves local point map and point map normal evaluations.

title: A Pre-Training Analogue of Grokking in Language Models: Tracing Delayed Grammatical Generalization
comments: 18 pages, 10 figures, 9 tables; Accepted to AACL-IJCNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Grokking, the phenomenon in which neural networks generalize long after fitting their training data, has been studied in supervised settings on many epochs. LLM pre-training instead involves next-token prediction over an unlabeled corpus, with limited data repetition and no explicit train/validation split. To address this, we propose an exposure-based framework that enables the study of grokking-like dynamics during LLM pre-training. We ground our evaluation in BLiMP minimal pairs, which provide controlled grammatical contrasts. For every BLiMP minimal pair, we identify a critical phrase, the smallest continuous span that captures the grammatical contrast and the phenomenon-relevant context. Examples whose critical phrase appears in the pre-training window are assigned to the proxy-train split; the remaining examples are assigned to the proxy-validation split. Across five grammatical phenomena, we observe delayed generalization. Analyzing pre-training checkpoints before and after generalization shows that grammatical concept vectors become more predictive of grammatical acceptability and occupy a higher-dimensional subspace after generalization. We also find that attention from the critical token to the relevant context token is concentrated in a small number of heads.

title: Specializing Without Forgetting: Analyzing Knowledge Preservation in Multilingual Model Adaptation
summary: While continual pretraining (CPT) is a practical way to extend large language models to new languages, naïve finetuning often erodes existing capabilities through catastrophic forgetting. We investigate which model layers drive this trade-off, and whether interventions at these layers can guide knowledge preservation during adaptation. We interpolate gemma-3-4b model states before and after CPT on five language families to localize forgetting on reading comprehension and translation, finding that middle-layer reversion yields the largest comprehension recovery, while translation effects vary by language family and direction. Guided by these findings, we evaluate CPT strategies that leverage this layer information to mitigate forgetting: layer freezing, layer-range L2 regularization, post-hoc layer reversion, and model souping, comparing all strategies against joint multilingual and family-specific vanilla CPT baselines. We find that preserving the layer weights identified via model interpolation substantially reduces comprehension loss relative to joint CPT, with layer freezing exceeding base model performance on average. However, these strategies yield mixed translation results: dense training or post-hoc reversion often outperforms both training-time constraints and family-specific specialization, complicating prior assumptions about how models should be aligned when extended to new tasks. Instead, we argue that multilingual adaptation strategy should be informed by target language, base model knowledge, and downstream task, and propose interpolation-based localization as a diagnostic for identifying candidate layers before committing to a training-time intervention in a new setting.

title: Detect Before You Leap: Mirage Detection in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can produce confident answers without relevant visual evidence, a failure mode known as mirage (Asadi et al., 2026). We study pre-release mirage detection: deciding whether a VLM answer should be released or withheld. Our model-agnostic method, Text-Conditioned Layer-wise Internal Alignment (TC-LIA), tracks question-image alignment across the layers of a frozen CLIP ViT-H/14 encoder, summarizing patch-text alignment by final similarity, late-layer top-k alignment, early-to-late gain, and slope. TC-LIA is training-free at deployment with fixed projections and scoring weights, without any label-specific training, and delivers strong detection independently. Additionally, when combined with blank/noise detection, domain routing, and VLM self-assessment, it forms an ensemble whose supervised training improves performance but is an optional add-on. On 19,004 samples spanning 10 VQA domains, 14 state-of-the-art VLMs exhibit 57.3-75.0% base mirage rates. Our proposed TC-LIA alone cuts this to 7.5% with 83.5% Related/Unrelated/Blank-Noise classification accuracy, and the ensemble reaches 84.5-88.4% accuracy with 5.9-7.2% mirage rates (best joint result: 88.4% accuracy, 6.4% mirage rate). Notably, an ensemble trained on a single backbone transfers well to unseen backbones, with the best-transferring source staying within 0.7% accuracy points of per-backbone training across 13 held-out VLMs.

title: On the Limits of LLM Adaptability: Impact of Model-Internalized Priors on Annotation Task Performance
comments: Updated based on camera-ready from ICML 2026 (Oral & Spotlight); PMLR vol. 306. 9 pages, 5 figures
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for zero-shot annotation and LLM-as-a-judge tasks, yet their reliability hinges on how model-internalized priors interact with user-provided instructions. We investigate three dimensions of this interaction: (1) how an LLM's familiarity with data and task definitions relates to performance, (2) whether additional information in prompts can correct zero-shot errors ("decision stickiness"), and (3) model susceptibility to misaligned task definitions. We introduce Definition-Specific Familiarity (DSF), which measures alignment between a model's elicited concept and the target definition. Across nine LLMs and six toxicity datasets (five primary datasets plus an additional robustness dataset), DSF predicts annotation performance after controlling for dataset identity (partial $r=+0.41$). This association remains positive across all prompting conditions tested. In contrast, three common text-memorization metrics show no positive association. We show that prompting has limited corrective power: only 34.8% of zero-shot errors are corrected by additional instructions or examples, with high-confidence errors especially persistent. Misaligned definitions systematically shift predictions without reducing reported confidence, making confidence unreliable for detecting definition-policy mismatch. Together, these findings establish definition alignment as a practical model-selection criterion and show that better prompting alone cannot substitute for validating model-policy fit.

title: SafeVLA-Bench: A Benchmark for the Success-Safety Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
comments: 46 pages (10 main + references + appendix), 7 figures, 21 tables. Project page: https://safevla.org
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) benchmarks measure whether a policy completes a requested manipulation task, but binary success can hide safety violations along the trajectory: a policy may reach the goal while applying excessive contact, disturbing bystander objects, destabilizing a held object, or entering robot self-contact. We present SafeVLA-Bench, a post-hoc safety-evaluation framework for existing simulator-based VLA benchmarks that reveals violations missed by success-only evaluation. It encodes task-aware safety requirements as Signal Temporal Logic (STL) invariants with quantitative robustness semantics. Alongside native success, it reports the safety rate and the success-but-unsafe rate (SBU) used in prior safety evaluations, and introduces the Violation Severity Index (VSI), a bounded worst-violation depth score. We instantiate SafeVLA-Bench on LIBERO and RoboCasa-365, evaluating twenty-seven policy-benchmark entries across tabletop and kitchen manipulation tasks. High task success does not imply safe execution: the fifteen tabletop policies above 90% mean success still have 18-28% unsafe-episode rates, and 38-56% of successful RoboCasa-365 rollouts violate at least one active safety clause. A post-training case study further shows that SafeVLA-Bench can be used to improve policy safety. Project page: https://safevla.org

title: Counterfactual Evidence Audits Predict LLM-Agent Susceptibility to Ranked Context
comments: 19 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at FLMSec 2026 (NeurIPS 2026 Workshop). Substantially revised after peer review with new preregistered audits, matched controls, held-out validation, RAG transfer, and Codex boundary tests
summary: LLM agents increasingly decide from evidence assembled by upstream systems: retrievers choose documents, recommenders choose posts, and memory systems choose prior events. Existing evaluations usually hold this evidence fixed, missing failures in which individually ordinary items form a systematically one-sided context. We introduce a counterfactual evidence audit: expose an agent to two mirrored sets of five documents, measure the difference in six downstream decisions, and use that contrast to predict its response to disjoint 45-document contexts. The protocol was frozen before testing three held-out open-weight model families. Across 18 held-out model-task cells, five-document effects predict full-context effects with Spearman rho=.855 (p<.001), reduce mean absolute prediction error by 62% relative to a zero-effect predictor, and recover the direction of 12 of 13 material effects. A reviewer-requested post-hoc task-mean baseline is also substantially weaker (MAE .369 versus .167). Matched controls show that selecting one-sided ordinary items, rather than merely reordering identical items, causes the shift in a susceptible model. Across seven open-weight families, susceptibility transfers from an interactive feed to a static RAG dossier (rho=.750, exact p=.033), while a provenance warning does not reliably mitigate it. A separate study of three deployed Codex agent tiers finds strong audit-to-full ranking (rho=.951, p<.001) but no individually significant full-context effect after correction. Within this single synthetic remote-work domain, the result supports a domain-specific triage procedure, not a universal steering claim: evidence selection must be evaluated as part of the composed agent system.

title: HakushoBench: A Japanese Chart and Table VQA Benchmark from Governmental White Papers
summary: Understanding chart and table images is essential for applying vision-language models (VLMs) to real-world document understanding. While English benchmarks have advanced rapidly, non-English counterparts remain scarce, leaving it unclear whether this progress generalizes across languages. A key obstacle is the difficulty of collecting realistic and diverse non-English chart and table images at scale. To address this, we leverage governmental white papers as a source for benchmark construction, as they contain naturally occurring charts and tables across diverse formats and domains and are freely accessible in many countries. As a first instantiation, we introduce HakushoBench, a Japanese chart and table VQA benchmark built from 33 governmental white papers. HakushoBench contains 2,053 images spanning over 10 image types, with manually annotated and independently verified QA pairs designed to assess holistic understanding of charts and tables rather than local visual cues alone. Experiments across a broad range of VLMs show that HakushoBench is substantially harder than the existing Japanese benchmark and remains challenging for open-weight models: sub-10B open-weight models reach at most 58.6% accuracy, and even the flagship open-weight model Qwen3.5-397B-A17B trails Gemini~3~Pro by 8.1 points (85.8% vs. 93.9%), highlighting substantial room for improvement in complex chart and table understanding. We release our dataset and code.

title: S2M-Trek: From Single to Multi-Sphere Transport via Per-Frame Deep Sets on a Wheel-Legged Robot
summary: We study the problem of scaling dynamic loco-manipulation from a single free-rolling sphere to multiple spheres transported simultaneously on the back of a wheel-legged quadruped, without fences, grippers, or mechanical stops. Multiple identical free-rolling spheres form an unordered set with no persistent identity: their ordering may change independently at each history frame, creating a \emph{per-frame permutation symmetry} that standard history-concatenation set encoders do not explicitly enforce -- these encoders impose only a shared, diagonal permutation symmetry over the full history. We show that this symmetry mismatch leads to a concrete failure mode in curriculum-based reinforcement learning. Within the same PPO training budget, flat MLPs and branch-wise encoders plateau at or below the two-sphere stage, while a history-concatenation Deep Sets baseline (\HCDS) fails to progress past the two-sphere stage in our runs unless ball-to-slot assignments are randomised during training, suggesting that it exploits slot indices as a curriculum shortcut rather than learning identity-free multi-sphere dynamics. We propose \textbf{Per-Frame Deep Sets (\PFDS)}, which performs permutation-invariant pooling within each history frame before temporal readout; we prove that \PFDS is $\Gframe$-invariant and universally approximates continuous $\Gframe$-invariant policies. A $2{\times}2$ ablation over encoder architecture and slot randomisation separates the architectural and data-augmentation pathways, and \PFDS reaches the five-sphere stage with 100\% no-drop transport in simulation across all five random seeds. We further distill the \PFDS teacher into \TactSet via DAgger, replacing privileged sphere-state observations with a $16{\times}16$ Boolean union contact map, yielding a compact and naturally $\Gframe$-invariant tactile representation.

title: Efficient Exploration for Iterative Nash Preference Optimization
summary: Preference alignment is central to improving large language models (LLMs), but reward-based formulations can be restrictive when human preferences are non-transitive. Nash learning from human feedback (NLHF) addresses this limitation by modeling alignment as a preference game and seeking a Nash equilibrium. However, the learning-theoretic foundations of scalable NLHF remain limited: existing regret guarantees rely on explicit preference-model estimation and minimax oracles, whereas simpler iterative methods lack such guarantees. We study online iterative NLHF and identify exploration as a key obstacle. First, we show that standard iterative NLHF can incur an exponential dependence on the inverse KL-regularization parameter, demonstrating that implicit exploration through policy updates can be insufficient. We then propose Exploratory Nash Preference Optimization (ENPO), which combines a SFT-type regularization with adversarial policy exploration. ENPO eliminates this exponential dependence without requiring minimax oracles or explicit preference-model estimation. We further introduce Bonus-Explorer ENPO (BENPO), which uses additional oracles to achieve an $O(\log T)$ regret bound. Finally, we develop Direct ENPO (DENPO), a practical variant of ENPO for fine-tuning LLMs. Experiments with Llama-3-8B-Instruct demonstrate consistent improvements over the evaluated RLHF and NLHF baselines across multiple benchmarks.

title: Everywhere Learning: Artificial Intelligence with Pointwise Constraints
summary: Everywhere learning is a new paradigm whereby Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are trained to satisfy loss constraints with probability one over the data distribution. This is in contrast to the standard paradigm of training AI systems to minimize average losses. We develop an approximate duality theory to substantiate a generalization analysis that establishes the proximity between solutions of empirical and statistical everywhere learning problems. Our results show that dual variables reweigh the data distribution towards points in which loss constraints are more difficult to satisfy and that generalization is controlled by the mismatch between the concentration of mass of the data distribution and the concentration of mass on points where constraints are more difficult to satisfy. We further show that we can control generalization with a sparse L1 penalty on constraint relaxations. We illustrate the merits of everywhere learning with an experiment in agentic classification for language model tasks.

title: Encoded but Not Routed: Explaining the Table-Chart Gap in Scientific Claim Verification
summary: Multimodal LLMs are increasingly used to assist scientific peer review, where a core requirement is verifying whether claims in a paper are supported by its evidence. Prior work has shown that models perform substantially better at this task when the evidence is a table than when it is a chart of the same underlying data. This raises the question of whether models fail to extract information from charts, or do they extract it but fail to use it when forming their prediction? We study this question through layer-wise linear probing and attention analysis on three open-weight VLMs over table and chart evidence, representing the same underlying data. We find consistent evidence for the latter. Chart information is encoded in the models' intermediate representations but does not reach the prediction position, a gap that is absent for tables and holds across all conditions tested. Attention analysis further reveals that this disconnect takes two architecturally distinct forms across model families. These findings point toward reframing the table-chart gap as a failure of how encoded visual information is used at prediction time, rather than a failure of encoding itself.

AI.title_translation: 已编码但未路由：解释科学主张验证中的表格与图表性能差距
AI.tldr: VLM在图表验证中表现逊于表格，并非由于编码提取失败，而是因为中间层已编码的图表信息未能有效路由至预测位置。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型在验证科学主张时，输入为表格的表现远优于输入为呈现相同数据的图表。研究旨在探究模型究竟是未能从图表中提取有效信息，还是成功提取了信息但在形成最终预测时未能有效使用。
AI.method: 在三个开源权重的视觉语言模型（VLMs）上，针对呈现相同底层数据的表格与图表证据，采用分层线性探测（layer-wise linear probing）和注意力分析（attention analysis）方法进行评估与追踪。
AI.result: 实验结果支持后者：图表信息成功编码在模型的中间层表征中，但未能有效传递至最终预测位置，而表格则无此脱节现象；注意力分析进一步揭示，该断联现象在不同模型家族中呈现出两种架构上截然不同的具体形式。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，模型在图表与表格任务上的表现差距本质上是预测阶段利用编码视觉信息的失败（信息路由缺陷），而非视觉编码本身的缺陷。
AI.translation: 多模态大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地用于辅助科学同行评审，其中的一项核心要求是验证论文中的主张是否得到其证据的支持。先前的研究表明，当证据为表格时，模型在该任务上的表现显著优于证据为呈现相同底层数据的图表时的表现。这引发了一个疑问：模型是无法从图表中提取信息，还是提取了信息但在形成预测时未能使用？我们通过对三个开源权重的视觉语言模型（VLM）在表示相同底层数据的表格和图表证据上进行分层线性探测和注意力分析来研究此问题。我们发现了一致支持后者的证据：图表信息已被编码在模型的中间表征中，但并没有到达预测位置；这种差距在表格中并不存在，且在所有测试条件下均成立。注意力分析进一步揭示，这种脱节在不同模型家族中表现为两种架构上截然不同的形式。这些发现表明，应将表格与图表的差距重新归因于预测时如何使用已编码视觉信息的失败，而非编码本身的失败。
AI.summary: 本论文探讨了多模态大模型在科学同行评审的主张验证任务中，处理图表证据表现落后于相同数据表格的原因。通过分层探测与注意力分析发现，模型在中间层均已成功编码图表信息，但该信息未能路由至预测位置，证明该差距源自预测阶段的信息路由失败而非编码能力不足。
AI.keywords: 科学主张验证, 视觉语言模型, 表格与图表差距, 线性探测, 注意力分析
AI.comments: 本研究通过机理可解释性分析（线性探测与注意力分析），颠覆了传统认为“图表表现差是因为模型无法有效解析视觉特征”的直觉认知，明确指出瓶颈在于信息在模型内部的传递与路由过程。这一发现对改进多模态大模型的推理架构设计、注意力流机制优化以及图表理解能力提升具有重要指导价值。

title: More Efficient LLM Reranking with Whole-Pool, Setwise, Long-Context Language Models
summary: LLM-based re-rankers produce a rankings through repeated local comparisons (listwise, pairwise or pointwise), requiring many sequential model calls. We study how long-context LLMs can drastically reduce this computation when the entire retrieved candidate pool fits within the context window. We introduce Whole-Pool Setwise re-ranking, where each comparison ranks all the entire candidate pool, and propose DualEnd, which jointly selects the candidates predicted to be most and least relevant. By filling the ranking from both ends, DualEnd constructs a complete ranking of 100 candidates in 50 LLM comparisons. Experiments with nine open-weight LLMs on TREC DL19 and DL20 show that this requires 59.4% fewer comparisons than previous top-oriented windowed Setwise with heapsort and 88.8% fewer than top-oriented windowed Setwise with bubblesort, even though those baselines target only the top-10 rankings while DualEnd targets the full ranking. DualEnd's nDCG@100 is within 0.008 of single-end whole-pool top-oriented approach, while approximately halving its token consumption and ranking time. Across six BEIR datasets, DualEnd reduces mean token consumption and ranking time by 49.4% and 50.8%, respectively, relative to single-end whole-pool top-oriented approach. These results demonstrate that DualEnd Setwise enables complete re-ranking with substantially fewer LLM comparisons and competitive effectiveness across several backbones.

AI.title_translation: 基于全候选池、集合式和长上下文大语言模型的更高效重排序
AI.tldr: 提出DualEnd集合式重排序策略，利用长上下文LLM同时从首尾两端确定候选相关性，仅需50次调用即可完成100个文档的全量重排，计算与时间开销减半且效果几乎不损耗。
AI.motivation: 传统基于LLM的重排序方法多依赖局部比较（逐点、逐对或列表式），需进行大量顺序模型调用导致计算成本高昂。随着长上下文模型发展，整个候选池可一次性放入上下文窗口，需要探索更高效的重排序机制以大幅削减计算开销。
AI.method: 提出了全候选池集合式重排序（Whole-Pool Setwise re-ranking）以及DualEnd方法。每次比较将整个候选池输入长上下文LLM，联合预测选出当前候选池中最相关和最不相关的样本，从首尾两端同时构建排序列表，重排100个候选仅需50次调用。
AI.result: 在TREC DL19和DL20上，DualEnd比堆排序窗口集合式减少59.4%的比较，比冒泡排序减少88.8%，且其完成的是Top-100全排序；nDCG@100与单端全池方法差距在0.008以内，Token消耗和耗时减半。在6个BEIR数据集上，平均Token消耗与耗时分别降低49.4%和50.8%。
AI.conclusion: DualEnd Setwise利用长上下文模型实现了全量重排序，在大幅减少LLM比较调用次数、降低约一半Token消耗与排序时间的同时，保持了与全池单端方法相当的检索排序质量。
AI.translation: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的重排序器通过重复的局部比较（列表式、配对式或逐点式）生成排序结果，需要多次顺序模型调用。我们研究了当整个检索候选池完全适应上下文窗口时，长上下文大语言模型如何大幅削减此类计算。我们引入了全候选池集合式（Whole-Pool Setwise）重排序，其中每次比较对整个候选池进行排序，并提出了DualEnd方法，该方法联合选择预测为最相关和最不相关的候选文档。通过从两端填充排序结果，DualEnd仅需50次LLM比较即可构建包含100个候选文档的完整排序。基于9个开源权重LLM在TREC DL19和DL20上的实验表明，与先前采用堆排序的顶端导向窗口化Setwise相比，该方法减少了59.4%的比较次数，与冒泡排序相比减少了88.8%，尽管这些基线仅针对Top-10排序，而DualEnd针对的是全量排序。DualEnd的nDCG@100与单端全池顶端导向方法的差距在0.008以内，同时将其Token消耗和排序时间减半。在六个BEIR数据集上，相对于单端全池顶端导向方法，DualEnd的平均Token消耗和排序时间分别降低了49.4%和50.8%。这些结果表明，DualEnd Setwise能够以显著更少的LLM比较次数实现完整的重排序，并在多个骨干模型上保持竞争力的排序效果。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在长上下文大模型时代如何提高重排序效率，提出了全候选池集合式排序方法DualEnd。通过每次同时识别最相关与最不相关的候选并从两端填充排序，DualEnd将100个文档重排序所需的模型调用降至50次，并在保持与基线相当的排序质量（nDCG@100差距在0.008内）的前提下，将Token使用量和推理时间削减约50%。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型重排序, 长上下文, 集合式重排序, 双端排序, 全候选池
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地结合了长上下文LLM的全候选池处理能力与双端（DualEnd）排序算法，将排序任务从两端同时收敛，使全量排序所需的模型调用次数和Token开销减半。其局限在于方法严格依赖长上下文窗口能够完全容纳整个候选池，对于长文档或更大规模候选池的扩展性仍需进一步验证。

title: Planning Takes More Than Token Prediction: Causal Plan for Benchmarking and Building Physically Grounded Embodied Reasoners
summary: Current benchmarks for embodied vision-language planning inadvertently favor linguistic next-token prediction over physically grounded next-state reasoning. This rewards models that mimic statistical language priors rather than track true causal dependencies, reducing complex physical planning to shallow sequence modeling. Hence, achieving genuine physical autonomy requires a fundamental shift from linguistically grounded token prediction toward physically grounded causal reasoning. To this end, we introduce Causal-Plan-Bench, a high-fidelity diagnostic suite spanning four causal dimensions, curated via multi-stage verification. To endow models with this capability, a four-stage annotation pipeline extracts structured interaction records from egocentric videos to construct Causal-Plan-1M, a dense million-scale corpus of explicit causal reasoning traces. Extensive evaluation reveals a striking gap: leading models struggle to demonstrate genuine physical agency -- even GPT-6-astra scores only 43.04. In contrast, our tailored training recipe enables Causal Planner to internalize the complex physical logic required for accurate next-state estimation. Built upon Qwen3-VL-8B, Causal Planner raises its backbone's score from 33.23 to 45.28, a 36.3% relative gain, and improves on three external benchmarks without benchmark-specific adaptation. We further observe an empirical Causal-Supervision Scaling Trend. Paired no-vision controls also reveal substantial visual dependence, while cross-judge comparisons and human scoring assess the reliability of automated evaluation. More importantly, we initiate the first effort to turn agents from superficial token predictors into physically grounded causal reasoners, bridging language modeling and world modeling.

AI.title_translation: 规划不仅仅是令牌预测：用于基准测试和构建物理接地具身推理器的因果规划
AI.tldr: 当前具身视觉-语言规划基准偏向语言令牌预测而非物理因果推理。本文引入了Causal-Plan-Bench基准和Causal-Plan-1M数据集，并提出了Causal Planner模型，显著提升了物理接地因果推理能力，旨在将智能体从表面令牌预测器转变为物理接地因果推理器。
AI.motivation: 当前具身视觉-语言规划的基准测试无意中偏向于语言上的下一个令牌预测，而非物理上的下一个状态推理。这导致模型模仿统计语言先验而非追踪真实的因果依赖，将复杂的物理规划简化为浅层序列建模。为了实现真正的物理自主性，需要从语言接地令牌预测转向物理接地因果推理。
AI.method: 1. 引入Causal-Plan-Bench，这是一个高保真诊断套件，涵盖四个因果维度，通过多阶段验证策划。2. 构建Causal-Plan-1M，一个百万级的密集语料库，通过四阶段标注流程从自我中心视频中提取结构化交互记录，以构建明确的因果推理轨迹。3. 提出Causal Planner模型，基于Qwen3-VL-8B，并采用定制的训练方法，使其能够内化复杂的物理逻辑以进行准确的下一状态估计。4. 进行广泛评估，包括对领先模型的测试，以及对视觉依赖性、交叉判断比较和人类评分的分析。
AI.result: 1. 领先模型在展示真正的物理自主性方面表现不佳，即使GPT-6-astra也仅得43.04分。2. Causal Planner模型将其骨干模型Qwen3-VL-8B的得分从33.23提高到45.28，相对提升了36.3%。3. Causal Planner在三个外部基准上也有所改进，且无需针对特定基准进行适应。4. 观察到经验性的因果监督缩放趋势。5. 无视觉控制的配对实验揭示了显著的视觉依赖性。6. 交叉判断比较和人类评分评估了自动化评估的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究首次尝试将智能体从表面令牌预测器转变为物理接地因果推理器，弥合了语言建模和世界建模之间的鸿沟。通过引入新的基准、数据集和训练方法，证明了实现物理自主性需要从语言接地令牌预测转向物理接地因果推理，并展示了Causal Planner在这一方向上的显著进展。
AI.translation:
论文标题：规划不仅仅是令牌预测：用于基准测试和构建物理接地具身推理器的因果规划

摘要：当前具身视觉-语言规划的基准测试无意中偏向于语言上的下一个令牌预测，而非物理上的下一个状态推理。这奖励了那些模仿统计语言先验而非追踪真实因果依赖的模型，将复杂的物理规划简化为浅层序列建模。因此，实现真正的物理自主性需要从语言接地令牌预测转向物理接地因果推理的根本性转变。为此，我们引入了Causal-Plan-Bench，这是一个涵盖四个因果维度的高保真诊断套件，通过多阶段验证策划而成。为了赋予模型这种能力，一个四阶段的标注流程从自我中心视频中提取结构化交互记录，以构建Causal-Plan-1M，一个百万级的明确因果推理轨迹密集语料库。广泛的评估揭示了一个惊人的差距：领先模型难以展示真正的物理自主性——即使GPT-6-astra也仅得43.04分。相比之下，我们定制的训练方法使Causal Planner能够内化准确下一状态估计所需的复杂物理逻辑。Causal Planner基于Qwen3-VL-8B构建，将其骨干模型的得分从33.23提高到45.28，相对提升了36.3%，并且在无需特定基准适应的情况下，在三个外部基准上均有所改进。我们进一步观察到经验性的因果监督缩放趋势。配对的无视觉控制实验也揭示了显著的视觉依赖性，而交叉判断比较和人类评分评估了自动化评估的可靠性。更重要的是，我们首次尝试将智能体从表面令牌预测器转变为物理接地因果推理器，弥合了语言建模和世界建模之间的鸿沟。
AI.summary: 本研究指出当前具身视觉-语言规划基准过度依赖语言令牌预测而非物理因果推理，阻碍了智能体实现真正的物理自主性。为解决此问题，论文提出了Causal-Plan-Bench，一个诊断性基准，并构建了Causal-Plan-1M，一个包含百万级因果推理轨迹的语料库。在此基础上，开发了Causal Planner模型，通过定制训练显著提升了物理逻辑理解和下一状态预测能力，将智能体从浅层令牌预测器转变为物理接地因果推理器，弥合了语言建模与世界建模的差距。
AI.keywords: 具身规划, 因果推理, 令牌预测, 视觉-语言, Causal-Plan-Bench
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于明确指出了当前具身视觉-语言规划中语言令牌预测与物理因果推理之间的根本性问题，并提供了一套全面的解决方案。通过引入Causal-Plan-Bench基准和Causal-Plan-1M数据集，为评估和训练物理接地智能体提供了坚实的基础。Causal Planner模型及其训练方法展示了在提升模型物理推理能力方面的有效性，为未来具身智能体的发展开辟了新方向。其重要性在于推动了具身智能领域从单纯的语言模仿转向更深层次的物理世界理解和交互，对实现真正的人工智能自主性具有重要意义。

title: A Language Model from 1913: Pretraining on Historical Text
summary: While modern language models increasingly rely on ever-larger web corpora, we show that pretraining on historical text (e.g., pre-1913 text) in a data-constrained setting can produce a temporally grounded language model that still shows reasonable performance on language understanding. However, developing History LMs requires addressing challenges in data quality, preventing temporal leakage in post-training, and constructing temporally aligned evaluations. We address these challenges and pretrain TypewriterLM, a 7.24B-parameter model with a 1913 knowledge cutoff. We construct TypewriterCorpus, a 54B-token historical corpus with extensive temporal filtering, propose lexically grounded instruction tuning that constrains all responses to vocabulary from historical source documents, and introduce History-Event, a benchmark of 2,344 events for evaluating both competence and cutoff adherence. We release TypewriterLM and all associated resources to support future research on History LMs.

AI.title_translation: 1913年的语言模型：在历史文本上进行预训练
AI.tldr: 本文展示了在数据受限的环境下，对历史文本（例如1913年之前的文本）进行预训练可以生成一个时间上接地气的语言模型，并在语言理解方面表现出合理的性能。研究人员解决了数据质量、防止训练后时间泄露以及构建时间对齐评估的挑战，预训练了一个7.24B参数的TypewriterLM模型，并构建了TypewriterCorpus语料库、提出了词汇接地指令微调，并引入了History-Event基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型越来越依赖大型网络语料库，但研究旨在证明在数据受限的环境下，对历史文本进行预训练也能产生一个具有合理语言理解性能且时间上接地的语言模型。同时，开发历史语言模型需要解决数据质量、防止训练后时间泄露以及构建时间对齐评估等挑战。
AI.method: 研究人员预训练了TypewriterLM，一个7.24B参数、知识截止日期为1913年的模型。他们构建了TypewriterCorpus，一个包含54B词元的历史语料库，并进行了广泛的时间过滤。提出了词汇接地指令微调，将所有响应限制在历史源文档的词汇范围内。引入了History-Event基准测试，包含2,344个事件，用于评估模型的能力和截止日期遵守情况。
AI.result: 预训练的TypewriterLM模型在语言理解方面显示出合理的性能。研究构建了TypewriterCorpus历史语料库和History-Event评估基准。模型能够通过词汇接地指令微调，将其响应限制在历史词汇范围内，并有效评估其知识截止日期遵守情况。
AI.conclusion: 在数据受限的背景下，对历史文本进行预训练可以成功构建一个时间上接地并具有合理性能的语言模型。解决数据质量、时间泄露和评估对齐等挑战对于开发此类模型至关重要。TypewriterLM及其相关资源为未来历史语言模型的研究提供了支持。
AI.translation: 虽然现代语言模型越来越依赖规模不断扩大的网络语料库，但我们展示了在数据受限的环境下，对历史文本（例如1913年之前的文本）进行预训练可以产生一个时间上接地气的语言模型，该模型在语言理解方面仍表现出合理的性能。然而，开发历史语言模型需要解决数据质量挑战、防止训练后出现时间泄露，以及构建时间对齐的评估。我们解决了这些挑战，并预训练了TypewriterLM，一个7.24B参数的模型，其知识截止日期为1913年。我们构建了TypewriterCorpus，一个包含540亿词元、经过广泛时间过滤的历史语料库，提出了词汇接地指令微调，将所有响应限制在历史源文档的词汇范围内，并引入了History-Event，一个包含2,344个事件的基准测试，用于评估能力和截止日期遵守情况。我们发布了TypewriterLM及所有相关资源，以支持未来对历史语言模型的研究。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了在数据受限背景下，对1913年之前的历史文本进行预训练以构建时间接地语言模型的可能性。研究团队通过解决数据质量、时间泄露和评估对齐等挑战，成功预训练了7.24B参数的TypewriterLM模型。他们还构建了包含540亿词元的TypewriterCorpus历史语料库，提出了词汇接地指令微调方法，并引入了History-Event基准测试来评估模型的性能和知识截止日期遵守情况。研究结果表明，该模型在语言理解方面表现出合理性能，并发布了所有资源以促进未来研究。
AI.keywords: 历史语言模型, 预训练, TypewriterLM, 历史文本, 时间接地
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于其专注于历史文本的预训练，这与当前主流大型语言模型依赖海量网络数据形成对比。它展示了在特定时间背景下构建专业语言模型的可行性，并解决了时间泄露和评估对齐等关键挑战。TypewriterLM和相关资源的发布对历史计算和数字人文领域具有重要意义。

title: Hint-Guided Diversified Policy Optimization for LLM Reasoning
summary: Recent developments in Large Language Models (LLMs) have showcased impressive reasoning capabilities, with Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) being a promising enhancement strategy. However, existing reward mechanisms are constrained to the outcome-level correctness and lack explicit signals to guide the model to consider diverse solutions. In contrast, human problem solving typically involves evaluating multiple potential approaches and selecting the most reliable solution, a cognitive process that current RLVR frameworks do not explicitly incentivize. Inspired by this, we propose Hint-Guided Diversified Policy Optimization (HDPO), allowing the model to first list all potential candidate solution outlines as hints and then select the most reliable one for further reasoning. HDPO comprises two stages of Cold Start for Structured Reasoning and Hint-Guided Diversified Reinforcement Learning to incentivize the model to generate diverse and reliable solutions following the ``propose-select-think'' trajectory. Experimental results show that HDPO effectively boosts LLM reasoning and enhances the diversity of candidate solutions as well as the LLM's ability to identify reliable solutions.

AI.title_translation: 面向LLM推理的提示引导多样化策略优化
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种名为HDPO的新方法，通过引导LLM生成多样化的解决方案并从中选择最优解，来提升其推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有RLVR方法仅关注结果正确性，缺乏引导模型考虑多样化解决方案的机制，而人类解决问题时会评估多种方法，当前RLVR框架未能激励这种过程。
AI.method: HDPO包含两个阶段：结构化推理的冷启动和提示引导的多样化强化学习，以激励模型遵循“提出-选择-思考”的轨迹生成多样化且可靠的解决方案。
AI.result: 实验表明，HDPO能有效提升LLM的推理能力，增加候选解决方案的多样性，并增强LLM识别可靠解决方案的能力。
AI.conclusion: HDPO通过引入提示引导和多样化策略优化，成功解决了现有RLVR方法在LLM推理中的局限性，提高了推理的准确性和解决方案的多样性。
AI.translation: 近期，大型语言模型（LLM）在推理能力方面取得了显著进展，其中具有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）被认为是一种有前景的增强策略。然而，现有的奖励机制仅限于结果层面的正确性，缺乏明确的信号来指导模型考虑多样化的解决方案。相比之下，人类解决问题通常涉及评估多种潜在方法并选择最可靠的解决方案，这一认知过程是当前RLVR框架未明确激励的。受此启发，我们提出了提示引导的多样化策略优化（HDPO），允许模型首先列出所有潜在的候选解决方案大纲作为提示，然后选择最可靠的一个进行进一步推理。HDPO包含结构化推理的冷启动和提示引导的多样化强化学习两个阶段，以激励模型遵循“提出-选择-思考”的轨迹生成多样化且可靠的解决方案。实验结果表明，HDPO能有效提升LLM推理能力，并增加候选解决方案的多样性以及LLM识别可靠解决方案的能力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的提示引导多样化策略优化（HDPO）方法，以增强大型语言模型（LLM）的推理能力。HDPO通过引入一个“提出-选择-思考”的框架，首先引导模型生成多样化的解决方案大纲（提示），然后从中选择最可靠的方案进行深入推理。该方法克服了现有RLVR机制仅关注结果正确性而忽略解决方案多样性的局限性。实验证明，HDPO能够显著提升LLM的推理性能，并增强其生成多样化候选方案和识别可靠解决方案的能力。
AI.keywords: LLM推理, 多样化策略优化, 提示引导, 强化学习, 可靠性
AI.comments: 该研究提出的HDPO方法巧妙地结合了人类解决问题的认知过程，通过引入“提示”机制来鼓励LLM探索和生成多样化的解决方案，这对于提升LLM在复杂推理任务中的表现具有重要意义。未来的工作可以进一步探索不同类型的提示以及它们对模型性能的影响。

title: Low-Frequency Shortcuts in Texture-Driven Visual Learning
summary: Neural networks suffer from shortcut learning, where learned features generalize well to the training set but not to in-distribution (ID) or out-of-distribution (OOD) test sets. Existing studies are all based on a few standard benchmarks, which are shape-driven. Numerous application domains, however, are texture-driven. In this work, we present shortcut learning analysis for texture-driven domains and compare it with that of a standard benchmark. We show that texture-driven domains suffer from low-frequency shortcuts. They make the majority of their decisions based on a few low-frequency components (LFCs) with a skewed spectral behavior, despite that higher-frequency components (HFCs) have higher predictive power. Pruning LFCs from training and test sets mitigates the shortcut and provides a more balanced spectral behavior, improving the ID accuracy by up to 10% and OOD accuracy by up to 40% under algorithmic and real-world domain shifts. We show that general-purpose and domain-specific foundation models can also suffer from low-frequency shortcuts. While large models can mitigate the shortcuts, they incur a high computational cost and may result in a significantly lower accuracy than shortcut-pruned from-scratch trained small models. We show that reduced image resolutions amplify the degree of shortcuts; large frequency-transformation block sizes capture low-frequency shortcuts better than small block sizes; and, low-frequency shortcuts persist across different color spaces. Our findings provide valuable insights, which we hope will be useful for practitioners working on new, understudied domains.

AI.title_translation: 纹理驱动视觉学习中的低频捷径
AI.tldr: 神经网络在纹理驱动任务中存在低频捷径学习问题，即模型依赖预测能力较弱的低频成分。通过裁剪低频成分可显著提高模型在分布内和分布外数据集上的泛化性能，甚至优于大型模型。
AI.motivation: 现有关于捷径学习的研究主要集中在形状驱动的基准测试上，而许多应用领域是纹理驱动的。因此，本文旨在分析纹理驱动领域中的捷径学习，并与标准基准进行比较，以解决其泛化性差的问题。
AI.method: 作者分析了纹理驱动领域中的捷径学习现象。他们发现模型主要依据低频成分做出决策。为了缓解这种捷径学习，他们提出从训练集和测试集中裁剪低频成分的方法。此外，他们还研究了不同图像分辨率、频率变换块大小和颜色空间对低频捷径的影响。
AI.result: 1. 纹理驱动领域存在低频捷径，模型主要基于预测能力较弱的低频成分进行决策。2. 裁剪训练集和测试集中的低频成分可以缓解捷径学习，并提供更平衡的频谱行为。3. 这种裁剪方法使ID准确率提高了10%，OOD准确率在算法和真实世界域转移下提高了40%。4. 通用和领域特定的基础模型也存在低频捷径。5. 大型模型虽然能缓解捷径，但计算成本高，且准确率可能低于经过捷径裁剪的从小模型训练的模型。6. 图像分辨率降低会放大捷径的程度。7. 大的频率变换块大小比小的块大小更能捕捉低频捷径。8. 低频捷径在不同的颜色空间中持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 纹理驱动视觉学习中存在显著的低频捷径问题，通过裁剪低频成分可以有效缓解这一问题，显著提高模型的泛化能力。这些发现为在欠研究领域工作的研究者提供了有价值的见解。
AI.translation: 神经网络存在捷径学习问题，即所学特征在训练集上泛化良好，但在分布内（ID）或分布外（OOD）测试集上表现不佳。现有研究都基于少数几个标准基准，这些基准是形状驱动的。然而，许多应用领域是纹理驱动的。在这项工作中，我们对纹理驱动领域的捷径学习进行了分析，并将其与标准基准进行了比较。我们发现纹理驱动领域存在低频捷径。尽管高频成分（HFCs）具有更高的预测能力，但模型的大多数决策是基于少数几个具有倾斜频谱行为的低频成分（LFCs）做出的。从训练集和测试集中裁剪低频成分可以缓解捷径问题，并提供更平衡的频谱行为，在算法和真实世界域转移下，ID准确率提高了10%，OOD准确率提高了40%。我们发现通用和领域特定的基础模型也可能存在低频捷径。虽然大型模型可以缓解捷径，但它们会产生高昂的计算成本，并且可能导致比经过捷径裁剪的从小模型训练的模型显著更低的准确率。我们发现，图像分辨率降低会放大捷径的程度；大的频率变换块大小比小的块大小更能捕捉低频捷径；并且，低频捷径在不同的颜色空间中持续存在。我们的发现提供了有价值的见解，我们希望这些见解对从事新的、未充分研究领域的从业者有所帮助。
AI.summary: 本文研究了神经网络在纹理驱动视觉学习中存在的低频捷径问题。研究发现，模型在纹理驱动任务中倾向于依赖预测能力较弱的低频成分，而非高频成分。通过从训练和测试数据中裁剪低频成分，可以有效缓解这一问题，显著提高模型在分布内和分布外场景下的泛化性能。研究还指出，即使是大型基础模型也可能存在低频捷径，且裁剪后的小型模型在性能上可能优于未经优化的昂贵大型模型。此外，研究还探讨了图像分辨率、频率变换块大小和颜色空间对低频捷径的影响。
AI.keywords: 捷径学习, 纹理驱动, 低频成分, 泛化能力, 神经网络
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过深入分析纹理驱动任务中的低频捷径学习现象，揭示了神经网络在特定领域泛化能力不足的一个重要原因。其创新之处在于将捷径学习的视角从传统的形状驱动扩展到纹理驱动，并提出了直接裁剪低频成分的有效解决方案，这不仅提高了模型性能，还可能为更高效的模型设计提供思路。论文的发现对于理解和改进神经网络在现实世界纹理复杂场景下的鲁棒性具有重要意义，特别是对于资源有限或需要高泛化能力的特定应用。

title: PatchScene: Patch-based Voxel Diffusion for Large-Scale Scene Completion
summary: We propose PatchScene, a novel diffusion-based framework for large-scale LiDAR scene completion. Unlike existing methods that rely on global latent representations or dense voxel grids, PatchScene adopts a patch-based voxel diffusion paradigm that explicitly generates fine-grained geometry within localized 3D regions. To ensure coherent reconstruction at both spatial and temporal scales, we introduce a confidence-guided spatio-temporal fusion mechanism that integrates overlapping patches and adjacent frames in a unified generative process. Furthermore, we design an Annular-Flow diffusion strategy that leverages the radial density pattern of LiDAR scans to progressively propagate high-fidelity information from near-range to far-range regions, enabling spatially unbounded scene completion. Extensive experiments on the SemanticKITTI benchmark demonstrate that PatchScene achieves state-of-the-art performance across all standard metrics, surpassing previous approaches in both geometric accuracy and temporal consistency. Remarkably, the model trained on 20 m LiDAR ranges generalizes effectively to 50 m scenes without retraining, highlighting its strong scalability and generalization capability for real-world autonomous driving applications. Project page: https://patchscene.github.io/

AI.title_translation: PatchScene：基于补丁的体素扩散用于大规模场景补全
AI.tldr: PatchScene是一个新颖的基于扩散的框架，通过补丁式体素扩散、置信度引导的时空融合以及环形流扩散策略，实现了大规模激光雷达场景补全的最新技术水平，并展现出强大的可扩展性和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的大规模激光雷达场景补全方法依赖于全局潜在表示或密集体素网格，这限制了它们生成精细几何细节的能力。本文旨在通过局部化和分阶段的信息传播来克服这些限制。
AI.method: 本文提出了PatchScene，一个基于补丁的体素扩散范式，显式地在局部3D区域内生成精细几何结构。为确保空间和时间尺度上的连贯重建，引入了置信度引导的时空融合机制，整合重叠补丁和相邻帧。此外，设计了一种环形流扩散策略，利用激光雷达扫描的径向密度模式，从近距离区域逐步向远距离区域传播高保真信息，实现空间无界场景补全。
AI.result: PatchScene在SemanticKITTI基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，在所有标准指标上均超越了现有方法，包括几何精度和时间一致性。值得注意的是，该模型在20米激光雷达范围上训练后，无需重新训练即可有效泛化到50米场景，显示出其强大的可扩展性和对实际自动驾驶应用的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: PatchScene通过其创新的基于补丁的体素扩散、置信度引导的时空融合和环形流扩散策略，成功解决了大规模激光雷达场景补全的挑战，并在性能、可扩展性和泛化能力方面取得了显著提升。
AI.translation: 我们提出了PatchScene，一个用于大规模激光雷达场景补全的新颖的基于扩散的框架。与依赖全局潜在表示或密集体素网格的现有方法不同，PatchScene采用了一种基于补丁的体素扩散范式，在局部3D区域内显式生成精细几何结构。为了确保空间和时间尺度上的连贯重建，我们引入了一种置信度引导的时空融合机制，在一个统一的生成过程中整合重叠补丁和相邻帧。此外，我们设计了一种环形流扩散策略，利用激光雷达扫描的径向密度模式，逐步将高保真信息从近距离区域传播到远距离区域，从而实现空间无界的场景补全。在SemanticKITTI基准测试上的大量实验表明，PatchScene在所有标准指标上都取得了最先进的性能，在几何精度和时间一致性方面均超越了以前的方法。值得注意的是，在20米激光雷达范围上训练的模型无需重新训练即可有效泛化到50米场景，这突显了其在实际自动驾驶应用中的强大可扩展性和泛化能力。项目页面：https://patchscene.github.io/
AI.summary: PatchScene提出了一种新颖的基于补丁的体素扩散框架，用于大规模激光雷达场景补全。它通过在局部3D区域生成精细几何结构，并结合置信度引导的时空融合机制来确保重建的连贯性。此外，其环形流扩散策略能够从近距离到远距离区域传播高保真信息，实现空间无界补全。该方法在SemanticKITTI基准测试上达到了最先进的性能，并在不同激光雷达范围间展现出优异的泛化和可扩展能力。
AI.keywords: 激光雷达场景补全, 体素扩散, 基于补丁, 时空融合, 环形流扩散
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于其独特的基于补丁的体素扩散范式，它避免了现有方法对全局表示或密集体素网格的依赖，从而能够更好地处理大规模场景。置信度引导的时空融合机制和环形流扩散策略是其实现高精度和远距离补全的关键，特别是后者利用了激光雷达数据的特性。模型的强大泛化能力（从20m到50m无需重训练）对于实际自动驾驶应用具有重要意义，显示了其潜在的鲁棒性和实用性。

title: An adaptive Dual-Primal Isogeometric Tearing and Interconnecting (IETI-DP) method for multi-patch structured Kirchhoff--Love plates
summary: We present a novel adaptive isogeometric method for solving the Kirchhoff-Love plate problem for plates whose mid-surface is defined by a planar multi-patch domain with possibly extraordinary vertices, parametrized by an analysis-suitable $G^1$ multi-patch geometry. The proposed technique relies on the concept of Dual-Primal Isogeometric Tearing and Interconnecting (IETI-DP), which enforces the required $C^1$-smoothness of the solution across a common edge of two neighboring patches by imposing appropriate continuity conditions by means of Lagrange multipliers. The resulting saddle point problem is solved using a dual-primal formulation, first by a small linear problem for the Lagrange multipliers and then by local, parallelizable linear problems on the individual patches for the coefficients of the numerical solution. While for the local problems on the single patches standard diagonally scaling is used as preconditioner, a suitable preconditioner for the problem of finding the Lagrange multipliers is introduced. To perform adaptive refinement, the solution of the Kirchhoff-Love plate problem on the single patches of the multi-patch domain is discretized by employing (truncated) hierarchical B-splines, and an appropriate refinement strategy of the underlying mesh is presented. Finally, the potential of the developed adaptive IETI-DP method for solving the Kirchhoff-Love plate problem on planar multi-patch geometries is numerically tested on the basis of several numerical examples. Thereby, the numerical results show on the one hand optimal convergence behavior with respect to adaptive refinement, and on the other hand a good performance of the proposed preconditioner for the linear problem of determining the Lagrange multipliers.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于多块结构化 Kirchhoff-Love 板的自适应双先验等几何撕裂和连接 (IETI-DP) 方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的自适应等几何方法来解决多块结构化 Kirchhoff-Love 板问题，该方法通过对偶-先验 IETI-DP 概念，使用拉格朗日乘子强制执行相邻块之间的连续性，并结合分层 B 样条进行自适应细化，数值结果表明该方法具有最优收敛性和良好的预处理性能。
AI.motivation: 解决多块结构化 Kirchhoff-Love 板问题，特别是处理具有可能存在的奇异顶点以及分析适用 G1 多块几何的板。
AI.method: 提出了一种自适应等几何方法，基于对偶-先验 IETI-DP 概念，通过拉格朗日乘子强制执行连续性，并使用分层 B 样条进行自适应细化。局部问题使用对角线缩放作为预处理，拉格朗日乘子问题采用新引入的预处理。
AI.result: 数值结果显示了自适应细化的最优收敛行为，以及所提出的用于确定拉格朗日乘子的线性问题的预处理器的良好性能。
AI.conclusion: 所开发的自适应 IETI-DP 方法在解决平面多块几何上的 Kirchhoff-Love 板问题方面具有潜力，并表现出最优的收敛性和良好的预处理性能。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种新颖的自适应等几何方法，用于求解 Kirchhoff-Love 板问题，该板的中间曲面由具有可能存在的奇异顶点的平面多块域定义，并由分析适用 $G^1$ 多块几何参数化。所提出的技术依赖于对偶-先验等几何撕裂和连接 (IETI-DP) 的概念，该概念通过施加适当的连续性条件（通过拉格朗日乘子实现）来强制执行两个相邻块的公共边上的所需 $C^1$ 光滑度。所得的鞍点问题通过对偶-先验公式求解，首先通过一个小的线性问题求解拉格朗日乘子，然后通过在各个块上的局部、可并行化的线性问题求解数值解的系数。虽然对于单个块上的局部问题使用标准的对角线缩放作为预处理，但引入了用于求解拉格朗日乘子问题的合适预处理。为了进行自适应细化，通过使用（截断的）分层 B 样条来离散化多块域的单个块上的 Kirchhoff-Love 板问题的解，并提出了底层网格的适当细化策略。最后，基于几个数值示例，对开发的用于求解平面多块几何上的 Kirchhoff-Love 板问题的自适应 IETI-DP 方法的潜力进行了数值测试。由此，数值结果一方面显示了相对于自适应细化的最优收敛行为，另一方面显示了所提出的用于确定拉格朗日乘子的线性问题的预处理器的良好性能。
AI.summary: 该研究介绍了一种新颖的自适应等几何方法，称为 IETI-DP，用于解决多块 Kirchhoff-Love 板问题。该方法利用对偶-先验公式和分层 B 样条来实现自适应细化，并通过专门的预处理器提高了计算效率。数值实验证明了该方法在收敛性和性能方面的有效性。
AI.keywords: 等几何分析, Kirchhoff-Love 板, IETI-DP, 自适应细化, 分层 B 样条
AI.comments: 该研究在等几何分析领域取得了重要进展，特别是在处理复杂几何形状（如多块板）和实现高效自适应细化方面。所提出的 IETI-DP 方法及其预处理器为解决更广泛的工程问题提供了有前景的解决方案。然而，对该方法在不同类型边界条件和材料非线性下的鲁棒性和扩展性的进一步研究将是有益的。

title: Min-Cost Flow Routing for Evidence Assembly in Long Multimodal Documents
summary: Answering questions about long multimodal documents requires distributing a fixed evidence budget across relevant facets in text, tables, figures, and slides while avoiding near-duplicates. We present \flowreader, which formulates evidence selection as a single minimum-cost flow problem with capacity limits over a multimodal content graph. Spectral decomposition identifies latent aspects of query-relevant content and allocates the budget among them in proportion to their spectral energy. These capacity limits enforce aspect coverage during routing without requiring a language-model planning call. Query-conditioned costs prioritize chains of relevant, mutually consistent evidence. Decomposing the optimal flow produces short evidence chains, which a vision-language model reads in parallel and a reasoner reconciles. On VisDoMBench with Qwen3-VL-32B, \flowreader\ achieves the highest macro accuracy ($68.9$), surpassing the strongest prior system by $2.7$ points, leading on three of five subsets and attaining the highest worst-subset accuracy. It uses a measured $17.5$ content nodes per query and maintains its lead at $12.9$. Ablation studies with a fixed graph, scorer, reader, and judge show that cost design drives accuracy, capacity limits preserve it while using about three-quarters of the reader tokens required by shortest-path routing without these limits on the same network, and spectral aspects align with LLM-generated sub-questions without a planning call.

AI.title_translation: 面向长多模态文档证据组装的最小成本流路由
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为\flowreader\的方法，将证据选择问题建模为最小成本流问题，以在长多模态文档中高效分配证据预算，并解决了信息冗余和方面覆盖问题。实验结果表明，\flowreader\在VisDoMBench基准测试中取得了领先的准确率，并能有效减少模型所需的输入量。
AI.motivation: 在长多模态文档中回答问题需要跨越文本、表格、图表和幻灯片等多种模态分配有限的证据预算，同时避免信息重复。现有的方法在处理这种复杂性时存在挑战。
AI.method: 本文提出了\flowreader\，将证据选择构建为一个单一的最小成本流问题，在多模态内容图上设置容量限制来处理潜在的方面和避免信息重复。通过谱分解识别查询相关内容的潜在方面，并按其谱能量比例分配预算。查询条件成本优先考虑相关且一致的证据链。最后，通过分解最优流得到短证据链，供视觉语言模型并行阅读和推理器协调。
AI.result: 在VisDoMBench基准测试和Qwen3-VL-32B模型上，\flowreader\实现了最高的宏观准确率（68.9%），比之前的最佳系统高2.7个百分点。它在五个子集中有三个取得了最高分，并获得了最高的最小子集准确率。该方法平均每个查询使用17.5个内容节点，并且在12.9个节点时仍保持领先地位。消融研究表明，成本设计是准确率的关键，容量限制在保持准确率的同时，相比无容量限制的最短路径路由，减少了约四分之一的阅读器标记使用量。谱方面与未进行规划调用的LLM生成的子问题一致。
AI.conclusion: \flowreader\通过将证据选择建模为最小成本流问题，有效地解决了长多模态文档的证据组装问题。该方法在准确性、效率和资源利用方面均表现出色，并且通过谱分解和容量限制等机制，无需额外的规划调用即可实现对潜在方面和信息冗余的有效管理。
AI.translation: 回答长多模态文档中的问题需要将固定的证据预算分配给文本、表格、图表和幻灯片中的相关方面，同时避免近乎重复的内容。我们提出了\flowreader\，将证据选择问题构建为一个跨越多模态内容图的具有容量限制的单一最小成本流问题。谱分解识别查询相关内容的潜在方面，并按其谱能量比例分配预算。这些容量限制在路由过程中强制执行方面覆盖，而无需进行语言模型规划调用。查询条件成本优先考虑相关且相互一致的证据链。分解最优流可以产生短证据链，视觉语言模型可以并行阅读这些证据链，推理器可以进行协调。在VisDoMBench基准测试和Qwen3-VL-32B模型上，\flowreader\实现了最高的宏观准确率（68.9%），比最强的先前系统高2.7个百分点，在五个子集中的三个上领先，并获得了最高的最小子集准确率。它使用每个查询平均17.5个内容节点，并在12.9个节点时保持领先。消融研究表明，在固定图、评分器、阅读器和判断器的情况下，成本设计驱动了准确率，容量限制在保持准确率的同时，使用的阅读器标记量约为无容量限制的最短路径路由的三分之二，并且谱方面与未进行规划调用的LLM生成的子问题一致。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为\flowreader\的新方法，用于解决长多模态文档的证据组装问题。该方法将证据选择视为一个最小成本流问题，通过谱分解来识别和分配预算给文档的不同方面，并利用容量限制来避免冗余信息和确保方面覆盖。实验证明，\flowreader\在准确率和效率方面均优于现有方法，并且能够减少模型处理的输入量。
AI.keywords: 最小成本流, 证据组装, 多模态文档, 谱分解, 容量限制
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的方法，将复杂的证据组装问题转化为一个明确定义的最小成本流问题，这在理论上和实践上都具有重要意义。通过利用谱分解来识别文档的潜在主题，并结合容量限制来控制信息冗余，该方法有效地提高了在多模态文档上进行问答的准确性和效率。然而，该方法对于图的构建和成本函数的定义可能非常敏感，这可能需要大量的领域知识和调优。此外，虽然减少了阅读器标记的使用量，但谱分解和最小成本流的计算本身可能也需要相当大的计算资源。

title: AgenticNav: Zero-Shot Vision-and-Language Navigation as a Tool-Calling Harness
summary: Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation in continuous environments (VLN-CE) has recently become feasible with large vision-language models (VLMs). Existing methods typically rely on learned waypoint predictors to propose navigable actions. This limits the model's action space and fails to leverage depth inputs effectively. Moreover, memory is commonly handled by accumulating long textual or visual histories, which overwhelms the prompt context. In this paper, we rethink zero-shot VLN-CE as an agentic interface between the VLM and the environment, and present AgenticNav, a lightweight navigation harness that exposes action, depth, and memory as callable tools. Instead of choosing from predicted waypoints, the action tool allows the VLM to directly select a target pixel in RGB observations, converting it into executable motion. Depth is exposed through an on-demand pixel-depth tool, enabling the VLM to request precise metric distances only where they matter. For memory, AgenticNav uses an agentic memory architecture combining reasoning text history and a compact map image, paired with a recall tool that allows the VLM to selectively revisit past visual observations. On R2R-CE, AgenticNav achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) zero-shot performance under same VLM comparison, reaching 76% success rate and 66.50% SPL. Ablation experiments validate the effectiveness of our tool and memory designs, while backbone evaluations demonstrate more consistent navigation gains as VLMs improve, highlighting the harness's potential to benefit from future VLM advances. Real-world experiments on two distinct robotic platforms further demonstrate its zero-shot generalization and adaptability.

AI.title_translation: AgenticNav：零样本视语导航作为一种工具调用框架
AI.tldr: AgenticNav是一个轻量级的导航框架，它将动作、深度和记忆暴露为可调用的工具，使大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够直接与环境交互，实现了最先进的零样本视语导航性能，并在真实机器人平台上展示了泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有的零样本视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）方法依赖于学习到的航点预测器，这限制了动作空间，未能有效利用深度输入，并且在处理长期历史时会因提示上下文过载而导致记忆问题。需要一种新的方法来克服这些限制。
AI.method: AgenticNav将VLN-CE重新构想为VLM与环境之间的代理接口，并将动作、深度和记忆作为可调用的工具。动作工具允许VLM直接选择目标像素进行运动。深度信息通过按需像素深度工具提供。记忆架构结合了推理文本历史和紧凑的地图图像，并配有一个允许VLM选择性地访问过去视觉观察的召回工具。
AI.result: 在R2R-CE数据集上，AgenticNav在相同的VLM比较下实现了最先进的零样本性能，成功率达到76%，SPL为66.50%。消融实验证明了工具和记忆设计的有效性。骨干评估表明，随着VLM的改进，导航增益更加一致。在两个不同的机器人平台上进行的真实世界实验也展示了其零样本泛化和适应性。
AI.conclusion: AgenticNav通过将导航任务重新构想为工具调用问题，并引入创新的动作、深度和记忆工具，显著提高了零样本VLN-CE的性能。该框架不仅在模拟环境中表现出色，还在真实机器人平台上展现了强大的泛化能力，并有望从未来的VLM进步中受益。
AI.translation: 零样本连续环境（VLN-CE）的视觉语言导航最近随着大型视觉语言模型（VLMs）的出现而变得可行。现有方法通常依赖于学习到的航点预测器来提出可导航的动作。这限制了模型的动作空间，并且未能有效地利用深度输入。此外，记忆通常通过累积长文本或视觉历史来处理，这会压垮提示上下文。在本文中，我们重新思考零样本VLN-CE，将其视为VLM和环境之间的代理接口，并提出了AgenticNav，一个轻量级的导航框架，它将动作、深度和记忆暴露为可调用的工具。动作工具允许VLM直接选择RGB观察中的目标像素，并将其转换为可执行的运动，而不是从预测的航点中选择。深度通过按需像素深度工具暴露，使VLM能够仅在需要时请求精确的度量距离。对于记忆，AgenticNav使用一种代理记忆架构，结合推理文本历史和一个紧凑的地图图像，并配有一个召回工具，允许VLM选择性地重新访问过去的视觉观察。在R2R-CE上，AgenticNav在相同的VLM比较下实现了最先进的（SOTA）零样本性能，成功率达到76%，SPL为66.50%。消融实验验证了我们的工具和记忆设计的有效性，而骨干评估则展示了随着VLM的改进，导航增益更加一致，突显了该框架受益于未来VLM进步的潜力。在两个不同的机器人平台上进行的真实世界实验进一步证明了其零样本泛化和适应性。
AI.summary: AgenticNav是一种新颖的零样本视觉语言导航框架，它将导航任务视为一个工具调用问题。通过将动作、深度和记忆作为可调用的工具暴露给大型视觉语言模型（VLMs），AgenticNav克服了传统方法在动作空间限制、深度信息利用不足以及记忆处理方面的局限性。该框架允许VLM直接选择目标像素进行移动，按需请求深度信息，并通过结合文本历史和地图图像的记忆系统来有效管理记忆。实验结果表明，AgenticNav在R2R-CE数据集上取得了最先进的零样本性能，并在真实机器人平台上展示了良好的泛化能力和适应性。
AI.keywords: 零样本导航, 视觉语言导航, 工具调用, 大型视觉语言模型, 代理导航
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的AgenticNav框架，将零样本视觉语言导航（VLN-CE）视为一个工具调用问题，为VLM与环境的交互提供了一个统一的接口。通过将动作、深度和记忆设计为可调用的工具，该方法有效地解决了现有方法的局限性，如动作空间受限、深度信息利用不足和记忆处理困难。特别值得注意的是，AgenticNav能够让VLM直接选择目标像素进行导航，并采用创新的记忆架构来处理长期历史信息，这在提高导航性能方面取得了显著成效。研究结果在模拟和真实世界环境中都得到了验证，证明了该框架的有效性和泛化能力。未来的工作可以进一步探索更复杂的环境和导航任务，以及更先进的VLM模型在该框架下的表现。

title: APT: Action Expert Pretraining Improves Instruction Generalization of Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that couple pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with continuous action experts have achieved strong manipulation performance, yet generalization to out-of-distribution (OOD) language instructions remains poor. A known challenge is the structural imbalance in VLA data, where language is far less diverse than visual and action content, making policies prone to visual shortcuts. While discrete-action methods mitigate this through vision-language co-training, continuous action experts lack such protection: they start from random initialization and learn entirely from imbalanced data, producing noisy gradients that corrupt the VLM and fail to exploit its language capability. We address this from a Bayesian perspective, factorizing the policy into a language-agnostic Vision-Action (VA) prior and a language-conditioned VLA likelihood, and propose APT, a two-stage training method emphasizing Action expert PreTraining. In Stage 1, the action expert is pretrained as a VA prior on vision-action pairs from a frozen VLM, bypassing the language imbalance. In Stage 2, language tokens are injected through a gated fusion mechanism that integrates VLM features while preserving the learned visuomotor prior. APT applies to mainstream VLA architectures, including the $π$ and GR00T-style architectures. Comprehensive experiments validate that APT achieves consistent gains on unseen instructions and compositional tasks. Project Page: https://xukechun.github.io/papers/APT/

AI.title_translation: 行动专家预训练提升视觉-语言-行动策略的指令泛化能力
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为APT的训练方法，通过预先训练行动专家来解决视觉-语言-行动模型在处理新指令时泛化能力差的问题，并在实验中取得了良好效果。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型在处理分布外（OOD）的语言指令时泛化能力较差，主要是因为VLA数据中语言多样性远不如视觉和动作信息，导致模型容易出现视觉捷径。对于连续动作专家，它们从随机初始化开始，直接从不平衡的数据中学习，产生的梯度噪声会干扰视觉语言模型（VLM）并阻碍其利用语言能力。
AI.method: APT方法将策略分解为一个与语言无关的视觉-动作（VA）先验和一个语言条件化的VLA似然。它采用两阶段训练：第一阶段，在冻结的VLM上，仅使用视觉-动作对对行动专家进行预训练，以构建VA先验，从而绕过语言不平衡问题；第二阶段，通过门控融合机制注入语言信息，该机制整合VLM特征，同时保留已学习的视觉运动先验。
AI.result: APT在未见过的指令和组合任务上取得了持续的提升。
AI.conclusion: APT通过预先训练行动专家作为视觉-动作先验，有效解决了VLA模型在指令泛化方面的挑战，并在实验中证明了其有效性。
AI.translation: 将与视觉语言模型（VLM）相结合的预训练视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在连续动作专家方面取得了强大的操控性能，但对分布外（OOD）语言指令的泛化能力仍然很差。一个已知的挑战是VLA数据中的结构不平衡，其中语言的多样性远不如视觉和动作内容，这使得策略容易出现视觉捷径。虽然离散动作方法通过视觉-语言协同训练来缓解这种情况，但连续动作专家缺乏这种保护：它们从随机初始化开始，完全从不平衡的数据中学习，产生嘈杂的梯度，破坏VLM并未能利用其语言能力。我们从贝叶斯角度解决了这个问题，将策略分解为与语言无关的视觉-动作（VA）先验和语言条件化的VLA似然，并提出APT，一种强调行动专家预训练的两阶段训练方法。在第一阶段，行动专家作为VA先验，在来自冻结VLM的视觉-动作对上进行预训练，绕过了语言不平衡。在第二阶段，通过门控融合机制注入语言标记，该机制整合了VLM特征，同时保留了学习到的视觉运动先验。APT适用于主流VLA架构，包括π和GR00T风格的架构。全面的实验验证了APT在未见过的指令和组合任务上取得了持续的收益。项目页面：https://xukechun.github.io/papers/APT/
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为APT（Action Expert Pretraining）的两阶段训练方法，旨在解决现有视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型在处理分布外语言指令时泛化能力不足的问题。APT首先将策略分解为视觉-动作（VA）先验和语言条件化的VLA似然，然后通过预训练行动专家作为VA先验来克服数据中的语言不平衡问题，最后通过门控融合机制整合语言信息。实验表明，APT能够显著提升模型在未见指令和组合任务上的表现。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-行动模型, 指令泛化, 行动专家预训练, 贝叶斯方法, 视觉-动作先验
AI.comments: 该研究提出的APT方法通过巧妙的分解和两阶段训练策略，有效地解决了VLA模型在指令泛化方面的一个关键挑战。特别是，它从贝叶斯视角出发，将问题解耦，并通过预训练行动专家来规避数据不平衡带来的负面影响，这是一种创新且实用的思路。APT能够应用于现有的主流VLA架构，具有良好的兼容性和扩展性。然而，该方法在计算成本和数据需求方面可能需要进一步的评估，并且其在更复杂、更长指令下的泛化能力仍有待探索。

title: Reliability of Probabilistic Emulation of Physical Systems
summary: Two dominant approaches have emerged for generating probabilistic forecasts of physical systems: generative models, such as diffusion or flow matching; and ensembles of deterministic models with stochasticity injected, trained using the continuous ranked probability score (CRPS) loss. While both approaches have demonstrated strong predictive accuracy, the reliability of their uncertainties has not been systematically assessed. We address this gap by developing a framework to evaluate both approaches across diverse 2D spatiotemporal physical systems, under matched model size and computational budget. We assess the reliability of probabilistic emulation by inspecting the empirical coverage of predictive intervals, while also considering accuracy and computational efficiency metrics. CRPS-trained ensembles typically achieve more reliable uncertainties on both single-step prediction and autoregressive rollouts, demonstrating better coverage than the standard alternative of training generative models in a latent space. Moreover, the CRPS approach offers significantly faster inference. When generative models are trained in ambient rather than a compressed latent space, which is often infeasible for high-dimensional problems, they exhibit comparable coverage to CRPS-trained ensembles, though with substantially larger inference latency. In contrast, when CRPS-trained ensembles are trained in latent space they do not show a marked degradation in coverage with respect to ambient space. Both generative models and CRPS-trained ensembles demonstrate good predictive accuracy. To facilitate future research and application, we release AutoCast, a modular framework implementing both generative models and CRPS-trained ensembles, alongside AutoSim, a flexible dataset generation package for rapid prototyping.

AI.title_translation: 物理系统概率仿真的可靠性
AI.tldr: CRPS训练的集成模型在不确定性可靠性方面优于生成模型，并且推理速度更快，而生成模型在非压缩空间中表现相当，但推理速度较慢。
AI.motivation: 评估生成模型和CRPS训练集成模型在预测物理系统时的概率预测不确定性的可靠性。
AI.method: 在一个框架下，通过检查预测区间经验覆盖率、准确性和计算效率指标，评估了两种方法在各种2D时空物理系统上的表现，并对模型大小和计算预算进行了匹配。
AI.result: CRPS训练的集成模型在单步预测和自回归预测中具有更可靠的不确定性，覆盖率优于在潜在空间中训练的生成模型，并且推理速度显著更快。在非压缩空间中训练的生成模型覆盖率相当，但推理延迟更高。CRPS训练的集成模型在潜在空间中训练时，覆盖率没有明显下降。两种模型在预测准确性方面都表现良好。
AI.conclusion: CRPS训练的集成模型在不确定性可靠性和计算效率方面通常优于生成模型，尤其是在推理速度方面。然而，生成模型在非压缩空间中训练时也能提供可靠的不确定性估计。
AI.translation: 两种生成概率物理系统预报的主流方法是：生成模型（如扩散或流匹配）；以及通过连续排序概率得分（CRPS）损失训练的注入随机性的确定性模型集成。虽然这两种方法都显示出强大的预测准确性，但它们不确定性的可靠性尚未得到系统评估。我们通过开发一个框架来解决这一差距，该框架在匹配模型大小和计算预算的情况下，在各种2D时空物理系统上评估这两种方法。我们通过检查预测区间的经验覆盖率来评估概率仿真的可靠性，同时还考虑了准确性和计算效率指标。CRPS训练的集成模型在单步预测和自回归滚动预测中通常能获得更可靠的不确定性，其覆盖率优于在潜在空间中训练生成模型的标准替代方法。此外，CRPS方法提供了显著更快的推理速度。当生成模型在环境空间而非压缩潜在空间（对于高维问题通常不可行）中训练时，它们的覆盖率与CRPS训练的集成模型相当，但推理延迟要大得多。相比之下，当CRPS训练的集成模型在潜在空间中训练时，它们的覆盖率与环境空间相比没有明显下降。生成模型和CRPS训练的集成模型都显示出良好的预测准确性。为了促进未来的研究和应用，我们发布了AutoCast，一个实现了生成模型和CRPS训练集成模型的模块化框架，以及AutoSim，一个用于快速原型设计的灵活数据集生成包。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了两种用于物理系统概率预测的方法：生成模型和CRPS训练的集成模型。通过在统一框架下进行评估，发现CRPS训练的集成模型在不确定性可靠性和推理速度方面通常优于生成模型。尽管生成模型在非压缩空间中训练时也能提供可靠的不确定性，但其推理速度较慢。研究还提出了AutoCast和AutoSim工具包以支持未来研究。
AI.keywords: 概率仿真, 不确定性可靠性, 生成模型, CRPS集成模型, 时空预测
AI.comments: 该研究系统地评估了两种主流概率预测方法在物理系统中的不确定性可靠性，弥补了现有研究的空白。CRPS训练集成模型的优势在不确定性可靠性和计算效率方面得到了明确的体现，这对于实际应用具有重要意义。然而，生成模型在非压缩空间中的表现也为特定场景提供了参考。AutoCast和AutoSim的发布将极大地促进相关领域的研究和应用。

title: Rethinking RAG in Long Videos: What to Retrieve and How to Use It?
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is extending beyond text to long videos, where query-relevant chunks can be represented across multiple modalities and temporal granularities. Progress in this setting, VideoRAG, is limited by two gaps: existing benchmarks allow queries to be answered without the video, obscuring retrieval errors, and prior methods apply a single modality-granularity configuration per query, ignoring chunk-level variability. We address both by introducing V-RAGBench, a benchmark of $\langle$query, evidence chunk, answer$\rangle$ triplets over hour-scale videos, in which each answer depends on a unique evidence chunk, enabling decoupled evaluation of retrieval and generation, and CARVE, a training-free method that runs parallel retrievers across configurations and uses chunk-adaptive reranking to select a winning configuration for each chunk, which is then carried into generation. On V-RAGBench, CARVE outperforms eight recent VideoRAG baselines on both stages, with the evidence it supplies to the generator interleaving multiple configurations rather than sharing one. Its gains hold across egocentric and third-person long videos and extend to an expanded configuration space.

AI.title_translation: 重新思考长视频中的RAG：检索什么以及如何使用？
AI.tldr: VideoRAG面临基准和单模态配置的限制。本文介绍了V-RAGBench基准和CARVE方法，CARVE通过多模态检索和自适应重排显著优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的VideoRAG研究存在两个问题：1) 基准测试允许在没有视频的情况下回答查询，掩盖了检索错误；2) 先前方法对每个查询应用单一的模态-粒度配置，忽略了块级别的可变性。
AI.method: 提出了V-RAGBench，一个包含<查询, 证据块, 答案>三元组的基准，其中每个答案都依赖于唯一的证据块，从而能够解耦评估检索和生成。同时提出了CARVE，一个免训练方法，它并行运行多个检索器，跨不同配置进行检索，并使用块自适应重排为每个块选择最佳配置，然后将其用于生成。
AI.result: 在V-RAGBench上，CARVE在两个阶段都优于八个最新的VideoRAG基线。它向生成器提供的证据是多种配置的交错，而不是单一配置。其优势在自我中心和第三人称长视频中均成立，并扩展到更广阔的配置空间。
AI.conclusion: CARVE通过引入V-RAGBench和其创新的多模态、块自适应检索策略，显著提升了长视频RAG的性能，解决了现有方法的局限性。
AI.translation: 检索增强生成正在从文本扩展到长视频，其中与查询相关的块可以以多种模态和时间粒度表示。在这种设置（VideoRAG）中的进展受到两个差距的限制：现有基准允许在没有视频的情况下回答查询，掩盖了检索错误；以及先前的方法对每个查询应用单一的模态-粒度配置，忽略了块级别的可变性。我们通过引入V-RAGBench来解决这两个问题，V-RAGBench是一个在小时级视频上的<查询、证据块、答案>三元组基准，其中每个答案都依赖于唯一的证据块，从而能够解耦评估检索和生成；我们还引入了CARVE，这是一种免训练方法，它在不同配置下并行运行检索器，并使用块自适应重排为每个块选择一个获胜配置，然后将其用于生成。在V-RAGBench上，CARVE在两个阶段都优于八个最新的VideoRAG基线，它提供给生成器的证据是多种配置的交错，而不是共享一个配置。其增益在自我中心和第三人称长视频中均保持，并扩展到更广阔的配置空间。
AI.summary: 本文针对长视频检索增强生成（VideoRAG）的现有局限性，提出了V-RAGBench基准和CARVE方法。V-RAGBench通过独有的证据块实现检索与生成的解耦评估。CARVE则通过并行多配置检索和块自适应重排，为每个视频块选择最佳模态-粒度配置，显著提升了在长视频RAG任务上的性能，超越了现有基线。
AI.keywords: 长视频RAG, 检索增强生成, V-RAGBench, CARVE, 多模态检索
AI.comments: 这篇论文通过引入新的基准V-RAGBench和创新的CARVE方法，解决了长视频RAG领域中存在的关键问题。V-RAGBench的解耦评估能力对于准确衡量检索和生成性能至关重要。CARVE的亮点在于其免训练、多模态并行检索和块自适应重排策略，能够更好地适应长视频中复杂的模态和时间粒度变化，具有重要的实用价值和研究意义。

title: Mental-R1: Aligning LLM Reasoning for Mental Health Assessment
summary: Mental health problems such as anxiety, depression, and suicide remain urgent global challenges, where timely and accurate assessment is critical for effective intervention. Recently, large language models have been explored for mental health assessment. However, existing general-purpose post-training methods do not align with the cognitive processes of human assessment, which may lead to unreliable reasoning outcomes. To bridge this gap, we propose Cognitive Relative Policy Optimization (CRPO), a reinforcement learning framework tailored for the mental health domain. CRPO extends group relative policy optimization by integrating stage-dependent uncertainty modeling into the policy optimization process. Specifically, we introduce a stage-wise entropy regularization mechanism that encourages broad exploration in early reasoning phases and progressively enforces confident decision-making in later stages, mimicking the human cognitive shift from uncertainty to certainty. In addition, inspired by cognitive appraisal theory, we formalize cognitive reasoning stages, thereby guiding theory-grounded interpretable inference. Experiments on 8 mental health datasets show that CRPO achieves an average improvement of 10.4 percentage points in weighted F1-score over the best reinforcement learning baseline. Furthermore, the CRPO-trained model Mental-R1 demonstrates clear advantages compared with existing large language models on reasoning-intensive cases, suggesting that CRPO enhances reasoning capabilities for mental health assessment.

AI.title_translation: Mental-R1：对齐大语言模型推理以进行心理健康评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出CRPO强化学习框架，通过模拟人类认知过程，提升大语言模型（LLM）在心理健康评估中的推理可靠性和准确性，在8个数据集上F1-score平均提升10.4%。
AI.motivation: 焦虑、抑郁、自杀等心理健康问题是全球性的紧迫挑战，及时准确的评估至关重要。现有大语言模型（LLM）在心理健康评估方面的探索缺乏与人类认知过程的对齐，导致推理结果不可靠。
AI.method: 本文提出了认知相对策略优化（CRPO），一个为心理健康领域定制的强化学习框架。CRPO通过整合阶段依赖的不确定性建模来扩展组相对策略优化。具体来说，它引入了阶段性熵正则化机制，鼓励在早期推理阶段进行广泛探索，并在后期阶段逐步强制执行自信决策，模仿人类从不确定性到确定性的认知转变。此外，受认知评价理论启发，该框架形式化了认知推理阶段，以指导基于理论的可解释推理。
AI.result: 在8个心理健康数据集上的实验表明，CRPO比最佳强化学习基线在加权F1-score上平均提高了10.4个百分点。此外，经过CRPO训练的模型Mental-R1在推理密集型案例上与现有大语言模型相比表现出明显优势，表明CRPO增强了心理健康评估的推理能力。
AI.conclusion: CRPO框架通过对齐大语言模型推理与人类认知过程，显著增强了其在心理健康评估中的推理能力，并提供了更可靠和可解释的评估结果。
AI.translation: 焦虑、抑郁和自杀等心理健康问题仍然是紧迫的全球挑战，及时准确的评估对于有效干预至关重要。最近，大语言模型已被探索用于心理健康评估。然而，现有的通用后训练方法并未与人类评估的认知过程对齐，这可能导致不可靠的推理结果。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了认知相对策略优化（CRPO），一个为心理健康领域量身定制的强化学习框架。CRPO通过将阶段依赖的不确定性建模整合到策略优化过程中来扩展组相对策略优化。具体来说，我们引入了一种阶段性熵正则化机制，鼓励在早期推理阶段进行广泛探索，并在后期阶段逐步强制执行自信决策，模仿人类从不确定性到确定性的认知转变。此外，受认知评价理论的启发，我们形式化了认知推理阶段，从而指导了基于理论的可解释推理。在8个心理健康数据集上的实验表明，CRPO比最佳强化学习基线在加权F1-score上平均提高了10.4个百分点。此外，经过CRPO训练的模型Mental-R1在推理密集型案例上与现有大语言模型相比表现出明显优势，这表明CRPO增强了心理健康评估的推理能力。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为认知相对策略优化（CRPO）的强化学习框架，旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在心理健康评估中推理与人类认知过程不对齐的问题。CRPO通过阶段性熵正则化机制模拟人类从不确定到确定的认知转变，并在认知评价理论的指导下形式化推理阶段。实验证明，CRPO在8个心理健康数据集上显著提升了评估的F1-score，并使训练出的模型Mental-R1在推理密集型任务上优于现有LLM，从而增强了LLM在心理健康评估中的推理能力和可靠性。
AI.keywords: 心理健康评估, 大语言模型, 强化学习, 认知相对策略优化, 推理对齐
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了CRPO框架，通过模仿人类认知过程中的不确定性到确定性转变，并结合认知评价理论来指导LLM的推理，从而提高了心理健康评估的准确性和可解释性。这对于提升LLM在专业领域应用的可靠性具有重要意义，特别是在需要高度准确性和敏感性的医疗健康领域。

title: Last But Not Least: Boundary Attention CalibratiON for Multimodal KV Cache Compression
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong vision-language reasoning but incur large KV caches and high decoding latency with long visual contexts. Existing compression methods rely on observation window attention for stable token importance estimation, yet this aggregation can dilute sparse critical evidence and discard answer-relevant tokens under aggressive compression. We identify last query attention as a complementary signal for recovering such evidence, though its irrelevant signals may introduce additional noise. We propose BACON, a plug-and-play method that calibrates observation window attention with last query evidence while suppressing noise through intra-layer coherence and inter-layer persistence. Across diverse benchmarks, models, budgets, and compression methods, BACON improves multimodal KV-cache compression by 7.5% on average under the most aggressive budget, with gains up to 30.9%.

AI.title_translation: 最后但并非最不重要：用于多模态KV缓存压缩的边界注意力校准
AI.tldr: BACON是一种即插即用的方法，通过校准观察窗口注意力并抑制噪声，显著提高了多模态KV缓存压缩的性能，解决了现有方法在积极压缩下可能丢失关键信息的问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）在长视觉上下文下存在KV缓存过大和解码延迟高的问题。现有压缩方法依赖观察窗口注意力，但这种聚合可能稀释关键证据并丢弃与答案相关的token。
AI.method: 我们提出了BACON，一种即插即用的方法，利用最后查询注意力作为补充信号来恢复关键证据。它通过层内一致性和层间持久性来校准观察窗口注意力，同时抑制不相关信号引入的噪声。
AI.result: 在各种基准、模型、预算和压缩方法中，BACON在最激进的预算下平均将多模态KV缓存压缩性能提高了7.5%，最高增益达到30.9%。
AI.conclusion: BACON通过有效校准观察窗口注意力并抑制噪声，显著提升了多模态KV缓存压缩的性能，解决了现有方法在积极压缩下丢失关键信息的问题，并展现出广泛的适用性和显著的性能提升。
AI.translation: 多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）实现了强大的视觉-语言推理能力，但在长视觉上下文下会产生巨大的KV缓存和高解码延迟。现有的压缩方法依赖于观察窗口注意力来稳定地估计token重要性，然而这种聚合在积极压缩下可能会稀释稀疏的关键证据并丢弃与答案相关的token。我们发现最后查询注意力是恢复此类证据的补充信号，尽管其不相关信号可能会引入额外的噪声。我们提出了BACON，一种即插即用的方法，它通过最后查询证据校准观察窗口注意力，同时通过层内一致性和层间持久性抑制噪声。在各种基准、模型、预算和压缩方法中，BACON在最激进的预算下平均将多模态KV缓存压缩性能提高了7.5%，最高增益达到30.9%。
AI.summary: 本文提出BACON，一种即插即用的多模态KV缓存压缩方法，旨在解决现有方法在积极压缩多模态大型语言模型（MLLMs）时可能丢失关键视觉信息的问题。BACON通过利用最后查询注意力作为补充信号，校准观察窗口注意力并抑制噪声，从而恢复被稀释的关键证据。实验结果表明，BACON在多种设置下显著提升了KV缓存压缩性能，平均提高7.5%，最高达30.9%。
AI.keywords: 多模态大型语言模型, KV缓存压缩, 注意力校准, 最后查询注意力, 观察窗口注意力
AI.comments: BACON的创新点在于引入了“最后查询注意力”作为补充信号来弥补传统“观察窗口注意力”在积极压缩下丢失关键信息的缺陷。通过结合层内一致性和层间持久性来抑制噪声，该方法展现出鲁棒性和有效性。作为一个即插即用的方法，BACON具有很高的实用价值和广泛的应用潜力，可以显著提高MLLMs的效率。

title: ROVE: Unlocking Human Interventions for Humanoid Manipulation via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human interventions provide crucial corrective signals for post-training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models. However, enabling seamless humanoid interventions is a formidable systems challenge due to complex whole-body kinematics and dexterous-hand control. Consequently, the collected intervention trajectories are often suboptimal, and methods that rely on human interventions as expert supervision can absorb hesitant, inefficient, or even erroneous behaviors. To address both the system and algorithmic challenges, we propose ROVE, a reinforcement learning framework for humanoid VLA post-training with imperfect human interventions. First, ROVE introduces a human-in-the-loop pipeline capable of collecting deployment and intervention data for humanoid manipulation. Second, it utilizes Optimistic Value Estimation (OVE) to prioritize high-value behaviors from mixed-quality trajectories. To further robustify value estimation, we incorporate cross-embodiment human experience videos to provide rich supervision for long-tailed failure and recovery modes. The resulting critic yields informative advantage signals, steering the VLA actor to focus on high-value behaviors rather than indiscriminately imitating all actions. On challenging real-world contact-rich and fine-grained humanoid manipulation tasks, ROVE outperforms experience-learning baselines and consistently improves across multiple rollout-intervention iterations.

AI.title_translation: ROVE：通过强化学习解锁人类干预在人形机器人操控中的应用
AI.tldr: 提出ROVE强化学习框架，通过乐观价值估计（OVE）处理不完美的人类干预数据，显著提升了人形机器人的操控能力。
AI.motivation: 虽然人类干预能为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的后训练提供关键纠正信号，但由于人形机器人全身运动学和灵巧手控制的复杂性，收集到的干预轨迹往往是次优的，盲目模仿会导致迟疑、低效甚至错误的行为。因此需要一种算法来处理不完美的人类干预。
AI.method: 提出ROVE框架，包含一个用于收集人形操控部署与干预数据的“人在回路”管线；采用乐观价值估计（OVE）从未优化轨迹中优先选择高价值行为；并结合跨具身人类经验视频为长尾失败与恢复模式提供丰富监督。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的真实世界接触密集和细粒度人形操控任务中，ROVE优于现有的经验学习基线，并在多个 rollout-intervention 迭代中表现出持续的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: ROVE框架成功解决了人形机器人复杂全身动力学与灵巧手控制中的人类干预难题，通过强化学习与乐观价值估计过滤并利用亚优干预数据，显著提升了人形机器人在接触密集、细粒度操控任务中的性能。
AI.translation: 人类干预为视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的后训练提供了至关重要的纠正信号。然而，由于复杂的全身运动学和灵巧手控制，实现无缝的人类干预是一个巨大的系统挑战。因此，收集到的干预轨迹往往是次优的，依赖人类干预作为专家监督的方法会吸收犹豫不决、低效甚至错误的行为。为了解决系统和算法上的挑战，我们提出了ROVE，这是一个利用不完美人类干预进行人形VLA后训练的强化学习框架。首先，ROVE引入了一个“人在回路”管线，能够收集用于人形操控的部署和干预数据。其次，它利用乐观价值估计（OVE）来优先处理混合质量轨迹中的高价值行为。为了进一步增强价值估计的鲁棒性，我们结合了跨具身人类经验视频，为长尾失败和恢复模式提供丰富的监督。由此产生的评判器（critic）产生了信息丰富的优势信号，引导VLA动作器专注于高价值行为，而不是盲目模仿所有动作。在具有挑战性的真实世界接触密集和细粒度人形操控任务中，ROVE优于经验学习基线，并在多个 rollout-intervention 迭代中持续改进。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ROVE，这是一个针对人形机器人视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型后训练的强化学习框架，专门用于处理不完美的人类干预。该框架通过“人在回路”管线收集数据，并利用乐观价值估计（OVE）和跨具身人类经验视频，引导VLA模型聚焦于高价值行为，从而在复杂的真实世界人形操控任务中取得优异性能。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人操控, 视觉-语言-动作模型, 人类干预, 强化学习, 乐观价值估计
AI.comments: 本文针对人形机器人操控中人类干预数据质量参差不齐的痛点，创新性地结合了强化学习与乐观价值估计（OVE），并引入跨具身人类经验视频，有效提升了VLA模型的后训练性能。该方法系统与算法并重，具有很强的实用价值和创新性。

title: Dissecting model behavior through agent trajectories
summary: AI agent performance is not just a modeling problem, it is fundamentally a systems problem. The advanced capabilities of models are realized through agent harnesses. Therefore, a gap between model assumptions and harness behavior can easily prevent the model's full capabilities from translating into agent performance. We formalize this as the `intent-execution' gap: the mismatch between what the model intends and what the harness executes, and vice versa. We argue that minimizing this intent-execution gap is as important as other aspects of harness design such as tools and execution loops. To illustrate the impact of this harness-model alignment, we develop a simple and customizable harness called `Simple Strands Agent' (SSA). SSA aims to find the bulk of common patterns which generalize across different model families (such as Claude, Gemini, GPT, Grok, Qwen), as well as a small number of model-specific preferences. We make two contributions: (i) we \textbf{reproduce or improve on the pass@1} performance reported by diverse model-provider families on popular agentic benchmarks (SWE-Pro, SWE-Verified, Terminal-Bench-2, and Deep-SWE), and (ii) building on an \textbf{analysis of 154\texttt{k} trajectories generated by SSA}, we look beyond the \texttt{pass@1} numbers which tend to be relatively even across frontier models. By representing agent trajectories in code state-spaces, we compute solution distance and backtracking to observe model-level differences in problem-solving behavior. Finer-grained metrics such as edit frequency, testing activity, and phase-transitions reveal how individual models allocate effort across different stages of problem solving.

AI.title_translation: 通过智能体轨迹剖析模型行为
AI.tldr: 本文通过引入“意图-执行”差距的概念，并利用154k条智能体运行轨迹的代码状态空间分析，揭示了不同AI模型在解决问题时的行为和策略差异。
AI.motivation: AI智能体性能不仅取决于模型本身，还取决于智能体框架（harness）。模型假设与框架行为之间的差距（即“意图-执行”差距）往往阻碍了模型全部能力的发挥，因此需要分析和最小化这一差距。
AI.method: 开发了一个简单且可定制的智能体框架“Simple Strands Agent”（SSA），并基于SSA生成的154k条轨迹，在代码状态空间中计算解决方案距离、回溯、编辑频率、测试活动和阶段转换等精细指标。
AI.result: 复现或超越了各大模型提供商在热门智能体基准测试（SWE-Pro, SWE-Verified, Terminal-Bench-2, Deep-SWE）上的pass@1性能；通过分析154k条轨迹，揭示了不同模型在问题解决过程中的行为差异及努力分配情况。
AI.conclusion: 通过最小化“意图-执行”差距并利用轨迹分析，可以更深入地理解AI智能体底层的模型行为差异，超越传统的单一指标。
AI.translation: AI智能体的性能不仅仅是一个建模问题，从根本上讲也是一个系统问题。模型的先进能力是通过智能体框架实现的。因此，模型假设与框架行为之间的差距很容易阻碍模型的全部能力转化为智能体性能。我们将此形式化为“意图-执行”差距：模型意图与框架执行之间的不匹配，反之亦然。我们认为，最小化这一意图-执行差距与工具和执行循环等其他框架设计方面一样重要。为了说明这种框架-模型对齐的影响，我们开发了一个简单且可定制的名为“Simple Strands Agent”（SSA）的框架。SSA旨在寻找跨不同模型家族（如Claude、Gemini、GPT、Grok、Qwen）通用的常见模式，以及少量的模型特定偏好。我们做出了两项贡献：(i) 我们复现或改进了多样化模型提供商家族在流行智能体基准测试（SWE-Pro、SWE-Verified、Terminal-Bench-2和Deep-SWE）上报告的pass@1性能，以及 (ii) 基于对SSA生成的154k条轨迹的分析，我们超越了在各前沿模型中往往相对均衡的pass@1数字。通过将智能体轨迹表示为代码状态空间，我们计算了解决方案距离和回溯，以观察问题解决行为中的模型级差异。编辑频率、测试活动和阶段转换等更细粒度的指标揭示了各个模型如何在问题解决的不同阶段分配精力。
AI.summary: 该论文探讨了AI智能体中模型假设与框架行为之间的“意图-执行”差距，并提出了Simple Strands Agent（SSA）框架。通过对154k条轨迹的代码状态空间分析，论文超越了传统的pass@1指标，深入揭示了不同前沿模型在问题解决过程中的行为特征和差异。
AI.keywords: AI agents, intent-execution gap, agent trajectories, code state-spaces, model behavior
AI.comments: 该论文指出了AI智能体性能不仅是模型问题，还是系统问题，并首次形式化了“意图-执行”差距的概念。通过开发通用且可定制的SSA框架，结合对15k条轨迹的代码状态空间分析，揭示了不同前沿模型在解决问题时的行为差异，具有重要的实践意义和方法论创新。

title: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Generalist Robot Policies
summary: Generalist robot policies, such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) and world-action models (WAMs), combine powerful pretrained backbones with expressive generative action heads trained via flow matching on large-scale robotic datasets. Despite their strong empirical performance in robotic manipulation, these policies lack mechanisms to quantify confidence in their predictions and to detect when their actions may be unreliable. This presents a critical limitation for real-world deployment in non-stationary environments, where models inevitably encounter scenarios outside their pretraining distribution and may fail without warning. To address this, we derive an efficient method to quantify epistemic uncertainty in flow-matching models by leveraging velocity-field disagreement (VFD) across a small ensemble. We successfully use this uncertainty estimate for detecting failures during deployment and active fine-tuning of flow-based generalist policies. For the latter, we propose SAVE, a simple yet effective method for uncertainty-guided active multitask fine-tuning that reduces the number of costly expert demonstrations required to adapt generalist policies to new tasks. We conduct experiments in simulation and the real world, across VLAs and a WAM. VFD yields better-calibrated uncertainty estimates predictive of downstream performance and detects failures with 8 pp higher overall accuracy than existing methods. Across three real-world tasks, SAVE improves final average success from 39 % to 47 % with a fixed demonstration budget. Our results show that measuring epistemic uncertainty with VFD enhances both failure awareness and adaptation of generalist robot policies. Project website: tum-lsy.github.io/uq_generalist_policies.

AI.title_translation: 面向流程匹配的通才机器人策略的不确定性量化
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为速度场不一致性（VFD）的有效方法，用于量化流程匹配（flow-matching）模型的不确定性，以提高通用机器人策略在现实世界部署中的可靠性，并提出了一种名为SAVE的方法，用于不确定性引导的主动多任务微调，以减少适应新任务所需的专家演示数量。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用机器人策略（如VLA和WAM）在实际应用中缺乏量化预测置信度和检测不可靠动作的机制，这在非平稳环境中是一个关键限制。
AI.method: 提出了一种高效的速度场不一致性（VFD）方法，利用小型集成模型之间的速度场差异来量化流程匹配模型的不确定性。在此基础上，提出了一种名为SAVE（不确定性引导的主动多任务微调）的方法。
