AI.title_translation: PTNO：使用带噪声的蒙特卡洛估计训练粒子输运问题的神经算子
AI.tldr: PTNO 提出了一种利用带噪声的低成本蒙特卡洛样本直接训练神经算子的方法，解决了粒子输运中高昂的模拟成本问题，实现了数量级的加速。
AI.motivation: 高保真的蒙特卡洛模拟在粒子输运中计算成本极高，而基于学习的替代模型通常依赖于昂贵且收敛的蒙特卡洛解，这限制了其效率；因此，需要开发一种能够直接从带噪声、低成本的蒙特卡洛标签中进行有效训练的神经算子方法。
AI.method: 提出粒子输运神经算子 (PTNO)，在物理空间中使用带有 softplus 输出层的神经网络以保持正定性，并采用逐点相对 $L_2$ 损失（PRelL2）来处理高动态范围问题，直接基于带噪声的低成本蒙特卡洛标签进行学习。
AI.result: 在两个中子学任务中，PTNO 比同等 CPU 上的收敛蒙特卡洛快 $10^4$-$10^5$ 倍，在匹配精度下成本低 $10^3$-$10^5$ 倍；在两个辐射传热任务中，匹配精度下的蒙特卡洛成本是 PTNO 的 $0.8$-$11$ 倍。
AI.conclusion: PTNO 成功实现了利用带噪声的低成本蒙特卡洛估计来训练高效的粒子输运神经算子，克服了高方差和高动态范围的挑战，在核子学和辐射传热任务中取得了数量级级别的加速和成本节约。
AI.translation: 多重散射下的粒子输运是辐射传输和等离子体物理的核心，但高保真的蒙特卡洛（MC）模拟必须追踪过多的粒子。基于学习的代理模型可以分摊这一成本，但通常依赖于昂贵且充分收敛的 MC 解。我们提出了粒子输运神经算子（PTNO），这是一种直接从带噪声、低成本的 MC 标签学习粒子输运代理模型的神经算子。此类标签带来两个挑战：(1) 高方差，这会破坏标准监督学习的稳定性；(2) 跨越多个数量级的高动态范围（HDR）。针对第一个挑战，我们从多个配置的带噪声标签中学习解算子，以分摊 MC 成本并泛化到未见过的配置。由于 MC 标签是无偏的，我们证明了它们上面的平方损失与收敛解上的损失具有相同的极小值，并且我们在训练场景 $M$、每个渲染的 MC 样本数 $N$ 以及每个场景的独立渲染数 $K$ 上的预算分配研究表明，许多带噪声的场景优于少数收敛的场景。针对第二个挑战，诸如对数之类的非线性变换会使带噪声的监督产生偏差。相反，PTNO 将标签保留在物理空间中，并通过 softplus 输出层强制实施正定性，从而有效地表示小值。我们进一步使用逐点相对 $L_2$ 损失（PRelL2）进行训练，这是 HDR 去噪和神经渲染的梯度停止相对损失，它用梯度停止预测而不是带噪声的标签来归一化每个残差。我们在聚变反应堆的中子输运和参与介质中的辐射传热上展示了 PTNO。在两个中子学任务中，PTNO 在相同的 CPU 上比收敛的 MC 快 $10^4$-$10^5$ 倍，在匹配精度下比 MC 便宜 $10^3$-$10^5$ 倍；在两个辐射传热任务中，匹配精度下的 MC 成本是 PTNO 的 $0.8$-$11$ 倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了粒子输运神经算子（PTNO），该方法绕过了对高成本、收敛蒙特卡洛解的需求，通过解决高方差和高动态范围（HDR）的挑战，直接利用带噪声的低成本蒙特卡洛估计进行训练，在粒子输运问题中实现了显著的计算加速和成本节约。
AI.keywords: 粒子输运, 神经算子, 蒙特卡洛模拟, 辐射传热, 高动态范围 (HDR)
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出直接利用带噪声的低成本蒙特卡洛样本训练神经算子，解决了传统代理模型对高精度、高成本收敛解的依赖。通过引入无偏估计的理论分析、预算分配研究、正定性保证的softplus输出层以及逐点相对L2损失函数（PRelL2），有效克服了高方差和高动态范围（HDR）带来的挑战。在核聚变反应堆中子输运和辐射传热等任务中展现出显著的加速效果和计算成本优势，具有极高的实用价值和理论意义。

title: Pricing Time, Not Just Tokens: Latency-Aware Mechanism Design for LLM Inference
comments: 28 pages, 1 figure. Paper appears in the proceedings of the 27th ACM Conference on Economics & Computation (EC'26)
summary:
The economic theory of LLM pricing treats tokens as a homogeneous commodity considering aggregate token count as the main features buyers and sellers consider. We model inference as a service market where buyers have three-dimensional private information - willingness-to-pay, task volume, and time preference - and utility depends on latency slack alongside token quantities.
  Our main result is a separation theorem: discrete hardware tiers induce endogenous self-selection on time preferences, reducing three-dimensional screening to standard one-dimensional screening within each tier. We derive the cost structure from GPU inference physics - compute-bound prefill and bandwidth-bound decode - and characterize optimal tiered mechanisms via virtual-value techniques. Optimal per-task prices are volume-independent, providing theoretical grounding for flat per-token API pricing.
  We verify the mechanism empirically by calibrating to 8-GPU clusters of H100 and B200 hardware. The separation theorem holds in 83% of 105 tested configurations overall, rising to 96% at economically relevant WTP scales. A seller adopting two-tier pricing under the optimal mechanism captures 26-66% higher profit than the best single-tier alternative, with gains driven by efficient cross-tier allocation in regimes where hardware costs are a significant fraction of per-request value.

AI.title_translation: 给时间定价，而不仅仅是Token：面向大语言模型推理的延迟感知机制设计
AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种大模型推理的延迟感知定价机制，证明了硬件分层能有效通过自选择实现降维筛选，阶梯定价可大幅提升服务商利润。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLM经济学定价理论将token视为同质化商品，忽视了买家对推理延迟的敏感性以及异构硬件带来的性能差异，因此需要开发一种考虑延迟感知的机制设计框架。
AI.method: 通过建模买家三维隐私信息（支付意愿、任务体量、时间偏好），结合GPU推理物理学（计算受限的预填充和带宽受限的解码），推导最优的阶梯机制并使用虚拟价值技术，同时利用H100和B200集群进行经验验证。
AI.result: 分离定理在83%（经济相关规模下为96%）的测试配置中成立；采用最优两层定价机制的卖家比最佳单层定价替代方案多获利26-66%。
AI.conclusion: 离散硬件层级能够有效诱导用户按时间偏好自选择，最优的阶梯定价机制可显著提升服务商的利润，且理论上支撑了扁平化的按token定价。
AI.translation:
LLM定价的经济学理论将token视为同质化商品，将聚合token数量视为买卖双方考虑的主要特征。我们将推理建模为一个服务市场，其中买家具备三维私人信息——支付意愿、任务体量和时间偏好——且效用取决于延迟余量以及token数量。
我们的主要结果是一个分离定理：离散的硬件层级在时间偏好上诱导了内生的自我选择，将每个层级内的三维筛选简化为标准的一维筛选。我们从GPU推理物理学（计算受限的预填充和带宽受限的解码）推导出了成本结构，并通过虚拟价值技术刻画了最优阶梯机制。每个任务的最优价格与体量无关，这为平面按token的API定价提供了理论基础。
我们通过校准H100和B200硬件的8-GPU集群，对该机制进行了实证验证。在所有105个测试配置中，分离定理在83%的情况下成立，在经济相关的WTP（支付意愿）规模下上升至96%。采用最优机制的两层定价卖家比最佳单层定价替代方案获取高出26-66%的利润，这些收益由硬件成本占请求价值显著比例情况下的高效跨层分配所驱动。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种面向LLM推理的延迟感知机制设计，通过建模三维买家偏好并结合GPU物理特性，证明了硬件分层可实现有效的时间偏好自选择，从而推导出更优的阶梯定价机制并显著提升卖家利润。
AI.keywords: 大模型推理, 定价机制, 延迟感知, 硬件分层, 机制设计
AI.comments: 该论文从经济学和系统架构结合的视角切入，将延迟感知（Latency-awareness）引入大模型推理定价机制，具有很高的理论创新性和实际应用价值。其证明了离散硬件层级可将多维筛选转化为一维筛选，解释了当前平面按token定价的理论基础，并通过H100/B200集群验证了多层定价的显著利润增益。

title: OverdoseMoE: A Multi-Expert Framework for Opioid Overdose Risk Prediction
summary: Opioid overdose remains a major clinical and public health burden, highlighting the need for scalable approaches to identify patients at high risk. Here, we investigate diagnosis-specific adaptation for 180-day opioid overdose risk prediction from patients' preceding one-year longitudinal ICD histories. We develop OODMAMBA and OODQWEN through continued pretraining on longitudinal diagnostic sequences followed by task-specific fine-tuning. Building on the stronger Qwen-based predictors, we further propose OVERDOSEMOE, a multi-expert framework that integrates models of different scales using complementary expert-weighting strategies. Diagnosis-specific adaptation consistently improved predictive performance over general-purpose language-model baselines, with OODQWEN achieving an AUPRC of 24.47 and an AUROC of 68.56. OVERDOSEMOE further improved discrimination and precision, achieving an AUPRC of 25.17 and an AUROC of 69.49 while outperforming the strongest single-model baselines. Among patients ranked in the top 5% of predicted risk, OVERDOSEMOE identified substantially enriched overdose risk, achieving a PPV of 25.38% while retaining meaningful recall. Evaluation on an independent MIMIC-IV cohort further demonstrated cross-cohort robustness, with complementary weighting strategies showing advantages across different performance measures. These findings demonstrate that diagnosis-specific language-model adaptation combined with multi-expert integration can improve opioid overdose risk stratification and support more robust prediction across heterogeneous electronic health record populations.

AI.title_translation: OverdoseMoE：一个用于阿片类药物过量风险预测的多专家框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多专家框架（OVERDOSEMOE）和诊断特定大语言模型的方法，用于精准预测阿片类药物过量风险。
AI.motivation: 阿片类药物过量仍是重大的临床和公共卫生负担，亟需可扩展的方法来识别高风险患者。
AI.method: 开发了OODMAMBA和OODQWEN模型（通过纵向诊断序列的持续预训练和任务特定微调），并进一步基于Qwen模型提出了多专家框架OVERDOSEMOE，整合了不同规模和采用互补专家加权策略的模型。
AI.result: OODQWEN取得了24.47的AUPRC和68.56的AUROC；OVERDOSEMOE进一步将性能提升至AUPRC 25.17和AUROC 69.49，在排名前5%的高危患者中实现了25.38%的PPV，并在独立MIMIC-IV队列中验证了跨队列的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 诊断特定的大语言模型适应结合多专家集成策略，能有效提升阿片类药物过量风险预测的准确性，并支持在异构电子健康记录人群中的鲁棒预测。
AI.translation: 阿片类药物过量仍然是沉重的临床和公共卫生负担，这凸显了对识别高风险患者的可扩展方法的迫切需求。本文研究了基于患者前一年纵向ICD历史的180天阿片类药物过量风险预测的诊断特定适应性。通过对纵向诊断序列进行持续预训练并进行任务特定微调，我们开发了OODMAMBA和OODQWEN。在更强的Qwen基预测器基础上，我们进一步提出了OVERDOSEMOE，这是一个利用互补专家加权策略集成不同规模模型的多专家框架。与通用语言模型基线相比，诊断特定适应性持续提高了预测性能，其中OODQWEN实现了24.47的AUPRC和68.56的AUROC。OVERDOSEMOE进一步提高了区分度和精确度，实现了25.17的AUPRC和69.49的AUROC，同时超越了最强的单模型基线。在预测风险排名前5%的患者中，OVERDOSEMOE识别出了大幅富集的过量风险，在保持有意义的召回率的同时，实现了25.38%的PPV。在独立MIMIC-IV队列上的评估进一步证明了跨队列的鲁棒性，互补加权策略在不同的性能指标上展现出优势。这些发现表明，诊断特定的语言模型适应与多专家集成相结合，可以改善阿片类药物过量风险分层，并支持在异构电子健康记录人群中进行更鲁棒的预测。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为OVERDOSEMOE的多专家框架，结合诊断特定的大语言模型微调，用于预测患者180天内的阿片类药物过量风险。实验证明该方法在预测精度和跨队列鲁棒性上均优于单模型基线。
AI.keywords: 阿片类药物过量风险预测, 大语言模型, 混合专家模型, 纵向诊断历史, 电子健康记录
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将大语言模型（如Mamba和Qwen）结合诊断特定适应性（Diagnosis-specific adaptation）与混合专家模型（MoE）框架应用于阿片类药物过量风险预测，显著提升了预测精度和跨队列的鲁棒性。

title: Tactile Curiosity Drives Robot Interaction
comments: 16 pages, 6 figures, 1 table. Preprint, under review
summary: Mastering robot manipulation skills via reinforcement learning (RL) remains largely sample-inefficient. The most common RL algorithms rely on random action sampling to discover new strategies, resulting in agents that allocate most of their training budget to motions in free space, away from the contacts from which manipulation skills emerge. Existing intrinsic motivation methods based on model disagreement or epistemic uncertainty improve on isotropic noise, but they can also reward uncertainty in functionally irrelevant transitions, such as erratic motions in free space. In this work, we argue that tactile feedback provides a natural signal for exploration, and introduce TacEx, a framework that incorporates touch into epistemic uncertainty-driven exploration by decomposing model uncertainty across sensory modalities and directing curiosity toward the tactile channel. By anchoring curiosity to the sense of touch, TacEx drives the robot to discover complex contact dynamics, learning to manipulate and grasp objects without task rewards or expert demonstrations during exploration. The interaction-dense dataset collected through this tactile-driven curiosity supports offline learning of downstream pick-and-place policies without additional environment interaction. We further use tactile-driven exploration to post-train vision-language-action (VLA) models. Although the VLAs are initially pre-trained without tactile feedback, post-training with TacEx substantially improves downstream performance while remaining highly sample-efficient.

AI.title_translation: 触觉好奇心驱动机器人交互
AI.tldr: 本文提出TacEx框架，通过将机器人的好奇心引导至触觉通道，解决了强化学习中探索效率低下、过度关注自由空间的问题，实现了高效的无监督机器人抓取学习与视觉-语言-动作模型的后训练。
AI.motivation: 传统的强化学习依赖随机动作采样，导致机器人在自由空间浪费大量训练预算，而现有的基于模型分歧或不确定性的内在动机方法容易奖励功能无关的自由空间不确定动作。因此需要利用触觉反馈作为自然探索信号，以克服样本效率低下的问题。
AI.method: 提出了TacEx框架，将触觉融入认知不确定性驱动的探索中，通过分解不同模态的模型不确定性并将好奇心引导至触觉通道，从而收集交互密集的触觉数据集用于下游离线学习和VLA模型后训练。
AI.result: TacEx驱动机器人发现了复杂的接触动力学，学会了在没有任务奖励或专家示范的情况下抓取和操作物体；收集的数据集成功支持了下游抓取策略的离线学习，并显著提升了视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型微调后的下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 触觉驱动的好奇心（TacEx）能有效指导机器人在没有任务奖励或专家示范的情况下学习复杂的接触动力学，极大地提升了下游抓取任务及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型微调的样本效率。
AI.translation: 通过强化学习掌握机器人操作技能往往样本效率极低。最常见的RL算法依赖于随机动作采样来发现新策略，导致智能体将其大部分训练预算分配给自由空间中的运动，而远离了产生操作技能的接触点。现有的基于模型分歧或认知不确定性的内在动机方法改善了各向同性噪声的问题，但它们也可能奖励功能上不相关的转换中的不确定性，例如自由空间中的不规则运动。在这项工作中，我们认为触觉反馈为探索提供了自然的信号，并介绍了TacEx框架，该框架通过跨感觉模态分解模型不确定性并将好奇心引导至触觉通道，将触觉纳入认知不确定性驱动的探索中。通过将好奇心锚定在触觉上，TacEx驱动机器人发掘复杂的接触动力学，在探索过程中无需任务奖励或专家示范即可学习操纵和抓取物体。通过这种触觉驱动的好奇心收集到的交互密集型数据集，支持了下游抓取放置策略的离线学习，且无需额外的环境交互。我们进一步利用触觉驱动的探索来对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行后训练。尽管VLA最初是在没有触觉反馈的情况下进行预训练的，但通过TacEx进行后训练显着提高了下游性能，同时保持了极高的样本效率。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了TacEx框架，它将触觉反馈融入基于认知不确定性的探索中，通过将好奇心导向触觉通道来驱动机器人与环境交互，从而高效学习复杂的接触动力学并改善下游操作策略与VLA模型的性能。
AI.keywords: 触觉探索, 强化学习, 内部动机, 机器人操作, 视觉-语言-动作模型
AI.comments: 该论文通过引入触觉好奇心驱动（TacEx）解决了传统强化学习在机械臂操作中样本效率低、盲目探索自由空间的问题。创新点在于将认知不确定性分解到不同模态并聚焦于触觉，对于无监督机器人操作学习和多模态模型后训练具有重要意义。

title: Learning Skills from Historical Action Trajectories: Action Experience Dictionary for World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) couple visual dynamics prediction with action generation, yet they do not explicitly support the reuse of action experience across manipulation tasks. Furthermore, existing WAMs struggle to capture underlying cross-task semantic relationships that could guide target action prediction, as redundant background elements interfere with the extraction of key visual information. To address these challenges, we develop a novel Action Experience Dictionary (AED) that encodes historical physical action trajectories into shared action embeddings to support skill reuse and model cross-task relationships. Specifically, we first aggregate historical actions to align with visual observations and retrieve action embeddings from the AED using a pretrained action tokenizer. Subsequently, we visually condition the pooled embeddings through cross-attention and prepend them to noisy action tokens, providing interaction context and action intent for prediction. To model action-related motion and reduce reliance on irrelevant background cues, we introduce a motion-aware transition loss that supervises visual feature change prediction over random temporal intervals. Experiments on simulation benchmarks and in real-world cross-embodiment settings verify the effectiveness of our AED. The project code is available at https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED .

AI.title_translation: 从历史动作轨迹中学习技能：用于世界动作模型的动作经验字典
AI.tldr: 本文提出动作经验字典（AED），通过编码历史动作为共享嵌入来支持机器人的跨任务技能复用和世界动作模型优化。
AI.motivation: 现有的世界动作模型（WAMs）无法显式支持跨操作任务的动作经验复用，且由于冗余背景元素的干扰，难以捕捉指导目标动作预测的跨任务语义关系。
AI.method: 提出动作经验字典（AED）将历史物理动作轨迹编码为共享动作 embeddings 以支持技能复用；利用预训练动作 tokenizer 从 AED 中检索动作 embeddings 并通过交叉注意力进行视觉条件化；引入运动感知过渡损失来模拟与动作相关的运动并减少背景干扰。
AI.result: 在模拟基准测试和真实世界的跨具身设置中的实验验证了 AED 的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 论文提出的Action Experience Dictionary（AED）和运动感知过渡损失能有效促进跨任务技能复用并提高动作预测精度，在模拟和真实世界实验中均得到了验证。
AI.translation: 世界动作模型（WAMs）将视觉动态预测与动作生成相结合，但它们并未明确支持跨操作任务的动作经验复用。此外，现有的 WAMs 难以捕捉可以指导目标动作预测的潜在跨任务语义关系，因为冗余的背景元素会干扰关键视觉信息的提取。为了解决这些挑战，我们开发了一种新颖的动作经验字典（AED），它将历史物理动作轨迹编码为共享的动作嵌入，以支持技能复用并建模跨任务关系。具体来说，我们首先聚合历史动作以与视觉观察对齐，并使用预训练的动作分词器从 AED 中检索动作嵌入。随后，我们通过交叉attention对汇聚的嵌入进行视觉条件化，并将它们前置到嘈杂的动作标记中，为预测提供交互上下文和动作意图。为了对动作相关的运动进行建模并减少对不相关背景线索的依赖，我们引入了一种运动感知过渡损失，监督随机时间间隔内的视觉特征变化预测。在模拟基准和真实世界跨具身设置上的实验验证了我们 AED 的有效性。项目代码可在 https://github.com/JiahuaDong/AED 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了动作经验字典（AED）和运动感知过渡损失，旨在解决世界动作模型（WAMs）中缺乏跨任务技能复用和抗背景干扰能力弱的问题，实验证明了其有效性。
AI.keywords: World Action Models, Action Experience Dictionary, Skill Reuse, Motion-Aware Transition Loss, Robotic Manipulation
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地引入了动作经验字典（AED）和运动感知过渡损失，解决了世界动作模型（WAMs）在跨任务技能复用和消除背景干扰方面的不足，对机器人操作和世界模型的发展具有重要意义。

title: Skill-Based AI Agents for Power-System Studies
comments: submitted to 2027 IEEE PES Grid Edge Technologies Conference & Exposition
summary: This paper describes a skill-based agentic framework for power-system studies using Model Context Protocol (MCP)-connected engineering tools. A custom MCP server was developed to expose Siemens PTI PSSE functions for power-flow analysis, dynamic simulation, result extraction, and model-validation workflows. Two implementation pathways built on a programmable OpenAI Agents software development kit (SDK) and a Claude Code command-line interface (CLI) were evaluated, both using reusable skills, subagents, MCP tools, data-repository connections, and local shell/Python execution. Both frontier-model-based implementations successfully executed representative study tasks. Success was evaluated based on task completion, output accuracy, and the need for human expert interventions. Results based on public datasets show that agentic systems can greatly accelerate power system dynamic simulation process for transmission planning studies leveraging industry-grade simulation platforms. This points toward a shift in transmission planning practice, where agentic systems could handle routine simulation setup and result extraction, allowing engineers to focus expert judgment on scenario design and interpretation rather than tool operation.

AI.title_translation: 用于电力系统研究的基于技能的AI智能体
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于技能的AI智能体框架，利用模型上下文协议（MCP）连接工业级电力系统仿真工具（如PSSE），显著加速了输电规划的动态仿真和结果提取过程。
AI.motivation: 为了利用前沿大语言模型和基于技能的智能体框架，加速电力系统研究中的常规仿真设置和结果提取过程，减少对繁琐工具操作的人工依赖。
AI.method: 开发了自定义MCP服务器以公开Siemens PTI PSSE功能，并评估了基于OpenAI Agents SDK和Claude Code CLI的两种实现途径，结合可重用技能、子智能体、MCP工具及本地shell/Python执行。
AI.result: 两种基于前沿模型的实现方式均成功执行了代表性研究任务，在任务完成度、输出准确性以及减少人工干预方面表现优异，显著加速了传输规划研究的动态仿真过程。
AI.conclusion: 基于技能的智能体框架能够显著加速电力系统动态仿真与传输规划进程，将工程师从繁琐的工具操作中解放出来，转向更具价值的场景设计与结果解释。
AI.translation: 本文描述了一个用于电力系统研究的基于技能的智能体框架，该框架使用了模型上下文协议（MCP）连接的工程工具。开发了一个自定义的MCP服务器，以公开用于潮流分析、动态仿真、结果提取和模型验证工作流的西门子PTI PSSE功能。评估了基于可编程OpenAI Agents软件开发工具包（SDK）和Claude Code命令行界面（CLI）构建的两条实现路径，两者均使用了可重用的技能、子智能体、MCP工具、数据仓库连接以及本地shell/Python执行。两种基于前沿模型的实现都成功执行了代表性研究任务。成功标准基于任务完成度、输出准确性以及对人类专家干预的需求。基于公共数据集的结果表明，智能体系统可以利用工业级仿真平台大大加速传输规划研究的电力系统动态仿真过程。这指明了传输规划实践的转变方向，即智能体系统可以处理常规的仿真设置和结果提取，使工程师能够将专业判断集中在场景设计和解释上，而不是工具操作上。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于技能的智能体框架，利用模型上下文协议（MCP）连接工程工具（如Siemens PTI PSSE），实现了电力系统分析、动态仿真和结果提取的自动化。研究评估了基于OpenAI和Claude的两种实现路径，证明了智能体系统能够大幅加速电力系统传输规划中的仿真流程。
AI.keywords: 电力系统研究, 智能体框架, 模型上下文协议 (MCP), 输电规划, 动态仿真
AI.comments: 本文创新性地引入了基于技能的智能体框架与模型上下文协议（MCP），实现了大语言模型与电力系统工业级仿真工具（PSSE）的无缝集成，极大地提升了输电规划研究的自动化水平和效率。局限性在于主要验证了常规仿真设置和结果提取，对复杂场景设计仍需人工干预。

title: Cogentic: Multi-Agent Orchestration for Automated Proof Discovery
summary: We present Cogentic, a multi-agent harness for automated proof discovery on open research problems. While frontier language models can generate strong mathematical ideas in a single shot, single-shot generation is often insufficient for open problems that require exploring multiple competing conjectures, overcoming subtle technical obstructions, and retaining intermediate progress over a long horizon. Cogentic addresses these challenges through an iterative prove-verify loop in which an orchestrator allocates a population of independent provers across distinct proof directions, subjects their output to adversarial verification by several specialized components, and promotes confirmed intermediate results into a persistent verified ledger that later rounds build on. The harness is designed to be able to solve research-level math and theoretical computer science problems. Using either Gemini 3.1 Pro or an early version of Gemini 4 Argon as the base model, Cogentic produced novel results on open problems across online learning, auction theory, and mechanism design. Each result was independently verified by domain experts and is developed in full in companion papers. We list these results, and new ones as they are verified, at https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic .

AI.title_translation: Cogentic：用于自动化证明发现的多智能体编排系统
AI.tldr: Cogentic 是一个多智能体自动化证明发现框架，通过迭代式的“证明-验证”循环和持久账本机制，成功利用前沿大语言模型解决了在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计等领域的开放性数学难题。
AI.motivation: 虽然前沿语言模型可以在单次生成中产生强大的数学构想，但单次生成通常不足以应对需要探索多种竞争性猜想、克服微妙技术障碍并在长期内保留中间进展的开放性研究问题。
AI.method: 提出了一个名为 Cogentic 的多智能体框架，采用迭代的“证明-验证”循环：由一个调度器（orchestrator）将独立的证明者群体分配到不同的证明方向，通过多个专门组件进行对抗性验证，并将确认的中间结果提升为持久的验证账本，供后续轮次构建。
AI.result: 利用 Gemini 3.1 Pro 或早期版本的 Gemini 4 Argon 作为基础模型，Cogentic 在在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计等开放性问题上产出了新颖的结果，且每一项成果都已通过领域专家的独立验证。
AI.conclusion: Cogentic 证明了多智能体协作、迭代证明-验证循环以及持久账本机制能够有效赋能前沿大语言模型，使其能够攻克在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计等领域的开放性研究难题，并产出经专家验证的全新理论成果。
AI.translation: 我们提出了 Cogentic，这是一个用于在开放性研究问题上进行自动化证明发现的多智能体框架。虽然前沿语言模型可以在单次生成中产生强有力的数学构想，但单次生成往往不足以应对那些需要探索多个竞争猜想、克服微妙技术障碍并在漫长周期内保留中间进展的开放性问题。Cogentic 通过迭代的“证明-验证”循环来应对这些挑战：在此循环中，一个编排器将一组独立的证明者分配到不同的证明方向，将其输出交由几个专门的组件进行对抗性验证，并将确认的中间结果提升为一个持久的已验证账本，供后续轮次在此基础上构建。该框架旨在解决研究级别的数学和理论计算机科学问题。以 Gemini 3.1 Pro 或早期版本的 Gemini 4 Argon 作为基础模型，Cogentic 在在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计等开放性问题上取得了新颖的成果。每项成果都经过领域专家的独立验证，并在相关配套论文中得到了完整的发展。我们将这些成果以及随着验证通过而产生的新成果列在 https://sites.google.com/view/cogentic 上。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了 Cogentic，一个用于自动发现开放性研究问题证明的多智能体系统。通过结合迭代证明-验证循环、独立的证明者群体搜索和持久的验证账本，该系统有效地支持了前沿语言模型在长期、复杂的数学和理论计算机科学问题上的探索，并在多个领域取得了经专家验证的创新成果。
AI.keywords: 多智能体编排, 自动化定理证明, 开放性研究问题, 对抗性验证, 长期推理
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的多智能体协作架构 Cogentic，用于解决开放性研究问题的自动化证明发现。通过结合交织的“证明-验证”循环、独立推理者的群体搜索以及持久的验证账本，该框架成功克服了单轮大语言模型在处理长期、复杂数学问题时的局限性，并在在线学习、拍卖理论和机制设计等领域取得了经专家验证的创新成果，展现出极高的学术研究价值。

title: The kernel-block rank profiles of the $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-linear and the $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-linear Hadamard codes, and a complete classification of the $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-linear Hadamard codes
summary: The kernel of a binary code containing the zero word partitions the binary coordinates into blocks, two coordinates lying in the same block when every kernel word takes the same value in both, and the \emph{kernel-block rank profile} is the multiset of the dimensions of its linear span punctured on those blocks. For the family $H^{t_1,t_2,t_3}$ of $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-linear Hadamard codes, this invariant is known explicitly and gives a complete classification of the family. In this paper, we compute it for the $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-linear and $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-linear Hadamard families with which those codes are compared, and we prove that it is constant for every nonlinear $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-linear Hadamard code and for every nonlinear $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-linear Hadamard code $\bar H^{a_1,\dots,a_s}$ with $s\geq2$. The second statement is obtained without any rank formula, by exhibiting coordinate permutations that preserve the code and act transitively on its kernel blocks, which makes the argument uniform in $s$. We also prove a descent theorem: if $\bar H^{a_1,\dots,a_s}$ is nonlinear and $a_1\geq2$, then the code punctured on one kernel block is the $\mathbb{Z}_{2^{s-1}}$-linear Hadamard code $\bar H^{a_1,\dots,a_{s-1}}$. Consequently, the constant local rank equals $rank(\bar H^{a_1,\dots,a_{s-1}})$ and is at least $t-κ+2$, where $2^t$ is the length and $κ$ the kernel dimension. These results separate every nonlinear $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-linear Hadamard code from every $\mathbb{Z}_4$-linear, $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-linear and $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-linear Hadamard code of the same length, except for the single infinite family $H^{1,1,t-4}$ and $\bar H^{2,0,t-5}$ with $t\geq5$. The members of this infinite family agree in the rank, kernel dimension and the kernel-block rank profile, but a two-block refinement separates them.

AI.title_translation: $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性与 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-线性 Hadamard 码的核-块秩剖面及 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-线性 Hadamard 码的完全分类
AI.tldr: 通过计算 kernel-block rank profile 不变量，实现了对多类线性 Hadamard 码的分类与区分。
AI.motivation: 为了对比并完善 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-线性 Hadamard 码的分类，需要研究 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性及 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-线性 Hadamard 码的 kernel-block rank profile 这一不变量。
AI.method: 计算了 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性及 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-线性 Hadamard 码族的 kernel-block rank profile，利用坐标置换证明了其在非线性情况下的常数性，并证明了一个下降定理。
AI.result: 证明了该不变量对所有非线性 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性 Hadamard 码以及 $s\geq2$ 的非线性 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-线性 Hadamard 码是常数，给出了下降定理，并成功将几乎所有的非线性 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-线性 Hadamard 码与其他 Hadamard 码区分开来。
AI.conclusion: 通过 kernel-block rank profile 不变量成功对多类 Hadamard 码进行了区分和完全分类。
AI.translation: 包含零码的二进制码的核将二进制坐标划分为块，当每个核字在两个坐标中取相同值时，这两个坐标位于同一块中，而“核-块秩剖面”是其在线性跨度上穿孔这些块的维数的多重集。对于 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-线性 Hadamard 码族 $H^{t_1,t_2,t_3}$，该不变量是显式已知的，并给出了该族的完全分类。在本文中，我们计算了与这些码进行比较的 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性谱和 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-线性 Hadamard 族的该不变量，并证明了对于每个非线性 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性 Hadamard 码以及对于 $s\geq2$ 的每个非线性 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-线性 Hadamard 码 $\bar H^{a_1,\dots,a_s}$，它是常数。第二个陈述是在没有任何秩公式的情况下获得的，通过展示保持码并不在其核块上可递作用的坐标置换，这使得 $s$ 的论证统一。我们还证明了一个下降定理：如果 $\bar H^{a_1,\dots,a_s}$ 是非线性的且 $a_1\geq2$，则在单个核块上穿孔的码是 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^{s-1}}$-线性 Hadamard 码 $\bar H^{a_1,\dots,a_{s-1}}$。因此，常数局部秩等于 $rank(\bar H^{a_1,\dots,a_{s-1}})$ 且至少为 $t-\kappa+2$，其中 $2^t$ 是长度，$\kappa$ 是核维数。这些结果将每个非线性 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-线性 Hadamard 码与相同长度的每个 $\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性、$\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性以及 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-线性 Hadamard 码区分开来，但单个无限族 $H^{1,1,t-4}$ 和带有 $t\geq5$ 的 $\bar H^{2,0,t-5}$ 除外。该无限族的成员在秩、核维数和核-块秩剖面上一致，但两块精细化将它们分开了。
AI.summary: 本文计算了 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4$-线性与 $\mathbb{Z}_{2^s}$-线性 Hadamard 码的 kernel-block rank profile，证明了其在非线性情况下的常数性，给出了下降定理，并以此完成了 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-线性 Hadamard 码的完全分类与码间区分。
AI.keywords: Hadamard codes, kernel-block rank profile, linear codes over rings, $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-linear codes, classification
AI.comments: 该论文深入研究了不同环上线性 Hadamard 码的 kernel-block rank profile 不变量，证明了其在非线性情况下的常数性质，并给出了 $\mathbb{Z}_2\mathbb{Z}_4\mathbb{Z}_8$-线性 Hadamard 码的完全分类，创新性强，方法巧妙。

title: Retrospective Open-Vocabulary Memory for Long-Term Object Search
summary: Long-term object search requires learning where objects usually appear from repeated but uneven observations of a changing environment. We formulate retrospective open-vocabulary memory as probabilistic inference from censored observations, where the key idea is to reason with evidence per opportunity: a detection or non-detection should influence belief only in proportion to the robot's opportunity to observe the corresponding location. We introduce ECROM, which uses this principle to estimate long-term prevalence for concepts specified only at query time and converts the resulting belief directly into an active-search prior. To evaluate this problem, we introduce a controlled long-term benchmark in ten HM3D homes that independently varies object placement and observation opportunity across repeated traversals. ECROM improves support-level AP on held-out queries by 4.5 points and search SPL by 4.2 points over the strongest competing memory in each metric. The benchmark, dataset, and code will be open-sourced. Project page: https://jiaming.im/ecrom/

AI.title_translation: 用于长期目标搜索的回顾式开放词汇记忆
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ECROM的长期开放词汇目标搜索方法，通过结合观察机会的概率推理，显著提升了机器人在动态环境中的搜索效率和准确性。
AI.motivation: 长期目标搜索需要从重复且不均衡的环境观察中学习物体的常驻位置，现有方法难以有效处理查询时才指定的开放词汇概念以及观察机会不均的问题。
AI.method: 提出ECROM方法，将回顾式开放词汇记忆建模为基于删失观测的概率推理，根据机器人的观察机会对检测或未检测到的证据进行加权，并将信念直接转换为主动搜索先验。
AI.result: 在包含10个HM3D家庭的控制长期基准测试中，ECROM的支持级别AP比最强对比方法提升了4.5个百分点，搜索SPL提升了4.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: ECROM方法有效解决了长期环境中的开放词汇目标搜索问题，通过显式建模观察机会提升了记忆准确率和主动搜索性能。
AI.translation: 长期目标搜索需要通过对变化环境中重复但不均衡的观察，来学习物体通常出现的位置。我们将回顾式开放词汇记忆（retrospective open-vocabulary memory）建模为来自删失观测的概率推理，其核心思想是根据每个机会的证据进行推理：检测或未检测应该仅按机器人观察相应位置的机会比例来影响信念。我们引入了ECROM，它利用这一原则来估计仅在查询时指定的概念的长期流行度，并将产生的信念直接转换为主动搜索先验。为了评估这个问题，我们在十个HM3D住宅中引入了一个受控的长期基准测试，该测试在重复遍历中独立地改变物体放置和观察机会。在每个指标上，ECROM在保留查询上的支持级别AP比最强的竞争记忆提高了4.5个点，搜索SPL提高了4.2个点。该基准测试、数据集和代码将开源。项目页面：https://jiaming.im/ecrom/
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于长期目标搜索的回顾式开放词汇记忆方法（ECROM），通过基于观察机会的概率推理来估计任意查询概念的长期存在概率，并将其转化为主动搜索先验，实验证明该方法在准确率和搜索性能上均优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 长期目标搜索, 开放词汇记忆, 概率推理, 主动搜索, 具身智能
AI.comments: 本文针对长期目标搜索任务，提出了回顾式开放词汇记忆（ECROM）方法，通过基于观察机会的概率推理来估计长期物体存在概率，具有很强的创新性和实用性。

title: The Conflict Between Logic and Memory: Training Conditions for Optimizer-Dependent Rule Acquisition
summary: Optimizers can fit the same task while acquiring different generalizing relations. We study the training conditions governing these differences in single-hidden-layer ReLU networks, combining composite evidence tasks, parameter-level interventions, and a three-seed strict-parity scan. Our central finding is that nuisance-connected trainability reshapes both shared failures and relative optimizer advantages. In a nuisance-heavy task, all twenty tested optimizer configurations remain near chance on the hardest stage. Retaining every input but fixing nuisance-connected first-layer weights at initialization raises that stage's accuracy from approximately 50\% to 70.56\%, 68.47\%, and 69.00\% for momentum SGD, Adam, and Muon. Masking the same inputs only after full training does not recover this performance. On a separate pairwise-mode task, background freezing reduces Muon's rare-mode advantage over momentum SGD by 12.48 percentage points, while the target and mode frequencies remain fixed. Each intervention is evaluated under a common validation-selection protocol with condition-specific learning rates and checkpoints. A strict-parity sweep over orders 1--20 provides a complementary reference without spurious cues or extra nuisance coordinates: the optimizers separate at orders 9--11, then approach chance despite substantial remaining Bayes predictability. A mixed task establishes a recovery boundary, and CIFAR-10 supplies an external architecture comparison. Together, these findings connect optimizer comparison to the acquisition and use of specified relations, identifying permitted adaptation as a concrete training variable that changes what a fixed architecture learns.

AI.title_translation: 逻辑与记忆的冲突：优化器依赖规则获取的训练条件
AI.tldr: 优化器依赖的规则获取受训练条件的强烈调控，允许的适应性（如无用特征的权重冻结）能够显著改变神经网络所学到的泛化关系。
AI.motivation: 优化器可以在拟合相同任务的同时获取不同的泛化关系，本文旨在研究单隐层ReLU网络中控制这些差异的训练条件。
AI.method: 结合了复合证据任务、参数级干预、三种子严格奇偶校验扫描、混合任务以及CIFAR-10外部架构比较，并在通用验证选择协议、条件特定学习率和检查点下评估各项干预。
AI.result: 在无用特征较重的任务中，固定初始化时无用特征连接的第一层权重将最困难阶段的准确率从约50%提升至约68%-70%；而在成对模式任务中，背景冻结减少了Muon相比动量SGD的稀有模式优势12.48个百分点。严格奇偶校验扫描显示优化器在9-11阶分离。
AI.conclusion: 优化器依赖的规则获取受训练条件（如无用特征连通性）的强烈调控。允许的适应性是一个关键的训练变量，它决定了固定架构所学习的内容。
AI.translation: 优化器可以在拟合相同任务的同时获取不同的泛化关系。我们研究了单隐层ReLU网络中控制这些差异的训练条件，结合了复合证据任务、参数级干预和一个三种子严格奇偶校验扫描。我们的核心发现是，无用特征连接的可训练性重塑了共享失败和相对优化器优势。在一个无用特征较重的任务中，所有二十个测试的优化器配置在最困难阶段仍保持在随机水平附近。在保留所有输入但将初始化时的无用特征连接第一层权重固定时，该阶段的准确率对于动量SGD、Adam和Muon分别从约50%提升至70.56%、68.47%和69.00%。在完全训练后才对这些输入进行掩码则无法恢复此性能。在另一个成对模式任务中，背景冻结将Muon相比动量SGD的稀有模式优势降低了12.48个百分点，而目标和模式频率保持固定。每一项干预都在具有条件特定学习率和检查点的通用验证选择协议下进行评估。对1-20阶进行的严格奇偶校验扫描提供了一个没有虚假线索或额外无用坐标的补充参考：优化器在9-11阶分离，随后尽管仍有显著的贝叶斯可预测性，但趋近于随机水平。一个混合任务确立了恢复边界，CIFAR-10提供了外部架构比较。总之，这些发现将优化器比较与指定关系的获取和使用联系起来，将允许的适应性确定为一个具体的训练变量，它改变了固定架构所学习的内容。
AI.summary: 本文研究了控制单隐层ReLU网络中优化器依赖规则获取差异的训练条件。研究发现，无用特征连接的可训练性会重塑共享失败和相对优化器优势，表明允许的适应性是改变固定架构所学内容的关键训练变量。
AI.keywords: 优化器, 规则获取, 泛化, 神经网络, 训练条件
AI.comments: 本文通过理论与实验结合，深入探讨了优化器在相同架构下如何影响模型的规则学习与泛化能力，揭示了训练条件（如“讨厌特征”的连通性）对优化器性能和规则获取的关键作用，对理解深度学习中的泛化和优化机制具有重要意义。

title: Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media with Multi-Task QLoRA
summary: Explainable suicide-risk assessment requires models not only to estimate risk severity, but also to identify supporting language and the risk and protective factors expressed in a post. We present our system for the IEEE BigData 2026 Cup on Explainable Suicide Risk Assessment on Social Media, which addresses three tasks: risk-level classification, evidence phrase extraction, and multi-label factor identification. Our approach adapts Qwen2.5-Instruct models using quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) and an answer-masked causal language-model objective. We jointly train across all three tasks for risk classification, jointly train on Tasks 1a and 1b for evidence extraction, and adapt Task 2 separately for factor identification. We also tailor aggregation to each output: we average risk-level probabilities from the 32B and 72B models, combine evidence phrases through cross-fold consensus, and calibrate factor-specific decisions through rate matching based on out-of-fold operating points. On the official leaderboard, the final system achieved a composite score of 0.7738, with 0.8089 on Task 1 and 0.6919 on Task 2. Across the evaluated configurations, three-task training performed best for Task 1a, joint training on Tasks 1a and 1b performed best for Task 1b, and task-specific training performed best for Task 2. Probability averaging further improved Task 1a when component models had complementary errors. These findings highlight the value of tailoring both training objectives and aggregation strategies to the output structure of each task within a unified language-model framework.

AI.title_translation: 基于多任务QLoRA的社交媒体可解释自杀风险评估
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于多任务QLoRA的大模型系统，用于解决社交媒体上的可解释自杀风险评估任务，并在IEEE BigData 2026 Cup中获得优异成绩。
AI.motivation: 可解释的自杀风险评估不仅需要估计风险严重程度，还需要识别支持性语言以及帖子中表达的风险和保护因素，因此需要开发一个能够同时处理多个相关任务的高效系统。
AI.method: 采用Qwen2.5-Instruct模型，结合量化低秩适应（QLoRA）和答案掩码因果语言模型目标进行多任务联合训练与特定任务微调，并使用概率平均、交叉折共识和基于速率匹配的决策校准等定制化聚合策略。
AI.result: 在官方排行榜上，最终系统取得了0.7738的综合得分（任务1得0.8089，任务2得0.6919）。实验表明，三任务训练对任务1a效果最好，1a与1b的联合训练对任务1b效果最好，而特定任务训练对任务2最有效。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，针对不同任务结构定制训练目标和聚合策略，能够显著提升大语言模型在社交媒体可解释自杀风险评估中的性能。
AI.translation: 可解释的自杀风险评估要求模型不仅要估计风险严重程度，还要识别支持性语言以及帖子中表达的风险和保护因素。我们提出了参加IEEE BigData 2026 Cup社交媒体可解释自杀风险评估竞赛的系统，该系统解决了三个任务：风险级别分类、证据短语提取和多标签因素识别。我们的方法使用量化低秩适应（QLoRA）和答案掩码因果语言模型目标来适配Qwen2.5-Instruct模型。我们对风险分类的所有三个任务进行联合训练，对任务1a和1b进行联合训练以进行证据提取，并对任务2进行单独适配以进行因素识别。我们还针对每个输出定制了聚合方法：我们对32B和72B模型的风险级别概率进行平均，通过交叉折共识结合证据短语，并通过基于交叉折外工作点的速率匹配来校准特定因素的决策。在官方排行榜上，最终系统取得了0.7738的综合得分，其中任务1为0.8089，任务2为0.6919。在评估的配置中，三任务训练对任务1a表现最好，任务1a和1b的联合训练对任务1b表现最好，而任务特定训练对任务2表现最好。当组件模型具有互补误差时，概率平均进一步改善了任务1a。这些发现突出了在统一语言模型框架内，针对每个任务的输出结构定制训练目标和聚合策略的价值。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种基于多任务QLoRA的社交媒体可解释自杀风险评估系统，通过定制化的训练目标和聚合策略，在IEEE BigData 2026 Cup中取得了优异的成绩。
AI.keywords: 自杀风险评估, 可解释性, 社交媒体, QLoRA, 多任务学习
AI.comments: 该论文针对社交媒体上的可解释自杀风险评估任务，创新性地结合了QLoRA与多任务微调策略，通过联合训练和特定任务聚合方法，在IEEE BigData 2026 Cup中取得了优异的成绩。研究展示了大语言模型在复杂多任务心理健康评估中的潜力和有效性。

title: Soundwich: Video Generation with Layered and Controllable Audio
summary: Recent joint audio-video generative models can synthesize realistic videos with synchronized sound, but typically generate audio as a single mixed track. This limits source-level control and differs from practical audiovisual workflows, where speech, music, sound effects, and ambient sounds are represented as separate editable tracks. We introduce Soundwich, a training-free framework that transforms a frozen joint audio-video flow-matching model into a generator of multiple synchronized, independently editable audio stems coupled to a shared video. Soundwich generates separate audio stems with explicit control over their temporal activity. To keep separately generated sounds coherent, we introduce a shared scene representation that communicates global audiovisual context across stems while preserving their source-level separation. We further route cross-modal interactions between each audio stem and its corresponding visual source, improving audiovisual consistency. The resulting stems remain synchronized with the video and can be independently retimed, muted, replaced, or remixed. Experiments and human evaluations show improved temporal control, source separation, and naturalness, while enabling flexible source-level editing within coherent audiovisual generation. Code is available at https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich.

AI.title_translation: Soundwich：具有分层和可控音频的视频生成
AI.tldr: Soundwich是一种免训练的音视频生成框架，能够将视频与多个独立、可编辑的同步音频分轨（如语音、音乐、音效等）关联起来，极大地提升了音视频创作的灵活性。
AI.motivation: 当前的联合音视频生成模型通常将音频生成为单一的混合音轨，缺乏源级别的控制，这与实际的视听工作流（其中语音、音乐、音效和环境音是独立的音频分轨）不符。
AI.method: 提出一个免训练的框架（Soundwich），将冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型转化为多个同步且独立可编辑音频分轨的生成器；引入共享场景表示以在分轨间传达全局视听上下文，并路由每个音频分轨与对应视觉源之间的跨模态交互。
AI.result: 实验和人工评估表明，Soundwich在时间控制、源分离和自然度方面均有显著提升，同时能够在连贯的视听生成中实现灵活的源级别编辑。
AI.conclusion: Soundwich成功实现了一个免训练的音视频生成框架，能够生成多个同步且独立可编辑的音频分轨，并保持高水平的视听一致性和自然度。
AI.translation: 近期的联合音视频生成模型可以合成具有同步声音的真实视频，但通常将音频生成为单一的混合音轨。这限制了源级别的控制，且与实际的视听工作流不同——在实际工作流中，语音、音乐、音效和环境音通常表示为独立的可编辑音轨。我们介绍了 Soundwich，这是一个免训练的框架，它将一个冻结的联合音视频流匹配模型转化为多个同步的、独立可编辑的音频分轨生成器，这些分轨与共享视频相耦合。Soundwich 生成单独的音频分轨，并对其时间活动进行显式控制。为了保持单独生成的音频之间的连贯性，我们引入了一个共享场景表示，在各个分轨之间传达全局视听上下文，同时保持它们的源级别分离。我们进一步路由每个音频分轨与其对应视觉源之间的跨模态交互，以提高视听一致性。由此产生的音轨与视频保持同步，并且可以独立地重新计时、静音、替换或重新混音。实验和人工评估表明，该方法改善了时间控制、源分离和自然度，同时在连贯的视听生成中实现了灵活的源级别编辑。代码可通过 https://github.com/CodyNing/Soundwich 获取。
AI.summary: Soundwich是一个免训练的音视频生成框架，它能将冻结的音视频模型转化为生成多个独立可编辑音频分轨的工具，通过共享场景表示和跨模态交互路由，实现高自然度、时间可控的音视频生成。
AI.keywords: 音频-视频生成, 独立音频分轨, 帧匹配, 视听一致性, 源码级控制
AI.comments: Soundwich通过引入免训练（training-free）的框架，有效解决了现有音视频生成模型无法独立编辑多音轨的痛点，结合了共享场景表示与跨模态路由机制，展现出极高的实用价值和灵活性。

title: Event-Triggered Practical Fixed-Time Integral Reinforcement Learning for Unknown Nonlinear Systems
summary: This paper develops an event-triggered fixed-time integral reinforcement learning framework for optimal control of unknown nonlinear systems. An integral data-driven identifier is first used to reconstruct the unknown dynamics, after which an inverse-optimal formulation is employed to construct a fixed-time running cost. A learning law satisfying the practical fixed-time property is then derived. Previously collected data, or data obtained during a finite excitation interval, are stored in an experience-replay buffer and incorporated into the weight-update law. This avoids the persistent-excitation condition, which is often difficult to satisfy in practical operation. To reduce communication and control updates, an event-triggered mechanism is introduced. The paper shows that, under the event-triggered implementation, the closed-loop system still achieves practical fixed-time stability, while the proposed triggering rule guarantees the exclusion of Zeno behavior. Finally, a nonlinear example is presented to verify the theoretical results developed in the paper.

AI.title_translation: 未知非线性系统的事件触发实用固定时间积分强化学习
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对未知非线性系统的事件触发固定时间积分强化学习控制框架，通过经验回放避免了持续激励条件，并保证了系统稳定与无Zeno行为。
AI.motivation: 为了解决未知非线性系统的最优控制问题，同时克服实际运行中难以满足的持续激励条件以及减少通信和控制更新的频率。
AI.method: 首先利用积分数据驱动识别器重建未知动力学，采用逆最优公式构建固定时间运行成本，推导满足实用固定时间属性的学习律；引入经验回放缓冲区结合历史或有限激励区间数据以避开持续激励条件；并结合事件触发机制以减少通信和控制更新。
AI.result: 理论证明了在事件触发实现下，闭环系统能够实现实用固定时间稳定性，并且所提出的触发规则保证了不会发生Zeno行为；最后通过一个非线性算例验证了理论结果。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功开发了一个针对未知非线性系统的事件触发实用固定时间积分强化学习框架，在保证系统稳定性和避免Zeno行为的同时，有效降低了通信和控制更新频率。
AI.translation: 本文开发了一种针对未知非线性系统最优控制的事件触发固定时间积分强化学习框架。首先，利用积分数据驱动识别器重建未知动力学，然后采用逆最优公式构建固定时间运行成本。接着，推导出了满足实用固定时间属性的学习律。先前收集的数据或在有限激励区间内获得的数据被存储在经验回放缓冲区中，并合并到权重更新律中，这避免了在实际运行中往往难以满足的持续激励条件。为了减少通信和控制更新，引入了一种事件触发机制。论文表明，在事件触发实现下，闭环系统仍能实现实用固定时间稳定性，同时所提出的触发规则保证了Zeno行为的排除。最后，给出了一个非线性算例来验证论文中发展的理论结果。
AI.summary: 本文针对未知非线性系统，提出了一种事件触发的实用固定时间积分强化学习框架。通过结合数据驱动识别器、逆最优公式、经验回放机制以及事件触发规则，实现了系统的最优控制，保证了实用固定时间稳定性，排除了Zeno行为，并通过仿真算例进行了验证。
AI.keywords: 事件触发控制, 固定时间稳定, 积分强化学习, 非线性系统, 经验回放
AI.comments: 该论文将事件触发机制与固定时间积分强化学习相结合，用于未知非线性系统的最优控制，通过经验回放消除了持续激励条件，并在理论上证明了系统稳定性和无Zeno行为，具有较高的理论价值和实际应用潜力。

title: TrueMuse: A Benchmark for Data Attribution in Text-to-Music Models
summary: Text-to-music generation models are trained on massive music collections, creating a growing need for data attribution methods that can quantify the contribution of individual training samples. However, existing attribution methods are difficult to rigorously evaluate due to the lack of reliable ground truth, making it challenging to reliably assess their actual effectiveness. To address this gap, we introduce TrueMuse, a controlled dataset and benchmark for text-to-music data attribution. TrueMuse is constructed by fine-tuning three diffusion-based text-to-music models on carefully curated attribution samples, whose known inclusion in fine-tuning provides controlled attribution targets for evaluation. The benchmark covers four attribution settings, spanning melodic structure, timbral characteristics, artist-level stylistic signatures, and genre-level shared patterns, and includes 133 attributes, 648 fine-tuned models, and 95,456 generated samples across two prompt types. Using TrueMuse, we systematically evaluate existing black-box attribution methods along four dimensions: fine-tuning improvement, prompt-type difficulty, multi-task training, and fine-tuning data size. Our results show that attribution remains challenging, with existing methods exhibiting substantial variation across evaluation settings, highlighting the need for more reliable and generalizable attribution methods for text-to-music generation. Code and Dataset will be released upon acceptance.

AI.title_translation: TrueMuse：文本-音乐模型数据归因基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了TrueMuse——首个用于文本到音乐模型的数据归因基准，填补了该领域缺乏可靠真实标签的空白，并评估了现有归因方法的局限性。
AI.motivation: 文本-音乐生成模型大规模训练催生了对数据归因方法的需求，以量化单个训练样本的贡献，但由于缺乏可靠的基准真值，现有方法难以进行严格评估。
AI.method: 通过在精心策划的归因样本上微调三个基于扩散模型的文本-纳音乐生成模型，构建了包含133个属性、648个微调模型和95,456个生成样本的受控数据集TrueMuse，并使用该基准评估了现有的黑盒归因方法。
AI.result: 实验表明，数据归因在文本转音乐中依然具有挑战性，现有方法在不同的评估设置下表现出巨大的性能差异。
AI.conclusion: 现有的黑盒数据归因方法在文本转音乐任务中表现出显著的性能波动，表明现有的归因技术仍有巨大提升空间，TrueMuse为未来的研究提供了可靠的评估平台。
AI.translation: 文本-音乐生成模型在海量音乐集上进行训练，这产生了对数据归因方法的日益增长的需求，以便量化单个训练样本的贡献。然而，由于缺乏可靠的真实标签（ground truth），现有的归因方法难以进行严格评估，从而难以可靠地评估其实际有效性。为了填补这一空白，我们介绍了TrueMuse，这是一个用于文本-音乐数据归因的受控数据集和基准。TrueMuse是通过在精心策划的归因样本上微调三个基于扩散模型的文本-音乐生成模型构建的，这些样本在微调中已知被包含，从而为评估提供了受控的归因目标。该基准涵盖了四种归因设置，横跨旋律结构、音色特征、艺术家级风格特征和流派级共享模式，并在两种提示词类型下包含了133个属性、648个微调模型以及95,456个生成样本。利用TrueMuse，我们从微调改进、提示词类型难度、多任务训练和微调数据规模四个维度系统地评估了现有的黑盒归因方法。我们的结果表明，归因仍然具有挑战性，现有方法在不同的评估设置中表现出巨大的变异性，这凸显了对文本-音乐生成需要更可靠和可泛化归因方法的必要性。代码和数据集将在论文被接受后发布。
AI.summary: 本文推出了TrueMuse，这是首个用于文本转音乐模型数据归因的受控数据集和基准，通过使用已知微调样本提供真实标签，评估了现有黑盒归因方法在四个维度上的性能，揭示了当前方法的局限性并强调了开发更可靠归因技术的必要性。
AI.keywords: Text-to-music, Data attribution, Benchmark, Diffusion models, Fine-tuning
AI.comments: TrueMuse为文本转音乐模型的数据归因（Data Attribution）填补了基准空白，通过精细控制微调样本提供了可靠的基准真值（Ground Truth），对于评估和改进模型的数据版权保护和贡献量化具有重要意义。

title: Screw Attention: Rigid-Body Algebra Inside a Transformer
summary: Learned manipulation policies rediscover from data the spatial relations that rigid-body mechanics supplies in closed form, which leaves them fragile to geometric change. We present Screw Attention, a transformer layer in which the relation between two bodies is a spatial transform rather than a graph edge. Each pair of tokens carries the relative pose and, for robot joints, the joint screw. Messages are transported along this relation into the receiver's frame, while the attention scores see only frame-invariant quantities. By construction, the messages are equivariant to an independent change of frame at every token, and a single layer can express the velocity recursion of rigid-body mechanics. On LIBERO-Spatial, a policy of 16k parameters trained from object poses alone reaches 97.3% success, above graph, transformer and flat networks of the same size and a flat network with 27 times more parameters. Ablations show that the gain comes from transporting the correct relations, and that the structure pays most where the task requires relations between frames that nothing else supplies. The equivariance makes the policy robust to how the robot is described, where every other learned network collapses under a change of frame convention. Furthermore, the policy tolerates pose noise and calibration errors at least as well as an analytic controller. Used as a gated residual on an analytic controller, it also improves a contact-rich insertion task. Code and trained policies will be released.

AI.title_translation: 螺旋注意力：Transformer内部的刚体代数
AI.tldr: Screw Attention将刚体代数引入Transformer，通过显式建模空间变换和关节螺旋，大幅提升了机器人操作策略的鲁棒性、泛化能力和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的学习型操作策略从数据中重新学习刚体机构闭式解所具备的空间关系，这导致它们对几何变化非常脆弱。为了解决这一问题，需要将刚体几何和力学的先验知识直接嵌入到网络结构中。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Screw Attention的Transformer层，其中两个物体之间的关系被定义为空间变换而非图边，每个token对携带相对位姿和关节螺旋，消息沿此关系传输至接收者坐标系，且注意力分数仅关注帧不变物理量。
AI.result: 在LIBERO-Spatial任务中，仅使用16k参数训练的策略达到了97.3%的成功率，超越了同等规模的图网络、Transformer和扁平网络，甚至超过了参数量大27倍的扁平网络。该策略对坐标系变换具有强鲁棒性，且对位姿噪声和标定误差具有良好的容忍度。
AI.conclusion: Screw Attention通过在Transformer中引入刚体代数，成功实现了数据驱动策略与严格物理先验的融合，极大地提高了机器人操作策略的泛化能力、鲁棒性和数据效率。
AI.translation: 学习型操作策略从数据中重新学习刚体力学以封闭形式提供的空间关系，这使得它们对几何变化非常脆弱。我们提出了Screw Attention，这是一种Transformer层，其中两个物体之间的关系是空间变换而不是图边。每个token对都带有相对位姿，对于机器人关节，还带有关节螺旋。消息沿着这种关系传输到接收者的坐标系中，而注意力分数只看到坐标系不变量（frame-invariant quantities）。通过这种结构，消息对于每个token处坐标系的独立变化具有等变性，并且单层就可以表达刚体力学的速度递推。在LIBERO-Spatial上，仅根据物体位姿训练的16k参数策略达到了97.3%的成功率，优于相同大小的图网络、Transformer和扁平网络，以及参数多27倍的扁平网络。消融实验表明，性能增益来自于传输正确的空间关系，并且在任务需要其他任何方式都无法提供的坐标系之间关系的地方，这种结构发挥了最大的作用。等变性使得该策略对机器人的描述方式具有鲁棒性，而其他所有学习网络在坐标系约定改变时都会崩溃。此外，该策略对位姿噪声和标定误差的容忍度至少与解析控制器一样好。作为解析控制器的门控残差，它还改进了富含接触的插入任务。代码和训练好的策略将开源。
AI.summary: 本文提出了Screw Attention，一种将刚体代数和螺旋理论融入Transformer的架构。该方法通过在注意力机制中显式建模空间变换和关节螺旋，保证了对坐标系变化的等变性，并在机器人操作任务中展现出卓越的样本效率、鲁棒性和泛化性能。
AI.keywords: Screw Attention, 刚体代数, Transformer, 机器人操作, 空间变换
AI.comments: 该论文通过将刚体动力学中的螺旋理论（Screw Theory）内嵌到Transformer的注意力机制中，开辟了一条将物理先验与深度学习结合的新途径。其核心创新在于保持了帧不变性（Frame-invariance）和等变性，显著提升了机器人操作策略的数据效率和鲁棒性，具有极高的理论价值和应用前景。

title: A Faster Auction Algorithm for Weighted Matroid Intersection
summary:
We consider the weighted matroid intersection problem in the independence-oracle model. A sequence of works by Huang--Kakimura--Kamiyama [SODA'16 \& Math. Program'19], Chekuri--Quanrud [SODA'16], Quanrud [ICALP'24], and Dudeja--Grilnberger [IPCO'26] has developed efficient $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithms for this problem.
  We present a simple deterministic auction algorithm that, given two matroids on a common ground set of size $n$, computes a $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximate maximum-weight common independent set using $O(n \varepsilon^{-2} \log^2(n))$ independence-oracle queries. This is the first deterministic $(1-\varepsilon)$-approximation algorithm for the weighted matroid intersection problem whose query complexity is nearly linear in $n$ and polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$. Our algorithm builds on the auction algorithm for unweighted matroid intersection by Huang--Kobayashi ['26], together with the analysis of the auction algorithm for weighted bipartite matching by Liu--Ke--Khuller [APPROX'23].

AI.title_translation: 加权拟阵交的一个更快拍卖算法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于加权拟阵交的更快确定性拍卖算法，查询复杂度在 $n$ 上几乎呈线性。
AI.motivation: 尽管已有系列工作研究加权拟阵交问题的 $(1-\varepsilon)$-近似算法，但如何在独立性预言机模型下设计出查询复杂度相对于基础集大小 $n$ 几乎呈线性、相对于 $1/\varepsilon$ 呈多项式增长的确定性算法仍是一个挑战。
AI.method: 基于Huang--Kobayashi ['26]提出的无权拟阵交拍卖算法，并结合Liu--Ke--Khuller [APPROX'23]对加权二分图匹配拍卖算法的分析，设计了一个简单的确定性拍卖算法。
AI.result: 该算法在独立性预言机模型下，仅需 $O(n \varepsilon^{-2} \log^2(n))$ 次查询即可计算出 $(1-\varepsilon)$-近似的最大权重公共独立集。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功设计了一个针对加权拟阵交问题的确定性拍卖算法，实现了几近线性的查询复杂度。
AI.translation:
我们研究了独立性预言机模型下的加权拟阵交问题。Huang--Kakimura--Kamiyama [SODA'16 & Math. Program'19]、Chekuri--Quanrud [SODA'16]、Quanrud [ICALP'24] 以及 Dudeja--Grilnberger [IPCO'26] 的一系列工作针对该问题开发了高效的 $(1-\varepsilon)$-近似算法。
我们提出了一种简单的确定性拍卖算法：给定两个定义在大小为 $n$ 的公共基础集上的拟阵，该算法使用 $O(n \varepsilon^{-2} \log^2(n))$ 次独立性预言机查询，计算出一个 $(1-\varepsilon)$-近似的最大权重公共独立集。这是第一个针对加权拟阵交问题的确定性 $(1-\varepsilon)$-近似算法，其查询复杂度在 $n$ 上几乎是线性的，且在 $1/\varepsilon$ 上是多项式的。我们的算法建立在 Huang--Kobayashi ['26] 的无权拟阵交拍卖算法基础之上，并结合了 Liu--Ke--Khuller [APPROX'23] 对加权二分图匹配拍卖算法的分析。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种针对加权拟阵交问题的简单确定性拍卖算法，在独立性预言机模型下，利用 $O(n \varepsilon^{-2} n \log^2(n))$ 的查询复杂度实现了 $(1-\varepsilon)$-近似最大权重公共独立集。这是首个在 $n$ 上几近线性、在 $1/\varepsilon$ 上呈多项式的确定性近似算法。
AI.keywords: 加权拟阵交, 拍卖算法, 近似算法, 独立性预言机, 查询复杂度
AI.comments: 该论文在加权拟阵交问题上取得了重要进展，提出了一种几乎线性的确定性近似算法，将拍卖算法从无权拟阵交成功推广并优化到了加权拟阵交，具有很高的理论价值。

title: Platonic Task Arithmetic
summary: Distinct pre-trained models specialized for the same task converge to closely similar behavior, yet the parameter updates that produce it share no common coordinate system. Weight-space task arithmetic is therefore confined to a single model, and transporting an update between models requires a structural correspondence. Drawing on Plato's allegory of the cave, we hypothesize that these model-specific updates are shadows cast by one shared, model-agnostic object, the platonic task vector. To make it operational across models of different architectures, we introduce Universal Task Descriptors, matrices whose shape is independent of architecture and embedding dimension, which record a task's functional effect and admit addition and negation as ordinary matrix operations, and we transfer a descriptor into a target in two ways. A single least-squares solve returns a linear operator folded into the target's last layer, and a bank of such operators, one per source and task, realizes any composition as a signed sum of its entries. Alternatively, a low-rank adapter of the target's encoder is trained on the same objective at the price of one optimization per edit. Despite a model-specific residual comparable in norm to the shared component, transfer from another model retains 74 to 80 percent of the gain the target's own descriptors attain. Experiments across six model families, eight tasks and audio-text models confirm both realizations.

AI.title_translation: 柏拉图式任务算术
AI.tldr: 提出通用任务描述符，突破模型架构限制，首次实现了跨不同预训练模型的任务算术与组合。
AI.motivation: 尽管针对同一任务的不同预训练模型表现出高度相似的行为，但它们的参数更新由于缺乏共同的坐标系而无法直接进行权重空间的任务算术。受柏拉图洞穴寓言启发，作者假设这些模型特定的更新是一个共享的、与模型无关的对象（柏拉图式任务向量）的阴影，从而寻求跨架构的任务迁移方法。
AI.method: 引入与架构无关的通用任务描述符（矩阵形式），记录任务的功能效果并支持加法和求反。通过最小二乘法求解线性算子或训练低额适配器（LoRA）将其迁移到目标模型中。
AI.result: 跨越六个模型系列、八个任务以及音频-文本模型的实验证实了这两种实现方式的有效性，从其他模型迁移可以保留目标模型自身描述符所获增益的74%到80%。
AI.conclusion: 通用任务描述符成功地捕捉了不同架构模型间共享的任务特征，实现了跨模型的任务算术与组合，实验证明其在保留大部分性能增益的同时具有广泛的通用性。
AI.translation: 针对同一任务专业化的不同预训练模型会收敛到高度相似的行为，然而产生这种行为的参数更新却不共享任何公共坐标系。因此，权重空间的任务算术仅限于单个模型，且在模型之间传输更新需要结构对应关系。借鉴柏拉图的洞穴寓言，我们假设这些模型特定的更新是一个共享的、与模型无关的对象（柏拉图式任务向量）所投下的阴影。为了使其在不同架构的模型中可操作，我们引入了通用任务描述符（Universal Task Descriptors），这些矩阵的形状与架构和嵌入维度无关，记录了任务的功能效果，并支持作为常规矩阵运算的加法和求反。我们通过两种方式将描述符传输到目标模型中：通过一次最小二乘求解返回折叠到目标最后一层的线性算子，以及通过一个算子库（每个源和任务一个算子）实现作为其条目有符号和的任意组合。或者，在付出每次编辑优化一次的代价下，在相同目标上训练目标编码器的低秩适配器。尽管残差的大小与共享组件相当，但从另一个模型迁移仍可保留目标模型自身描述符所获得增益的74%到80%。跨越六个模型系列、八个任务以及音频-文本模型的实验证实了这两种实现方式。
AI.summary: 论文提出了柏拉图式任务算术和通用任务描述符，解决了跨不同架构模型进行任务更新迁移和组合的难题，实验证明其能够有效跨模型保留大部分性能增益。
AI.keywords: 任务算术, 预训练模型, 通用任务描述符, 模型迁移, 表征对齐
AI.comments: 该论文提出了“柏拉图式任务算术”这一创新概念，通过引入通用任务描述符（Universal Task Descriptors），突破了不同架构模型之间权重空间坐标系不兼容的限制，实现了任务更新跨模型的高效迁移与组合，展现了极高的理论价值与实用潜力。

title: Adapter Thickets: Splitting an RLVR Budget Beats Concentrating It
summary: Majority voting over sampled completions is the workhorse of test-time scaling, and reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is the workhorse for making each completion better. The standard pipeline composes the two: train one policy with RLVR, then sample it many times and vote. We show that this composition is lossy. A vote can only overturn mistakes that its voters do not share, and RLVR sharpens a policy so that its samples increasingly make the same mistakes. With every method drawing exactly $160$ completions per problem, training a single LoRA adapter on the full RLVR budget raises single-sample accuracy on every model we test ($1.5$B-$8$B). Yet on three of four models it leaves the majority vote below that of the untrained base model, by up to $4.8$ points. The damage builds during training: voter errors grow steadily more correlated, and the majority vote accuracy peaks early before falling by up to $7.0$ points. The cause is concentration, not RLVR itself. We split the same data and training budget across $K$ LoRA adapters, each trained on its own random disjoint shard, and call the result an adapter thicket. Thickets out-vote the fully trained adapter in all $16$ (model, $K$) settings, and for $K{\geq}4$ they stay within $0.8$ points of the base model or above it. A single adapter stopped early, at a thicket member's step count, is a strong control that matches thickets for small $K$. For $K{\geq}8$, thickets keep more of RLVR's single-sample gain and out-vote this control in six of eight settings. The cost of concentration also grows with the number of votes: from $16$ to $160$ votes, the thicket's lead over the fully trained adapter widens from $1.3$ to $3.3$ points. When the plan is to sample and vote, an RLVR budget is better spent broad than deep.

AI.title_translation: 适配器灌木丛：分散强化学习与可验证奖励预算胜过集中预算
AI.tldr: 在测试时需要进行采样和投票的场景下，将RLVR训练预算分散到多个适配器（Adapter Thickets）比集中训练单一适配器效果更好。
AI.motivation: 传统的强化学习与可验证奖励（RLVR）会将策略训练得过于单一，导致模型在测试时进行多数投票（majority voting）时样本错误高度相关，进而抵消了测试时扩展带来的收益。作者旨在研究并解决RLVR预算过度集中带来的负面影响。
AI.method: 提出“Adapter Thickets”方法，即将相同的训练数据和计算预算平分为 $K$ 份，分别训练 $K$ 个互不重叠的 LoRA 适配器，并在测试时结合这些适配器的采样进行投票。
AI.result: 实验表明，集中训练单一适配器虽然提升了单样本准确率，但损害了多数投票准确率；而通过将预算分散到 $K$ 个适配器（Adapter Thickets）中，在所有16种设置下均优于完全训练的单一适配器，且当 $K \geq 4$ 时能够保持或超过基础模型的投票水平。随着投票数量的增加，分散策略的优势进一步扩大。
AI.conclusion: 当计划在测试时使用采样和投票时，将RLVR训练预算分配给多个分散的适配器（Adapter Thickets）远优于集中训练单一适配器。
AI.translation: 对采样补全进行多数投票是测试时扩展（test-time scaling）的主力方法，而带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）则是提升每个补全质量的主力方法。标准的流程是将两者组合：用RLVR训练一个策略，然后对其进行多次采样并投票。我们表明这种组合是有损的。一次投票只能纠正投票者不共同犯下的错误，而RLVR会使策略变得尖锐，以至于其样本越来越多地犯相同的错误。在每个方法对每个问题准确抽取160个样本的情况下，在全额RLVR预算下训练单一LoRA适配器提升了我们测试的所有模型（1.5B-8B）的单样本准确率。然而，在四个模型中的三个模型上，它使多数投票低于未训练的基础模型，最多下降4.8个百分点。这种损害在训练过程中累积：投票者的错误稳步增加相关性，多数投票准确率在早期达到峰值，随后下降多达7.0个百分点。其原因是集中化，而非RLVR本身。我们将相同的数据和训练预算分割到 $K$ 个LoRA适配器中，每个适配器在其自身的随机不相交分片上训练，我们将结果称为适配器灌木丛（adapter thicket）。在所有16种（模型，$K$）设置中，灌木丛的表现都优于完全训练的适配器，并且对于 $K \geq 4$，它们的表现保持在基础模型的0.8个百分点以内或更高。在早期停止、达到灌木丛成员步数的单一适配器是一个强有力的对照，它与较小 $K$ 的灌木丛相匹配。对于 $K \geq 8$，灌木丛保留了更多RLVR的单样本增益，并在八分之六的设置中超越了该对照。集中化的成本也随着投票数量的增加而增长：从16票到160票，灌木丛相对于完全训练的适配器的领先优势从1.3个百分点扩大到3.3个百分点。当计划进行采样和投票时，RLVR预算“广撒网”比“深钻研”更好。
AI.summary: 论文发现传统的RLVR全额训练单一适配器会导致样本错误高度相关，损害测试时的多数投票效果。为此，作者提出了“Adapter Thickets”策略，通过将RLVR训练预算分散到多个独立的LoRA适配器上，有效保持了样本多样性，显著提升了多数投票的准确率。
AI.keywords: Test-time scaling, Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, Majority voting, LoRA adapters, Model diversity
AI.comments: 该论文针对测试时扩展（test-time scaling）与RLVR（基于可验证奖励的强化学习）的结合进行了深入探讨。作者发现，传统的将全部RLVR预算投入单一Adapter会导致模型样本错误高度同质化，从而损害多数投票（majority voting）的效果（即集中化诅咒）。通过提出“Adapter Thickets”（适配器灌木丛）策略，将训练预算分散到多个随机不相交的LoRA适配器上，有效地保持了多样性，提升了投票准确率。这项工作对大语言模型在测试时扩展和强化学习阶段的策略训练具有重要的指导意义。

title: Open Vocabulary Word Recognition From Transcribed Bangla Texts
comments: 6 pages, 4 figures, 5 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 26th International Conference on Computer and Information Technology (ICCIT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Open-Vocabulary-Word-Recognition-From-Transcribed-Bangla-Texts.git
summary: An optical character recognition (OCR) can scan a paper and extract text using technology, making people's jobs easier. While various OCR systems are available in the software industry, finding a reliable equivalent solution for Bangla takes much work. When it comes to handwritten texts, the situation is much more unusual. Recognizing words from word images is the most critical stage in any OCR process. It is the second stage after segmenting words from text pictures. If this stage fails, the overall performance of the OCR will be poor, regardless of how well the other phases perform. This study aims to recognize words using deep learning in a handwritten Bangla word image. Three object detection models, SSD with MobileNetV2, Faster R-CNN with InceptionResNetV2, and an ensemble model of these two, have been used to train and test handwritten word images. A modified Non-Maximum Suppression has been introduced to enhance the effectiveness of the models' results. A customized dataset of 9841 handwritten Bangla word images has been compiled, featuring diverse handwriting styles from various individuals. All three models' performances have been checked against the test dataset, and the ensemble model has been the most impressive, with an F1-score of 92.61%. Also, at the word level, the ensemble model correctly recognizes 96.12% of the words to some extent. The system can be further improved by introducing a post-processing phase to correct errors generated by the system.

AI.title_translation: 基于转录孟加拉语文本的开放词汇单词识别
AI.tldr: 本研究利用深度学习目标检测模型与集成方法，实现了高效的开放词汇手写孟加拉语单词识别，集成模型的F1-score达到了92.61%。
AI.motivation: 尽管光学字符识别（OCR）技术在软件行业广泛应用，但针对孟加拉语（特别是手写文本）的可靠OCR解决方案依然较少。单词图像识别是OCR的核心关键阶段，若此阶段失败，整体性能将大打折扣。因此，本研究旨在利用深度学习技术实现对手写孟加拉语单词图像的有效识别。
AI.method: 使用三种目标检测模型（SSD与MobileNetV2、Faster R-CNN与InceptionResNetV2，以及它们的集成模型）进行训练和测试；引入了修改版的非极大值抑制（NMS）来提升模型效果；使用包含9841张手写孟加拉语单词图像的自定义数据集进行评估。
AI.result: 在测试数据集上评估了三个模型的性能，其中集成模型表现最出色，F1-score达到92.61%，并且在单词级别上以某种程度正确识别了96.12%的单词。
AI.conclusion: 该研究成功构建了一个基于深度学习的开放词汇手写孟加拉语单词识别系统。通过采用目标检测模型与集成方法，并引入改进的NMS算法，在自定义数据集上取得了优异的性能（F1-score达92.61%），证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.translation: 光学字符识别（OCR）可以通过技术扫描纸张并提取文本，从而简化人们的工作。虽然软件行业有各种各样的OCR系统，但要找到孟加拉语的可靠等效解决方案却很困难。当涉及到手写文本时，情况就更不寻常了。从单词图像中识别单词是任何OCR过程中最关键的阶段。它是从文本图片中分割出单词之后的第二个阶段。如果这个阶段失败了，无论其他阶段表现多好，OCR的整体性能都会很差。本研究旨在利用深度学习识别手写孟加拉语单词图像中的单词。使用了三个目标检测模型：带MobileNetV2的SSD、带InceptionResNetV2的Faster R-CNN，以及这两个模型的集成模型来训练和测试手写单词图像。引入了一种修改后的非极大值抑制（NMS）来增强模型结果的有效性。收集了一个包含9841个手写孟加拉语单词图像的定制数据集，具有来自不同个人的多样化手写风格。所有三个模型的性能都在测试数据集上进行了检查，集成模型表现最为出色，F1-score达到了92.61%。此外，在单词级别上，集成模型在一定程度上正确识别了96.12%的单词。通过引入后处理阶段来纠正系统产生的错误，该系统可以进一步改进。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种基于深度学习的开放词汇手写孟加拉语单词识别方法。研究人员构建了一个包含9841张手写孟加拉语单词图像的自定义数据集，并评估了SSD、Faster R-CNN及其集成模型在内的多种目标检测架构，同时引入了改进的非极大值抑制方法。实验结果表明，集成模型的表现最佳，F1-score达到92.61%，展现了在手写孟加拉语OCR任务中的巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: 手写孟加拉语识别, 光学字符识别 (OCR), 目标检测模型, 深度学习, 集成模型
AI.comments: 该论文针对孟加拉语手写文字识别这一难点，创新性地将目标检测模型（如SSD和Faster R-CNN）应用于开放词汇的手写单词识别，并引入了改进的非极大值抑制（NMS）和集成模型，取得了较高的识别准确率。未来可以通过引入后处理阶段进一步提升系统性能。

title: The RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset
summary: Intracranial aneurysm rupture is associated with substantial morbidity and mortality, yet aneurysm detection remains challenging, particularly for small lesions and on routine non-angiographic imaging examinations. To support the development and evaluation of artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms for intracranial aneurysm detection and localization, the Radiological Society of North America (RSNA), in collaboration with the American Society of Neuroradiology (ASNR), the Society of Neurointerventional Surgery (SNIS), and the European Society of Neuroradiology (ESNR), curated the RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm (RSNA-ICA) Dataset. Developed for the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge, RSNA-ICA is a large, publicly available, expert-annotated dataset comprising 7202 CTA, MRA, and MRI series from 4278 adult patients collected across 21 institutions in 12 countries spanning five continents. The dataset includes 2566 CTA, 2166 MRA, and 2470 MRI series from patients with and without intracranial saccular aneurysms, providing substantial geographic and imaging diversity. Expert annotations indicate both aneurysm presence and location, and 178 series additionally include three-dimensional segmentations of challenge-defined vascular locations. RSNA-ICA was used to develop and evaluate algorithms in the 2025 RSNA Intracranial Aneurysm Detection Challenge. Of the 7202 image series, 5041 are publicly available through MIRA, while the remainder were used for challenge public and private test sets. The dataset is freely available to the research community for noncommercial use and provides a comprehensive resource for advancing AI-based aneurysm detection across both angiographic and routine neuroimaging examinations.

AI.title_translation: RSNA颅内动脉瘤（RSNA-ICA）数据集
AI.tldr: 本文介绍了RSNA-ICA数据集，这是一个包含来自全球21家机构的7202个多模态影像系列的大型、专家注释的颅内动脉瘤公开数据集，旨在促进AI辅助动脉瘤检测算法的开发。
AI.motivation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂会导致极高的发病率和死亡率，但动脉瘤的检测仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于小型病变和常规非血管造影检查。为了支持人工智能算法在颅内动脉瘤检测和定位中的开发与评估，需要构建一个大规模、多样化且经专家注释的数据集。
AI.method: 由北美放射学会（RSNA）联合多个神经放射学与神经介入学会共同策划，收集了来自全球12个国家21家机构的4278名成年患者的7202个CTA、MRA和MRI系列，并由专家进行动脉瘤存在、位置及部分三维分割的注释。
AI.result: 成功构建了包含7202个系列（涵盖CTA、MRA和MRI）的RSNA-ICA数据集，具备高度的地理和影像多样性，其中5041个系列已通过MIRA公开供研究人员使用，其余用于挑战赛测试集。
AI.conclusion: RSNA-ICA数据集作为一个大型、公开且经过专家注释的多样化影像数据集，为开发和评估颅内动脉瘤检测AI算法提供了强有力的支持，有望推动该领域的进一步发展。
AI.translation: 颅内动脉瘤破裂与高发病率和死亡率相关，但动脉瘤的检测仍然具有挑战性，特别是对于小型病变和常规非血管造影影像检查。为了支持用于颅内动脉瘤检测和定位的人工智能（AI）算法的开发和评估，北美放射学会（RSNA）与美国神经放射学会（ASNR）、神经介入外科学会（SNIS）以及欧洲神经放射学会（ESNR）合作，策划了RSNA颅内动脉瘤（RSNA-ICA）数据集。RSNA-ICA专为2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛而开发，是一个大型、公开、经专家注释的数据集，包含来自五大洲12个国家21家机构的4278名成年患者的7202个CTA、MRA和MRI系列。该数据集包括来自有和没有颅内囊状动脉瘤患者的2566个CTA、2166个MRA和2470个MRI系列，提供了巨大的地理和影像学多样性。专家注释指出了动脉瘤的存在和位置，其中178个系列还包括挑战赛定义血管位置的三维分割。RSNA-ICA用于开发和评估2025年RSNA颅内动脉瘤检测挑战赛中的算法。在7202个影像系列中，有5041个通过MIRA公开提供，其余部分用作挑战赛的公开和私有测试集。该数据集可供研究界免费用于非商业用途，并为推进基于AI的血管造影及常规神经影像检查中的动脉瘤检测提供了全面的资源。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了RSNA颅内动脉瘤（RSNA-ICA）数据集，这是一个大型、公开、经专家注释的多模态影像数据集，包含来自全球多中心的多样化CTA、MRA和MRI系列，旨在推动人工智能在颅内动脉瘤检测与定位方面的发展。
AI.keywords: 颅内动脉瘤, 人工智能, 数据集, 计算机断层扫描血管造影, 磁共振血管造影
AI.comments: 该数据集规模宏大、多模态（包含CTA、MRA、MRI）、多中心且跨越全球多个大洲，具有极高的地理和影像学多样性。它为人工智能在颅内动脉瘤检测与定位领域的研究提供了宝贵的基准资源，有助于推动小型及常规影像中动脉瘤检测技术的发展。

title: OptimusMesh: Compact Autoregressive Mesh Generation from Point Clouds via Sparse Latent Pivots
summary: Generating compact and geometrically faithful 3D meshes directly from point clouds remains a fundamental challenge. Point clouds are unordered and sparse, whereas meshes exhibit irregular structure and varying topology. As a result, many existing approaches rely on implicit representations followed by surface extraction or reconstruction. Although effective, these pipelines can produce dense or over-smoothed meshes, often requiring computationally expensive post-processing and simplification. We present OptimusMesh, a framework for direct compact triangle mesh generation from point clouds using sparse latent pivot conditioning. Our key idea is to compress $2{,}048$ oriented input points into only $16$ sparse latent pivots, reducing the geometric conditioning set by $128\times$. These pivots provide a compact structural representation shared across a two-stage autoregressive framework that first generates mesh vertices and then predicts triangular faces conditioned on the generated vertices and the same pivots. Compared with the evaluated recent point-cloud-conditioned autoregressive methods, which use $257$ decoder-conditioning tokens, OptimusMesh uses only $16$, yielding a $16.1\times$ shorter conditioning sequence. Experiments show that OptimusMesh produces the most compact outputs among the compared recent autoregressive methods, using $25.7\%$--$94.1\%$ fewer faces while maintaining competitive geometric fidelity and distributional quality.

title: Color Independent Word Segmentation From Transcribed Bangla Passages
comments: 6 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Accepted version of the paper published in the 2023 6th International Conference on Electrical Information and Communication Technology (EICT). Code: https://github.com/FaiasPromit/Color-Independent-Word-Segmentation-From-Transcribed-Bangla-Passages.git

While numerous OCR systems are accessible in the software sector, finding a dependable equivalent solution for Bangla is tough. When it comes to handwritten texts, the case is even more rare. The first fundamental step to any OCR is to segment words from text images. If this stage fails, the total OCR's performance will be poor no matter how promising the later stages perform. This research aims to segment words in a handwritten Bangla text image. This research can be implemented on any smartphone-captured image, irrespective of the color and type of paper and ink. Furthermore, as smartphone-captured images can create shadow interferences, the custom dataset built for this research is created in such a way that every possible obstacle that can be faced is included. For 7374 words, a total of 7278 bounding boxes are generated, which have recall of 90.60%, precision of 91.80%, and F1-score of 91.20%. The system can be further improved with nested operations on bounding boxes containing several words or by adjusting the adaptive thresholding and dilation filter sizes to a more precise level.

title: Beyond the Clique: Comparing Clique and Dowker Complexes for Co-occurrence Data in Learning Analytics
comments: v2: adds a local criterion for when clique and Dowker complexes agree (Prop. 3); Appendix B relates the analysis to the current TNA toolchain (the window co-occurrence complex of hypernets 0.6.0) and gives a Hodge-decomposition reading of the loss for transition flows; expands the outlook
summary: Learning analytics increasingly represents the relations in co-occurrence data (codes in a window of discourse, participants in a thread, tags on a post) as simplicial complexes and analyses them with persistent homology. The standard approach uses the clique complex. Because its simplices are determined by the pairwise network alone, it cannot distinguish "three elements co-occurred together" from "each of the three pairs co-occurred separately". The Dowker complex, in contrast, takes as simplices the sets of entities actually observed to co-occur. We compare the two. First, we show that, on the same 1-skeleton, the Dowker complex is a subcomplex of the clique complex, the map on first homology induced by the inclusion is surjective, and its kernel is generated by phantom triangles that never co-occurred; that is, the clique construction can only erase holes. We also give a criterion for agreement that can be checked on triples of groups. We then test this on real data. On four Stack Exchange data sets, 46-91% of clique triangles are phantom and 522-1,970 holes are erased. On the example data of the learning-analytics R packages tna/Nestimate, the first Betti number $β_1$ of the clique complex is 0 at every threshold, whereas the Dowker complex detects holes. Against a degree-preserving null model, the Dowker complex departs strongly in five of the six data sets. This difference is invisible at the fixed thresholds used in practice. We conclude that the construction should follow the data type and that, for observed groups, the Dowker complex is the appropriate choice. Code is available at https://github.com/igu-lab/beyond-the-clique.

title: Rethinking Probability-Based Reinforcement Learning From Posterior Concentration
summary: Verifier-free reinforcement learning with probability-based rewards offers a promising way to train LLMs on general reasoning tasks where external verifiers are unavailable. Yet the reliability of these rewards, especially in long-horizon reasoning, remains underexplored. This work identifies a length-dependent failure mode of probability rewards, which we call the Posterior Concentration Phenomenon (PCP). We show that the probability of a reference answer conditioned on a reasoning trace often collapses to a low-variance interval as the trace becomes lengthy. This phenomenon results in nearly indistinguishable rewards, which, under GRPO-based settings, makes probability-based policy optimization unstable and inefficient. Motivated by this, we propose Reinforcement Learning with Concentration-aware Posterior Rewards (RLCPR), a verifier-free RL framework to explicitly account for PCP for better optimization stability and token efficiency. It has two components: uncertainty-aware data sampling, which reduces concentration-prone rollouts before generation, and concentration-aware regularization, which penalizes unnecessarily long traces when posterior rewards collapse. Extensive experiments show that, alongside higher token efficiency, RLCPR outperforms the state-of-the-art verifier-free RL baseline by up to 4.0% on six of seven benchmarks, including general-domain and mathematical reasoning challenges.

title: GAW-PO: Preference Optimization with Gradient-Aligned Token Weights
summary: Most preference optimization methods, such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), apply preference supervision at the response level, although autoregressive language models are optimized token by token. As a result, all tokens in a rejected response contribute to the negative training signal, including tokens that may encode behavior that is useful for the preferred response. We introduce GAW-PO, a gradient-aligned token reweighting method for DPO that estimates, for each rejected token, whether penalizing it would interfere with the preferred update directions. Tokens whose gradients are strongly aligned with the preferred behavior receive a weaker negative contribution, while conflicting tokens retain a stronger penalty. Our method achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated preference-optimization methods, improving by 0.97 points over standard DPO and 0.65 points over the strongest competing baseline across 11 benchmarks spanning mathematics, reasoning, coding, and question answering. We further show that gradient-aligned weighting is substantially more robust to aggressive preference optimization: as the DPO regularization parameter $β$ decreases, standard DPO degrades sharply, whereas GAW-PO continues to improve. These results suggest that accounting for the interaction between rejected-token updates and preferred behavior provides an effective form of token-level credit assignment for preference optimization.

title: Range-GRPO: Policy Optimization via Pairwise Relations among Reward Intervals
summary: As the use of large language models (LLMs) expands, post-training has become increasingly important for adapting them to downstream tasks. However, obtaining reliable supervision remains costly, especially in domains without reference answers or executable verifiers. LLM-as-a-Judge provides scalable pseudo-rewards for unlabeled responses, but a single point score does not explicitly represent reward uncertainty. This motivates representing pseudo-rewards as conformally calibrated reward ranges. We propose Range-GRPO, a semi-supervised post-training framework that combines limited labeled data with unlabeled prompts. In Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), learning signals depend on relative reward comparisons within each rollout group. The proposed objective compares reward ranges pairwise rather than reducing them to point rewards, allowing interval uncertainty to affect both the magnitude and direction of these signals. Our theoretical analysis characterizes this distinction and shows that the proposed objective recovers the Dr$.$GRPO advantage when all reward ranges collapse to points. Empirically, Range-GRPO achieves the highest in-distribution and out-of-distribution average performance among the evaluated semi-supervised methods while requiring fewer training resources.

title: Continual Reinforcement Learning with Neuroevolution
summary: Despite many studies about causes and remedies of plasticity loss in Reinforcement Learning (RL) under continual task changes, no RL method has yet consistently achieved a good balance between adaptation and forgetting. Here we turn to an alternative optimization paradigm, neuroevolution (NE): algorithms that search directly in weight space through mutation and selection over a population of neural networks. Across a wide array of environments and environmental changes, with policies ranging from a few hundred parameters to million-parameter networks, we compare evolution strategies (ES) and genetic algorithms (GAs) against state-of-the-art continual RL variants and population-based RL. ES most consistently achieves a good stability-plasticity trade-off, while the GA is the most plastic method but forgets more than ES. To explain this, we study the return landscape around each method's solutions. ES finds the widest neighborhoods, i.e.\ regions of weight space in which perturbed policies still solve the task, and the size of the overlap between the neighborhoods of consecutive tasks correlates with a method's stability-plasticity trade-off. Rewarding behavioral diversity in a GA through novelty search makes the population even more plastic, at the cost of forgetting. Finally, symptoms of plasticity loss commonly reported in RL do not transfer to NE. Overall, these results establish NE as a competitive alternative to RL under continual task changes, and suggest that training under perturbations in weight space may be a useful mechanism for continual learning more broadly.

title: Learning PDE Dynamics between Submanifolds Using Green's Observation Operators
summary: Many physical systems are driven and observed only on lower-dimensional submanifolds of a larger spatial domain, while their dynamics are governed by the ambient medium occupying that domain. Examples include laser-heated parts imaged by an infrared camera, and ground-level emissions measured on a sensor plane. Full-domain solvers, however, compute the entire volume for every new source although only the observation submanifold is needed, and black-box surrogates do not exploit that the ambient medium remains fixed. We introduce the \emph{Green's Observation Operator (GObO)}, which maps the ambient medium once to the Green's kernel of a linear PDE restricted to the source and observation submanifolds. New sources then cost one lower-dimensional integral and no network evaluation. Exponential rates in the kernel yield an exact finite streaming state with horizon-independent memory; we prove its stability and an approximation rate for the restricted heat kernel. On three-dimensional heat conduction and advection--diffusion with collocated and distinct source and observation geometries, GObO trained on static sources predicts responses to moving sources zero-shot with 4--8$\times$ lower error than black-box surrogates, at 1.4\,ms per query after a single conditioning pass. The same kernel transfers across resolutions and admits corrections for mild nonlinearities, including radiative losses and temperature-dependent conductivity, without retraining, at the cost of lower in-distribution accuracy.

title: Query-Conditioned Articulation Estimation from a Single Image
comments: Code and video are available at https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/
summary: Enabling robots to estimate the kinematic parameters of articulated objects unlocks a wide range of capabilities for interaction and manipulation. The estimation has to happen from the information the robot currently observes, often just a single RGB image of an object it has never seen before. Current single-image approaches couple articulation part segmentation with articulation estimation, making their predictions vulnerable to missed detections and incorrect part associations, and they regress metric 3D geometry that a single view fixes only up to scale. We present QueryArt, a model that estimates articulation parameters from a single RGB image, a 2D query point, and camera intrinsics. QueryArt is trained to estimate the 3D articulation geometry relative to the queried point and in units of its depth, which keeps its target identifiable from the image alone. A single depth measurement at the query point then supplies the scale and recovers the metric parameters. We train QueryArt on a curated mixture of synthetic and real-world articulation datasets. We evaluate QueryArt on several benchmarks and compare it against recent baselines. QueryArt outperforms recent baselines on most articulation metrics, including on out-of-distribution data. To demonstrate the model's capabilities in real-world settings, we evaluate QueryArt on a mobile manipulator across 57 manipulation trials spanning 16 object parts and five viewpoint classes, achieving a 70.2% success rate. We provide code and videos at: https://abwerby.github.io/queryart/

title: Cross-Lingual Alignment for Decoder-Only Models using MoE Routers
summary: Cross-lingual contrastive learning has been a core component of multilingual encoder training, but the ability to explicitly align representations is not possible in decoder-only LLMs because of varying multilingual tokenization. However, a growing amount of research suggests that even in LLMs, higher cross-lingual representational alignment leads to improved cross-lingual transfer. In this paper, we propose a novel approach to reimagine cross-lingual contrastive learning given the architectural constraints of modern LLMs. Rather than applying an auxiliary alignment loss on hidden states, we propose using the outputs of the mixture-of-experts (MoE) routers as the target for alignment. Router outputs lend themselves better to pooling over many tokens, enabling more reliable cross-lingual comparisons at the sequence-level. Controlled continual pre-training experiments on four open-source MoEs show that incorporating this routing loss also aligns the underlying hidden representations across languages. Most importantly, this loss improves multilingual performance on our diverse evaluation suite, demonstrating the potential of cross-lingual MoE router alignment.

title: TouchTherm: Building Multimodal Digital Twins of Objects for Tactile and Thermal Rendering
summary: Robotic simulation and virtual reality increasingly require object assets that capture not only visual geometry but also the physical cues underlying tactile and thermal interaction. Existing 3D datasets and reconstruction methods primarily represent object-scale geometry and visual appearance, overlooking microscale surface structure for high-fidelity haptic rendering and transient temperature dynamics for temperature-aware interaction. We present TouchTherm, a framework for constructing simulation-ready visuo-tactile-thermal object assets from real-world objects. For visual and tactile reconstruction, we combine structured-light scanning with multiview normal maps obtained from photometric stereo. The normal maps are registered to the scanned geometry and transformed into tangent space to recover local micro-height fields for optical tactile rendering, while the coarse mesh handles collision detection. For thermal reconstruction, we capture synchronized multiview infrared videos of natural cooling following controlled heating and reconstruct a physics-regularized dynamic thermal field. Experiments on 20 objects show that the reconstructed micro-height fields preserve dominant surface structures and recover higher-frequency details beyond the coarse geometry, while the thermal fields achieve held-out surface-temperature MAEs of 0.465 degrees C and 0.592 degrees C at 30 s and 45 s, respectively. The resulting tactile assets support synthetic-to-real object recognition from tactile observations, while a glove-based VR system demonstrates spatially and temporally varying thermal feedback. These results highlight the potential of TouchTherm for multimodal sensory simulation and temperature-aware virtual interaction.

title: Universal Byte-Level Encoding: UTF-8/UTF-16 Routing to Reduce Cross-Script Token-Budget Disparities
summary: Byte-level byte-pair encoding (BBPE) tokenizers are attractive for multilingual large language models (LLMs) because they cover all Unicode text. In UTF-8-based BBPE, however, many scripts start from a higher fallback cost than English: when no learned merges can be applied, a multibyte character requires multiple byte-derived symbols. We call this worst-case pre-merge cost the encoding floor. A higher floor can increase token counts and per-request cost and shrink usable context. Changing the text encoding can reduce this gap, but a single global encoding can make already-efficient English spans more expensive in mixed-script text. We propose Universal Byte-Level Encoding (UBE), a dual-alphabet tokenizer that keeps 1-2-byte UTF-8 characters on the UTF-8 path while routing 3-4-byte UTF-8 characters through UTF-16. This lowers the encoding floor for 3-byte Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) characters in scripts with high token premiums (token counts relative to English) without raising it for already-efficient spans in mixed-script text. UBE changes only the byte representation presented to byte-pair encoding (BPE); the merge rule remains standard, and exact decoding is preserved. UBE also composes with alternative boundary policies and morphology-based representations. In a Unicode 17 audit, UBE exactly round-trips all Unicode scalar values and all inputs in the official normalization, grapheme-break, and emoji test suites. Across intrinsic evaluations, UBE lowers dispersion in English-normalized token-count ratios, reducing cross-lingual token-budget disparity. In multilingual language model (LM) experiments, UBE matches BBPE's LM quality. In the main multilingual settings, UBE reduces token counts most for high-premium scripts and slightly lowers English token counts, yielding more usable context under fixed token budgets and faster prompt processing in content-matched benchmarks.

title: Form and Void: Entangled Composition through an Autonomous AI Agent
comments: CVPR Workshops AI4VA, 2026, Best Paper Award
summary: Positive and negative space is a fundamental principle in visual composition, supporting visually coherent forms and layered semantic relationships. Generating such compositions is challenging because it requires coordinated control over two semantic concepts that share a common boundary. Although recent text-to-image models and multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance in image generation and visual understanding, positive-negative space generation remains difficult, particularly under direct single-pass prompting. In this work, we present the \textbf{F}orm \textbf{a}nd \textbf{V}oid \textbf{A}gent (\textbf{FaV-A}), a multimodal agent designed for staged positive-negative space generation. FaV-A follows a progressive workflow: it first generates a base object, then analyzes its shape and spatial structure to identify candidate negative-space semantics, and finally produces compositional instructions for the final image generation stage. Experimental results and ablation analyses suggest that FaV-A provides a more effective framework than direct zero-shot MLLM baselines for producing visually coherent and semantically aligned positive-negative space compositions.
